title: Product Manager - Spark
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. About the Role We’re looking for a Product Manager, Spark Projects to join our Product Team and lead a new Supabase project type built for how agents use infrastructure. Agents are creating an unprecedented amount of software, and every app, prototype, preview, and experiment needs a backend from the moment it’s created. Spark projects provision in a second, scale down when idle, and are cheap to enough to use liberally, guilt-free. while keeping the Supabase interface agents already know. Some of these projects will be small and short-lived while others will grow and graduate to larger instances on Supabase. This role owns establishing Spark as the default starting point for agent-built software and how projects grow from an early experiments into production workloads on Supabase. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Own the product strategy and roadmap for Spark projects, from early MVP through general availability. - Make Spark effortless for agents and the platforms they run on, so a backend exists the moment an idea does. - Define the path from experiment to production, including how projects get claimed, upgraded, and grown into the full Supabase platform. - Shape packaging and pricing with Engineering, Growth, and Finance so Spark is economical at very large scale. - Partner closely with Supabase for Platforms customers to understand their needs and bring Spark to them first. - Define what success looks like, instrument it end to end, and let the data guide what gets built next. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - Have 5+ years of product management on developer tools or infrastructure, or are an ex-founder with strong product instincts. - Have a strong point of view on agent-driven development and how it changes what developers and platforms need from a backend. - Know your way around AI Evals, controlled experimentation, and data analysis. - Are biased toward speed and would rather ship, learn, and iterate than perfect a spec. - Build with what you own and form opinions through first-hand use. - Use AI tools to compress research, drafting, and feedback synthesis so you can focus on judgment calls. - Work async by default, making decisions in writing in a fully remote team. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Security and Compliance Engineer
location: London or remote within the UK
description: About Griffin Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences. We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more. We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies. Learn more about what we do Our culture We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible. We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life. We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified. Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers. Learn more about our culture. The Team The Craft function has seven small, cross-functional engineering teams - each with engineers, an engineering manager, and a product manager, working closely with designers. You will work across the whole Craft function, with the remit of improving our controls and cyber security governance. You will initially work with and report to the Engineering Manager for Infrastructure as you establish yourself and take on your day to day responsibilities, additionally you will work closely with our CTO and Founder, Allen Rohner . The Opportunity We're looking for an Engineer 1.5 to become the engineering voice of security, compliance and assurance at Griffin. Sitting across engineering, security, risk and operational resilience, you'll turn standards and regulatory expectations into practical controls that engineers actually want to use and you’ll build those controls yourself, shipping code to production alongside the engineering team. You’ll also give our second and third lines real confidence in what we’ve built. It’s a rare hybrid role with broad ownership and a direct hand in strengthening Griffin’s security. What Success Looks Like In your first 6 months, you'll have taken ownership of our certification, attestation and audit work including ISO 27001 and SWIFT, with evidence organised and findings driven through to closure. Our engineering risks and controls will be well maintained, and our release, change and post-incident processes will be stronger. You’ll have shipped code that automates control checks and evidence collection, and you’ll be a regular contributor to our codebase. By month 12 our resilience plans, including Important Business Service technical mapping, B& Continuity Planning and disaster recovery, will be current, and security and compliance will be easier to run and easier to demonstrate to customers, thanks to clearer ownership and smart automation. To Do This You’ll Own Control design and cyber security governance: translating standards into practical engineering controls and building and shipping the code that puts them in place, working with Engineering teams to get them live Certifications and attestations, from SWIFT and FPS today to schemes like SOC 2 and ISO 27001 in the future, including the documentation behind them Internal and external audits and customer due diligence requests, owning findings and driving them to closure Engineering Risk and Controls Self Assessments, controls and actions, plus recurring control activity such as chaos testing and backup/restore Code release and change management, improving the process and sampling releases to check adherence to policy Post-incident reviews, including follow-up actions and sharing learnings with the right stakeholders Engineering's contribution to operational resilience (DR plans and IBS technical mapping) and to managing engineering third parties alongside Operations We expect you to shape this role This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are. Your background To ensure this, we're looking for people who have: A hands-on engineering or technical background, including experience writing and shipping production code with an engineering-first approach to turning standards into practical controls and technical delivery Experience in security, compliance, risk or assurance within a technical environment, including owning or significantly contributing to audits, certifications or attestations Strong knowledge of compliance, risk and cyber security principles, and a broad understanding of change and release management, incident management, operational resilience and third-party governance Sharp analytical and assurance skills: spotting gaps, assessing adherence to standards and following actions through Stakeholder management and influencing skills across Engineering, SMEs, auditors and control functions, with a pragmatic, proportionate approach to governance A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write ) Ideally, you would also: Be familiar with frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, SWIFT and FPS, ideally from a regulated fintech or challenger bank environment Have used automation and code to improve security, compliance or control processes and documentation What can we offer you? We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future. Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year Time off: 25 days’ holiday, bank holidays and a winter break (we shut down between Christmas and New Year) Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment. As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks. How do I apply? Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next. We’re remote-first We trust people to do great work wherever they are. We hire across the UK and most of our team works remotely full-time. We have a small London office in Moorgate for those who want it, and about a third of the company is close enough to use it occasionally, but there's no expectation to be there. What matters is the work, not where you do it. Under representation At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance Griffin Bank Ltd request that recruitment agencies do not speculatively submit CVs to any employee or associate of our company unless explicitly asked to do so by a member of our Talent team. Any CVs sent to any member of our team on a speculative basis will not be recognised and we will not accept liability for any fee or commission should we subsequently employ a candidate who applied to us directly or was introduced by an instructed agency that may also have been submitted speculatively by an uninstructed agency. title: Lead Legal Counsel, Regulatory and Financial Services
description: Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy? Then Pennylane is the right place for you ! Our vision We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business. About us Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!) In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to : 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants 💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more... 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor . 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings 🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France! We are currently operating approximately 30k business accounts under a BaaS model with Swan. The role of Financial Services in our strategy is set to grow, both in terms of revenue and product contribution, to serve our 800k current customer base. As such, we are initiating a process to get licensed as Etablissement de paiement et Société de financement. Our ambition is to start onboarding new customers by mid 2027 before starting migrating existing customers. To meet this ambition, we are starting to hire our Tech, Product, Compliance, Legal and Ops leaders. We are looking for a Lead Legal Counsel to drive the legal function of our Financial Services activity and build our regulatory legal team. From the day you join until we are fully licensed, you will structure and execute the legal path to authorization: interpret requirements, translate them into an internal plan, and ensure deliverables are complete, consistent, and aligned across teams. You will help define the target operating model (intra-group and outsourced) and ensure it is legally defensible and well documented for the application. After licensing, you will shift from “building the file” to running and scaling the legal function of the regulated entity: ensuring ongoing compliance with ACPR expectations, enabling product growth safely, and keeping the operating model (including outsourcing) continuously audit-ready. You will own the legal oversight of day-to-day legal and corporate matters (policies, governance, reporting support, inspections), lead the legal work for launching new regulated products and entering new partnerships, and manage the legal aspects of onboarding and migrating customers to the licensed subsidiary (terms, communications, complaints/conduct risk). This is a greenfield project with high autonomy and responsibility, and the opportunity to shape the legal culture of a fast-growing fintech while managing and mentoring an experienced Legal Counsel, with the ambition to scale the team further as the business grows. Organisation & Reporting You will be part of the core Legal Department. Your reporting line will be Stanislas, our General Counsel. You will manage a seasoned Legal Counsel and will be responsible for planning the future growth of the Financial Services Legal team. You will also partner closely with our Financial Services Chief Compliance and Risk Officer, Chief Operational Officer and the contract team. Mission & Objectives Team Leadership & Structuring You manage, mentor, and develop your team member(s), fostering a high-performance, autonomous, and pragmatic legal culture. You structure the team’s workload and roadmap, delegating effectively while remaining deeply hands-on. You anticipate future hiring needs and actively participate in scaling the regulatory legal team. Corporate and governance You design, document and run the legal aspects of corporate governance: delegation of powers, board/committee charters, conflicts management, inter-company arrangements on payment services outsourcing, governance narrative for the ACPR reports, and ongoing legal compliance cadence once authorized. Products, contracts and customer legal architecture You own the legal design of the FS product perimeter (payments services, account services, credit/financing products as applicable). You work with the contractual team (Roland) on the associated contractual framework: customer terms, disclosures, pricing documentation, complaint handling language, and operational/legal flows (including KYC/AML handoffs, incident handling and customer communications). Outsourcing / BaaS transition & vendor contracting You own legal matters relating to critical outsourcing and third-party reliance (including existing BaaS arrangements): contract negotiation, regulatory outsourcing clauses, audit/access rights, sub-outsourcing controls, exit plans, SLAs, data protection allocation, operational resilience expectations, and documentation suitable for ACPR scrutiny. Migration readiness In close collaboration with the operation team (Maxime), you lead the legal plan for migrating customers from Swan (sequencing, consent/novation approaches, customer communications from a legal standpoint, continuity of mandates, handling of incidents/complaints, and safeguards to minimise conduct risk). Privacy and Security In close coordination with our DPO (Léa) and security stakeholders, you ensure that our Financial Services operating model address data processing roles, cross-border flows (if any), retention, incident response, recordkeeping, and contractual protections with key providers. Regulatory engagement support & internal enablement Until we are fully licenced, you help prepare ACPR interactions (Q&A packs, position papers, meeting preparation). Once authorized, you own the relationship with ACPR from a legal perspective, supporting the CCRO with legal opinions, advisory etc. You train internal stakeholders on the legal/regulatory constraints that shape product and operations, and build a “legal-by-design” approach for Financial Services. Culture, Training & Advisory You will be expected to operate as an owner, not a “support function,” and to produce pragmatic, regulator-ready outcomes. About you You have 8+ years of relevant experience, including in-house legal experience at a regulated entity (payments, EMI/PI, bank, lending/consumer credit, factoring, etc.), fintech, or BaaS. You have a proven track record or a strong aptitude for managing, mentoring, and developing team members in a fast-paced environment. You have substantial experience in regulated financial services legal work, and you are comfortable owning cross-functional programmes. Senior legal expert in a French ACPR-regulated entity (établissement de paiement, établissement de crédit, société de financement or similar). Hands on contract experience and knowledge about our regulatory environment (arrêté du 3 novembre 2014, PSD2, DORA, EBA Guidelines, etc). Skills & mindset Technical strengths You can credibly lead on : ACPR/European regulatory frameworks for payments and/or lending/financing; Outsourcing and third-party risk legal frameworks in regulated environments; Governance and regulated-entity corporate law basics. Soft skills Player-coach mentality: capable of executing complex individual contributions while guiding and empowering your team. You can work fast without losing rigour. Strong pedagogy: able to explain complex regulatory legal topics to product managers, engineers and founders in simple, actionable terms. Pragmatic, impact-driven approach, capable of operating under strong regulatory constraints without blocking innovation. Very strong written and oral communication skills in both French and English. Languages, presence and location Fluent French and English are mandatory. Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris. Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role. Recruitment Process 1. Interview with Lucie (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter 2. Interview with Stanislas (1h), Head of Legal, Risk & Compliance 3. Case Study with Stanislas & Maxime (1h) 4. Last round with Laurent and Felix (45 min) What do we do to make your work life easier 🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane 💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package 📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us 🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it ⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness 🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French 💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment 🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone 🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone. title: Senior Data Intelligence Engineer
description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. About Deepgram Deepgram is the foundational AI company for voice. We build the models that allow machines to hear, understand, and speak to humans with zero latency. As we scale our usage-based economy, we are building the "Intelligence Layer"—a system of autonomous agents that monitor, reason, and act on our data to drive NRR and operational excellence. The Role Reporting to the Head of Decision Intelligence , you are the founding engineer of the Data Intelligence team. While the Head of Data sets the strategic "Brain" of the company, you build the nervous system. You are not building legacy dashboards; instead you are building the API-based tools, dbt models, and semantic layers that allow AI agents to navigate our data environment autonomously. Key Responsibilities Semantic Layer Architecture: Build and maintain high-fidelity dbt and SQL models that serve as the "ground truth" for our complex, usage-based revenue models. Agent Tooling & Integration: Develop the tools and permissions frameworks that allow "Analyst Agents" to query Athena, correlate Salesforce churn signals, and identify API latency issues. Infrastructure Evolution: Serve as the technical bridge to the Engineering/Infra team to ensure our data contracts are "agent-ready" and highly reliable. The "Unlock Audio Intelligence" Project: Partner with the Head of Data to ingest thousands of hours of internal calls using Deepgram’s own models, turning unstructured audio into queryable insights for GTM teams. Automation Obsession: Maintain a culture where manual, repetitive SQL tasks are viewed as automation bugs to be solved with code and agents. Requirements Experience: 5+ years in high-growth Data or AI Engineering roles. AI-Native Technical Skills: Mastery of SQL and Python (production-grade) with a proven track record of building RAG or Agentic systems on top of structured data. Usage-Based SaaS Fluency: Familiarity with the metrics of an API-first business, such as consumption patterns, gross margins, and NRR. Builder Mindset: Comfort with "work-in-progress" infrastructure and the ability to turn messy, siloed data into high-impact business logic. Bonus Points Prior experience as a Software Engineer or Data Engineer. Experience with real-time billing and consumption systems. Contributions to open-source data or AI projects. Notice : We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @ deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

title: Growth Manager
description: LOCATION: The Growth Manager is a remote, work from home position , as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and our vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel is required, for client meetings or other internal meetings, conferences, etc. THE ROLE: Acceleration Partners is seeking a Growth Manager to drive partner growth strategies for some of our largest and most complex client programs. In this role, you will identify, develop, and scale high-impact partnerships that drive measurable revenue growth and help clients achieve their business objectives. You will shape recruitment, activation, and optimization strategies, uncover emerging growth opportunities, and influence partnership roadmaps beyond traditional affiliate models. TOP 5 JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Client Revenue: Publisher & Partner Performance: Contributes to client growth and retention by building high-potential partner relationships and optimizing performance. Performance Trackers & Reporting : Follows client-approved processes for paid placements and partner optimizations. Uses reporting effectively, translating data into a clear story that shows clients not just what happened, but why it matters and what to do next. Subject Matter Expert Across the Partnership Landscape: Is a trusted, knowledgeable resource on partner relationships and client verticals. Proactively leads conversations to share insights, adding value to the accounts they support and the broader department. Business Development and Partner Relationships: Proactive Research: Identifies and recruits high-quality partners with strong revenue potential based on client needs. Written and Verbal Communication: Communications are clear, informative, and engaging. Asks relevant questions to vet opportunities effectively. Manages day-to-day communication with top partners in the program. Initiative: Proactively identifies and executes areas of opportunity and optimization across the program to drive revenue growth. Top Partner Management Relationship Management: Optimizes opportunities with top partners on behalf of the client. Views themselves as a true extension of the client's business and maintains long-lasting relationships with key partners. Budget Management: Identifies and acts on opportunities that drive client growth while maintaining a healthy return on investment. Time Management: Demonstrates exceptional calendar and time management skills. Strategy and Execution: Alignment to Client Strategy and Goals: Participates in engagement kickoff calls and ongoing calls as needed; maintains a clear understanding of client goals and KPIs. Creation and Ongoing Ownership of Partner Strategy: Builds a recruitment and/or paid placement plan end-to-end (from strategy through execution) based on client goals and KPIs. Strategy Pivots: Adapts and pivots strategies to reach client goals, resetting expectations when needed. Pushes back constructively on unrealistic client goals while preserving trust. Pitching Opportunities: Client Education and Alignment: Clearly articulates the "why" behind each opportunity and its expected value, including anticipated ROI. Persuasiveness: Demonstrates intellectual curiosity and a willingness to challenge the status quo. Regularly identifies, pitches, and secures approval for innovative opportunities, grounded in data. Partnership Ecosystem Knowledge: Maintains deep knowledge across partnership types and applies that expertise to confidently address client questions and identify opportunities. Tenacity: Proactively explores the reasoning behind a rejection, thoughtfully pushes back when appropriate, and has a track record of overcoming objections. What Success Looks Like By 6 Months: You've developed strong relationships with your clients and their key partners, and have a firm grasp on the recruitment and reporting process. You're consistently sourcing and engaging partners who can drive real revenue and scale for your programs, meeting partner outreach goals as well as recruitment and revenue goals. You regularly bring relevant new partner opportunities to your clients and help keep AP on the forefront of affiliate publisher and partner models. Clients see you as someone who brings ideas, not just executes on them. By 1 Year: You're consistently meeting or exceeding your goals and have established efficient reporting and recruitment processes, along with best practices that benefit the broader team. You've built a reputation for identifying opportunities that drive considerable revenue growth and for collaborating with partners and clients to develop new activation tactics that help clients exceed their goals. You've also successfully identified and activated non-traditional partner types for your clients. Qualities of the ideal candidate: Growth-oriented and energized by identifying, pursuing, and closing new opportunities, equally motivated to find new partnerships and deepen existing ones. Natural relationship builder who proactively creates opportunities and strengthens relationships for clients and partners. Enjoys building persuasive, data-grounded pitches that connect new opportunities directly to client goals. Strong aptitude for developing partner strategy informed by publisher business models and client objectives. Builds new relationships quickly and establishes credibility fast with clients, partners and internal stakeholders. Comfortable operating independently in a remote environment, exercising sound judgment with minimal oversight. Communicates with confidence, poise, and clarity, especially under pressure or in high-stakes conversations. Thrives in a fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environment and brings their own structure and prioritization to it. Exercises mature, measured judgment; solves problems independently but knows when to escalate or loop others in. Takes full ownership of their work: consistently meets commitments and delivers quality without close supervision. Minimum qualifications & skills: 2–5 years of partnership/channel marketing experience. Affiliate marketing background required; direct exposure to content partnerships, AEO, or retail media is a strong plus. Demonstrated track record of self-generating new business. Proven excellence in meeting or exceeding revenue targets. Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and negotiation skills. Knowledge of affiliate networks, including Impact, Partnerize, CJ, and Awin. Ability to travel up to 20% for client meetings, industry conferences, and events. WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS? Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing. AP PERKS & BENEFITS - WHAT WE OFFER 100% remote work for everyone Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits) 401K with matching Open Paid Time Off Summer & Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December Volunteer and Birthday Time Off Focus Fridays Paid Parental Leave Benefits Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!! Our mission is to build Connections That Work by fostering a diverse and inclusive team. We are committed to making everyone feel valued and empowered to contribute their unique skills, experiences and perspectives. And now we want to connect with you.

title: Merchant Support Specialist
description: Merchant Operations at Polar Merchant Operations at Polar is about delivering an exceptional merchant experience while building the processes, tooling and automation that allow us to scale. As we rethink how software companies monetize their products, we help merchants navigate the complexities of global payments, billing and financial workflows. Polar sits in the critical path of our merchants' businesses, where reliability, responsiveness and sound judgment matter deeply. We're looking for people who enjoy solving complex problems, understanding how products work and collaborating closely with Product and Engineering to turn merchant insights into meaningful improvements. We're a small, fast-moving team where there's plenty of room to take ownership, challenge how things are done and make a meaningful impact. We value people who look beyond individual problems, spot opportunities to improve how we work and help build the systems and experiences that make Polar better as we scale. More about Polar and how we work. Role & responsibilities: What you will do As a Merchant Support Specialist, you'll be on the front lines helping merchants and customers succeed with Polar. You'll troubleshoot issues, answer questions, and work closely with Product and Engineering to improve the merchant experience. As a small and fast-moving team, we’re looking for someone who wants to do more than resolve individual support requests. You’ll be close to the product and the people using it, identifying friction, spotting opportunities for improvement, and helping build the processes, tooling, and automation that allow Merchant Operations to scale alongside Polar. You’ll work with the team to Own merchant and customer inquiries end-to-end across email, chat, and Slack, ensuring issues are understood, prioritized and driven to resolution. Investigate and troubleshoot issues across payments, payouts, subscriptions, checkout and the merchant dashboard, building a deep understanding of how Polar works. Help merchants successfully onboard, navigate the platform, and understand the operational and financial workflows involved in using Polar as their Merchant of Record. Partner closely with Product and Engineering to reproduce bugs, uncover root causes, and turn merchant feedback into meaningful product improvements. Identify recurring support trends, proactively identifying recurring friction and opportunities to improve the Help Center, documentation, product, and internal processes. Exercise sound judgment in prioritizing and escalating complex technical, payment, and account issues, balancing urgency, merchant impact, and operational risk. Maintain a high bar for customer experience by providing thoughtful, accurate, and timely support. Contribute to operational improvements that help us scale support without sacrificing quality. What we’re looking for We're looking for someone who is naturally curious, resourceful, and enjoys getting to the bottom of complex problems. You're comfortable working across multiple tools, can explain complex topics clearly, and care about delivering an excellent customer experience while balancing efficiency with attention to detail. Skills & Experience 2+ years of experience in customer support, merchant support, or customer success, preferably in SaaS, fintech, or payments. Excellent written communication skills with a customer-first mindset. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities. Experience working with support platforms such as Plain, Zendesk, Intercom, or similar. Ability to independently prioritize and manage multiple conversations while maintaining attention to detail. Comfortable collaborating with Product and Engineering teams to resolve customer issues. Familiarity with payments, subscriptions, or Merchant of Record platforms is a plus.

title: Vice President, International
description: Job Summary: As Vice President, International, you will report directly to the EVP, Industries, and grow Toptal ’s Enterprise business across Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia Pacific. All international Enterprise sales teams will report to you. Working with our industry General Managers, you will decide where to focus, tailor our approach to each market, and be accountable for sales results. In some markets, growth will depend on solving the practical problems of doing business there. You may need to find a local partner, work through contracting requirements, or adapt how we deliver. You will work across Toptal to put those arrangements in place and help your teams win business. You will build on established enterprise relationships to expand the problems clients trust Toptal to solve through our services, AI-based solutions, and talent-based capabilities. You will personally develop client relationships, shape proposals, and lead important negotiations. This role requires someone who can make sound choices about the business and do the work needed to deliver them. This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. Align with industry GMs which markets and clients to pursue, what to offer, and where to stop investing effort. Use your teams’ knowledge of local buyers and competitors to develop sales plans that fit each market. Work through obstacles to selling and serving clients in priority geographies. Bring Legal, Finance, Operations, and Delivery together to resolve local requirements and establish arrangements that work commercially. Follow through on implementation. Be accountable for new-client acquisition, retention, and expansion. Work with industry GMs and account teams to expand existing relationships into additional business units and countries. Make sure teams know who owns each account and opportunity. Build senior client relationships and take an active role in important sales. Work with clients to define the problem, the value of solving it, and what it will take to reach a buying decision. Shape proposals with the relevant industry GM and specialists, and lead negotiations where your involvement can help close the business. Develop targeted campaigns with Marketing, Sales Development, and industry teams. Give sellers propositions that address the needs of local buyers, and use campaign results to improve targeting and follow-up. Find partners that help Toptal reach clients or serve a market. Agree on how you will sell together, who owns the client relationship, and how each party benefits. Judge partnerships by the business they generate. Help sellers recognize when a client needs services or an AI-based solution. Bring in the right expertise, coach teams on explaining the value, and ensure the seller stays responsible for advancing the opportunity. Hire and develop strong regional leaders. Review their coaching and join client calls to see where teams need help. Set clear expectations, demonstrate better approaches, and address underperformance promptly. Establish a consistent rhythm for pipeline reviews, forecasting, and account planning. Investigate missed targets and change what is not working. Work with Finance to keep spending within agreed budgets and direct resources toward the best growth opportunities. In the first week, expect to: Learn Toptal’s Enterprise business model, industry priorities, and services, AI, and talent capabilities. Meet industry GMs, your sales leaders, and the teams supporting international clients. Join client calls and begin reviewing sales performance, active opportunities, and obstacles to growth. In the first month, expect to: Assess your leaders and teams, including their selling capability, account coverage, and coaching. Present a proposed international growth plan identifying the markets and clients to pursue, the barriers to address, and the resources needed. Establish regular commercial reviews with regional leaders and industry GMs. In the first three months, expect to: Be executing agreed regional plans, with sellers pursuing defined accounts and opportunities. Have put initial arrangements in place to address priority barriers to selling and serving clients. Be personally advancing major opportunities and have made the first hiring, leadership, and coaching decisions needed to improve results. In the first six months, expect to: Demonstrate progress against international sales objectives and explain which initiatives are contributing to results. Show where coaching has improved deal progression or conversion, and act where results remain weak. Have active client opportunities from partnerships where they are part of the regional plan. In the first year, expect to: Deliver against agreed international revenue and sales performance objectives. Demonstrate growth from new clients and expansion within existing accounts, with evidence to guide further investment. Have regional leaders who coach their teams, address performance issues, and deliver against their plans. Qualifications and Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree is required. An MBA or a master’s degree in a relevant field is preferred. 10+ years of B2B commercial experience, including SaaS or services sales to enterprise clients. You can demonstrate your personal contribution to winning significant business and growing client relationships. 3+ years leading sales organizations, including managing managers and teams across multiple countries. You have improved results through coaching, hiring, and addressing underperformance. Deep commercial experience in at least one of Europe, the Middle East, Africa, or Asia Pacific. Experience in a second region is preferred. Experience opening or expanding markets by solving commercial and operating challenges, including working with partners. You can explain what stood in the way, what you put in place, and the business it generated. Experience developing industry-specific sales strategies with industry or business-unit leaders. You know how to combine their expertise with regional knowledge and resolve competing priorities. Experience navigating enterprise buying processes and personally leading important client negotiations. Sound commercial judgment. You can assess market potential, understand the costs of pursuing it, and decide where to commit resources. Enough fluency in technology, AI, and services delivery to discuss client needs, identify relevant opportunities, and know when specialist expertise is needed. Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication in English, including the ability to give geographically distributed teams specific direction. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including proposals and presentations. Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. Regular or periodic travel to meet and engage with Toptal clients and customers both inside and outside of your geographic location. You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do. Essential Job Functions: Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera. Work independently with minimal supervision. Use all required digital collaboration tools. Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines. Work effectively with clients and colleagues across time zones. Travel internationally as needed to develop client and partner relationships and work with your teams. Compensation Additional Information

title: AI Trainers Network - Croatian Talent Hub
description: Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries. At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms. Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech? Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI. By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms. Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation. What You’ll Need - Native or near-native fluency in Croatian - Based in: Croatia, Serbia, United States - English proficiency - Comfortable with digital tools - Detail-oriented and curious Why Join Us? Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community About our projects: Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI. Depending on your skills, you might: Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs) Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you’ll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you. How to Apply? Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community. Questions? If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact us at TalentRequests@welocalize.com . Compensation Additional Information

title: Customer Success Manager
description: At Semperis , our mission is to be a Force for Good. Starting with being a great place to work. We believe that when people feel valued, supported, and empowered, they do their best work. That’s why we focus on creating an employee experience rooted in purpose, growth, and balance. Semperis has been recognized as one of America’s Fastest-Growing Cybersecurity Companies by the Inc. 5000, a DUNS 100 Top Startup to Work For, and a multi-year Inc. Best Workplace awardee. Semperis is looking for a passionate and results-driven Customer Success Manager to join our Americas team. What you’ll be doing: As a Customer Success Manager at Semperis, you will ensure your customers' success and satisfaction with our products and support them every step of the way. You will be an essential member of our Customer Success team, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including Technical Delivery and Sales teams to maximize opportunities for our SMB customers and Semperis. Our Customer Success Managers are strategic and empathetic communicators who can convey complex concepts in a clear and concise manner. Our CSM will build and nurture long-lasting relationships across multiple client accounts. Our CSM’s strengths include the ability to identify gaps in the product and internal operations and build effective and scalable solutions to address them. Our CSM will also onboard new customers, ensuring a smooth and successful implementation of our solutions. You will be responsible for: Designing success plans for a Book of Business of approximately 50 SMB customers throughout their lifecycle. From onboarding and implementation through upselling, cross-sell, and renewal, you will guide your customer down the path of success every step of the way to help them reach their business objectives and operational goals. You will be empowered to achieve and report on customer health, satisfaction, retention, and growth targets. Acting as the voice of the customer, gather insights to provide feedback to internal teams including our Product Development team. Collaborate on new developments to ensure the product suits our client’s needs. Leading training sessions to ensure that the product is meeting user needs and is being used widely enough to have concrete impact on our customers' operations. Monitoring record-keeping to ensure that relevant customer information is captured to enable informed, personalized customer interactions with Semperis Support, Customer Success (CS), Sales, etc. Developing and execute programs for ongoing customer development (health checks, product upgrades, workshops, etc.) Identifying potential customer references and assisting with development of customer case studies. Gain and maintain an understanding of Semperis technology, products, and services. In addition to managing an assigned customer segment, assist with development and enhancement of processes and systems for the overall Semperis CS program. What you will bring to the table: Technical & Cyber Security Skills Hands-on product enablement experience with a security product vendor, including running product health checks, articulating the output with expertise, configuring or tuning alert and response rules, remediating Active Directory and Entra security posture vulnerabilities. Understanding of security concepts (NIST IR process, MITRE Attack framework, APTs, etc.) and workflows, Active Directory and Entra ID vulnerabilities and attack patterns, IAM and Security team organization structures Strong foundational knowledge of cyber security domains: Network security, endpoint protection (EDR/XDR), cloud security (CSPM/CWPP), identity (IAM/SSO/MFA), SIEM, zero-trust, threat intelligence, etc. Fundamental understanding of modern architectures: on-prem and cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) Familiarity with compliance frameworks (NIST CSF, CIS, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2) Customer-facing & Soft Skills 3+ years’ experience as a Customer Success Manager, technical account manager, or related customer-facing role in a Cybersecurity SaaS solutions company. Executive presence & communication: can explain complex threats or product value to CISOs, CIOs, architects, and analysts in their language. Storytelling with data: Turn telemetry, risk scores, and attack surface metrics into compelling business narratives. Project/program management: Be in tune with customer onboarding, health checks, maturity roadmaps, and expansion opportunities. Conflict resolution & expectation management during incidents or escalations Consultative selling & value realization: Identify use cases that justify expansion, upsell & cross-sell modules, or multi-year renewals. Business & Strategic Skills Renewal & expansion forecasting (understand ARR, NRR, consumption metrics) Ability to build and Execute Customer Success Plans / Joint Success Plans with Account owners (sales reps) Risk identification (technical debt, low adoption, competing solutions) and mitigation planning (QBRs, escalation paths) Competitive intelligence: Know how our product differentiates from the competition. Preferences: Experience with SFDC and Active Directory #LI-KG1 Why Join Semperis? You’ll be part of a global team on the front lines of cybersecurity innovation. At Semperis, we celebrate curiosity, integrity, and people who take initiative. If you’re someone who sees the glass as half full, embraces challenges as growth opportunities, and values a healthy balance between work and life—we’d love to meet you. **Semperis maintains office locations in several cities across the globe. Where the job description specifies a required location, candidates will follow our hybrid work model. This includes working up to three days per week and remotely the remaining days. Semperis is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against an applicant or employee based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, citizenship, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law. The information collected by the Semperis application is solely to determine suitability for employment, verify identity, and maintain employment statistics. Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act and/or other applicable state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on Semperis. Please inform Semperis representative Anna Taylor, Director of Global Recruiting, if you need assistance completing this application or to otherwise participate in the application process.

title: Americas Sales Business Partner Manager
description: Who we are At Twilio , we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. . Hiring and how we work We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. . See yourself at Twilio Join the team as Twilio’s next Americas Sales Business Partner Manager. About the job We are seeking an Americas Sales Business Partner Manager (SBP) to serve as the right hand Sales Ops leader to leaders across the Americas Sales organization. In this role, you will be instrumental in ensuring alignment between sales strategy and execution, fostering collaboration across teams, and driving operational excellence that accelerates growth and delivers measurable results for your verticals. The ideal candidate is a hands-on Sales Operations leader with deep go-to-market (GTM) and enterprise-scale software/tech experience in sales strategy. Success requires tight alignment and collaboration with your peer Sales Operations functional leaders ( Strategic Operations, Sales Compensation, GTM Initiatives and GTM Analytics, GTM Enablement) and company-wide cross-functional teams such as HR, finance, marketing, product and more. Responsibilities In this role, you’ll: Be the Business partner to GTM leaders; challenge the status quo. Shape & execute business strategy to address risks / obstacles / opportunities. Translate strategy into actionable operational plans & execute. Be the Voice of sales in cross-functional initiatives. Execute operational cadences at the Vertical/Segment level supporting a Regional VP of Sales Manage forecast and pipeline health; drive predictability for month/quarter/year. Provide business performance insights; facilitate decision-making. Produce recurring & ad hoc exec business updates. Engage & deliver on localized planning & sales ops activities (e.g. headcount, Annual Planning, New Year Readiness, Account Movements, Territory & Quota operationalization) in alignment with Strategic Operations peer function. Qualifications Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! *Required: 6+ years of experience in sales operations, sales, strategy consulting; minimum 2+ years directly partnering with senior software/tech sales leaders ($1B+ sales orgs). Proficiency in sales planning and operations including sales coverage, segmentation, territory planning, sales compensation strategy and executing a rhythm of business (MBRs, QBRs, etc). Problem-solving, communication and interpersonal skills with ability to influence and align senior leadership and teams. Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent years' of experience; graduate degree a plus. Location This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA. Travel We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings. What We Offer Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. Compensation The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows: Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $116,960 - $146,200. Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $123,760 - $154,700. Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $137,520 - $171,900. This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. Application deadline information Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 20, 2026, but may change based on business needs. Twilio thinks big. Do you? We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts. So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions. . Stay alert to recruitment fraud We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps. . Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: Senior Campaign Manager (Temp Contract)
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We're looking for a Senior Integrated Campaign Manager, Brand & GTM to join our Integrated Marketing team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help architect, roll out, project manage, and drive the Go-To-Market (GTM) execution for our major 2027 brand marketing strategy and campaigns and be part of turning brand strategy, positioning, and creative concepts into operational GTM blueprints as we scale our multi-segment (SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise) reach across 6 key European markets. If you're excited about high-visibility, full-funnel orchestration and balancing long-term brand equity building with full-funnel conversion, and are passionate about integrated brand and GTM marketing in high-growth B2B SaaS, then this is the opportunity for you! Please bear in mind this role is a temporary contract of 1 year. Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to our Director of Integrated Marketing and work closely with teams in Brand Marketing, Digital, Field/Events, Content, PR, Product Marketing (PMM), Marketing Ops, Data, and Sales/Growth channels. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to bridging top-of-funnel brand awareness with lower-funnel acquisition, ensuring every campaign moment translates into market salience, customer engagement, and measurable business impact. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across country teams, local market stakeholders, Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field squads to ensure success. What you’ll be doing As a Senior Campaign Manager, you will: Integrated GTM Architecture & Strategic Planning : Translate the overarching 2027 brand strategy into actionable, full-funnel GTM campaign blueprints across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments, architecting campaign flighting and distribution models across 6 European markets. The "Master Brief" & Cross-Functional Squad Leadership : Own and author comprehensive Integrated Campaign Master Briefs, leading the operational rhythm of cross-functional squads to execute multi-channel strategies (OOH, Paid Social, VIP activations, Digital, ABM) on time and within scope. Localization & Regional Adaptation : Partner with country teams and local market stakeholders to ensure master campaign frameworks balance global consistency with local relevance and execution precision. Strategic Brand Partnership & Enablement : Serve as the strategic execution peer to the Brand Marketing Lead, while partnering with Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field teams to equip customer-facing squads with the stories, tools, and campaign momentum needed to capitalize on campaign-generated intent. Campaign Operations, Budget & ROI Accountability : Maintain and protect the integrated campaign master calendar, manage and allocate the multi-country integrated campaign budget, and partner with Marketing Ops, Data, and Brand Intelligence to track brand lift, consideration, pipeline growth, and closed-won impact. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: A proven track record leading multi-million dollar, multi-country, full-funnel integrated campaigns in high-growth B2B SaaS or tech environments. Deep experience taking high-level brand frameworks and translating them into multi-channel GTM blueprints across varied audience segments (SMB to Enterprise). High proficiency in aligning cross-functional teams (Creative, Digital, PR, Ops, Sales) and holding squads accountable to tight deadlines and complex campaign launches. Deep understanding of how to run campaigns across diverse European markets, with a clear perspective on modular campaign design and local adaptation. Experience with tracking brand-to-pipeline performance metrics, campaign flighting dynamics, brand lift, consideration, and total ROI. A background in integrated marketing, GTM campaign management, or brand marketing orchestration within B2B technology or SaaS. Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You thrive as the operational bridge between high-level brand strategy and lower-funnel demand generation, turning concepts into structured GTM blueprints. You love leading cross-functional squads across multiple international markets, balancing consistency with local nuances across 6 key European countries. You take pride in end-to-end accountability, from authoring master briefs and handling multi-country budgets to tracking downstream pipeline velocity and closed-won revenue impact. This role is not a good fit for you if: You prefer focusing purely on high-level creative ideation, copy, or audience insight development without building the operational execution machinery. You prefer running single-channel or single-market marketing initiatives rather than orchestrating complex, multi-segment (SMB to Enterprise), multi-channel matrices. You are uncomfortable navigating data, campaign flighting performance, budget allocations, and downstream pipeline attribution alongside brand metrics. How you’ll develop in this role In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll: Lead the architecture and rollout of the 2027 integrated brand campaign calendar across all target European markets. Collaborate with the Brand Marketing Lead, country teams, and Marketing Ops to stand up the Master Briefing framework and streamline cross-functional execution rhythms. Grow your skills in full-funnel orchestration and multi-market scale, driving measurable brand lift, consideration, and downstream pipeline velocity as Pleo continues to expand. The location Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work . We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations. Show me the benefits! Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards). For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role Final Interview : A final interview with a senior leader Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! Last time we hired for this role, we received a total vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call.Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include: CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background! Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us. Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you. Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here . Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role. Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Clinical Project Coordinator
description: Provide administrative, clerical, implementation and/or processing support to the project teams and stakeholders. Assist with document/process/report development, testing, tracking, distribution, and management. Coordinate meetings, presentations, and training activities, facilitate billing and payment activities, and act as first point of contact for project queries. Ensure that all activities align with quality standards, project guidelines, corporate best practices, and regulatory standards and guidelines. Project Support Prepare and coordinate flow of documents, materials, and resources for project meetings and presentations, preparing meeting agendas, minutes and documents, scheduling and coordinating project committees, sponsor and site meetings, and tracking training programs and activities Facilitate project invoicing, billing and payment document preparation including support documents, and assist with internal and external communications throughout the project life cycle. Document Management Assist team, providing timely administrative support, including form preparation, client/project information entry, creating logs, reports, and scripts Contribute to the creation and maintenance of project forms, documents and processes during the project life cycle and assist with project issue identification and resolution during audits that is consistent with project requirements. Client/Sponsor Support Act as first point of contact for project queries, appropriately identifying, addressing, redirecting or escalating questions, protocol clarification requests and project/service issues appropriately, that are consistent with project requirements, regulatory standards and corporate code of conduct. Document Control Manage and maintain project materials, tools, equipment and supplies, ensuring all activity is entered/recorded, distributed, tracked, monitored, updated, revised and/or maintained in accordance with project protocols, industry best practices and regulatory standards and guidelines. Qualifications Applicants should have a minimum of one to three years of related work experience with ongoing training, or a minimum of a one-year College Advance Diploma/Degree in a relevant field of study, preferable in Health or Life Sciences, or Clinical Research. The successful candidate must exhibit the following skills: Knowledge of clinical research, ability to work independently, strong communication skills, and the ability to work in a cross-functional environment. Working conditions Home Based *Accommodations for job applicants with disabilities are available upon request Compensation + bonus Additional Information PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Alimentiv is aware of the continued increase of phishing scams, leveraging various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media.
