title: Global Account Director
description: About Us Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets through automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners specifically within cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audit. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses. We're based in San Francisco, CA, but built as a remote-first company that enables you to do your best work from anywhere. We're backed by top investors including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, DNX Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and more. We value diversity — in backgrounds and in experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide's team is inclusive, driven, humble and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture that we are building, seeking teammates that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth. As an early stage start-up employee, you'll have the opportunity to build out the future of business trust. We make audit practitioners' lives easier by bringing together up to 50% of their work and giving them better work-life balance. If you share our values and enthusiasm for building a great culture and product, you will find a home at Fieldguide. About the Role As a Global Account Director at Fieldguide, you'll own the largest, most complex strategic accounts in our portfolio and be responsible for growing them across every region, subsidiary, and business unit where they operate. This is a deeply focused, white-glove role: rather than managing a portfolio or a territory, you'll go all-in on a small number of accounts (big 4), becoming the internal and external expert on their business, structure, and long-term strategy. You'll run a global, multi-threaded account motion that spans regions, time zones, and stakeholder groups (regional practice leaders to global C-suite executives) while coordinating internally across a wide set of partners to deliver a coherent, unified experience for the account worldwide. Taking a consultative, partner-first approach, you'll guide these organizations through a broader shift in how audit and advisory work gets done globally, positioning Fieldguide as the platform of record across every geography they operate in. This role reports to the Sr. Director of Sales and is fully remote within the U.S. What You'll Do Own 1–3 named global strategic accounts end-to-end, serving as the single point of accountability for their growth and health worldwide. Build and execute a multi-year global account strategy, mapping whitespace across regions, subsidiaries, and business units. Achieve and exceed revenue targets tied to global expansion, not just a single region or entry point. Build deep, trust-based relationships with global and regional decision-makers, understanding how each account's structure, governance, and local nuances shape the path to expansion. Develop and execute account strategy using the MEDDICC methodology, adapted for multi-region, multi-stakeholder deal cycles. Coordinate closely with cross-functional and regional teams — Solutions, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success — to ensure a consistent account experience across every geography. Navigate the added complexity of global deals: multiple procurement and legal processes, regional pricing and currency considerations, data residency requirements, and varying regulatory environments. Present tailored solution walkthroughs to stakeholders across regions, adapting messaging to local market context while maintaining a unified global narrative. Own the creation, ideation, and execution of comprehensive global account plans, shared and aligned with internal leadership. Maintain rigorous CRM diligence, forecasting accuracy, and clear communication with internal stakeholders across all active regions of the account. Represent Fieldguide at global and regional industry events tied to your accounts, deepening relationships and visibility within the account's ecosystem. Up to 30–40% travel, including international travel to support in-region relationships and meetings. About You 10+ years of sales experience, with a track record of owning and growing a small number of large, complex, multinational accounts rather than a broad territory. Proven experience managing global or multi-region account relationships — including navigating different regional stakeholders, procurement processes, and business practices within a single account. Experience working for and/or selling directly to audit, advisory, or assurance firms Strong executive presence and the ability to build trust with senior stakeholders across geographies and cultures. Exceptional project and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to orchestrate long, multithreaded expansion cycles across regions and business units. Demonstrated success driving whitespace expansion within existing accounts, not just net-new logo acquisition. Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy and ownership over a small, high-stakes book of business. Team player who collaborates effectively across internal teams (Solutions, BDRs, Finance, Product, Marketing, Customer Success, etc.) spanning multiple regions. Motivated by depth over breadth — energized by going deep on a handful of accounts rather than managing a large portfolio. Bonus Points: Experience selling internationally or accounts with multinational footprint. More about Fieldguide: Fieldguide is a values-based company. Our values are: Fearless - Inspire & break down seemingly impossible walls. Fast - Launch fast with excellence, iterate to perfection. Lovable - Deliver happiness & 11 star experiences. Owners - Execute & run the business with ownership. Win-win - Create mutual value & earn trust for life. Inclusive - Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams. Some of our benefits include: Competitive compensation packages with meaningful ownership Flexible PTO 401k Wellness benefits starting on your first day Technology & Work from Home reimbursement Flexible work schedules

title: Senior Director, Enterprise Sales

Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients. About The Role As the Senior Director of Enterprise Sales at Dandy you will build and lead an exciting new motion aimed at bringing our world-class dental lab solution to large dental practices (DSOs) and enterprise clients. In this role, you will own the GTM strategy for this motion and be responsible for winning business and building enduring relationships anchored in real value for clients. The Senior Director of Enterprise Sales is responsible for top-down relationship building and selling, and will lead a team of Managers, Account Executives and BDRs who will sell into clients top down and bottom up. This leader will partner cross-functionally with our Post Sales teams (Customer Onboarding/Training, Account Management), Marketing, Product, RevOps, Data, and Technology, to deliver strong value to customers and continue to iterate on solutions that best serve this exciting new segment. This role reports into the Head of Global DSO. Create and refine the enterprise sales playbook, including strategies for top-down selling, multi-location contracting, and deal negotiation for enterprise groups Develop and execute strategic account growth plans that address the unique needs of enterprise clients, navigating complex organizations and building relationships across C-suite executives, regional managers, and practice operators Serve as the primary driver of enterprise deal negotiations, balancing client needs with Dandy’s business objectives to secure enduring, high-value partnerships Collaborate with Post Sales teams to ensure smooth onboarding, effective training, and successful handoffs that drive long-term client success Requirements 10+ years sales experience with at least 5+ years of enterprise sales experience; must use a consultative selling approach and be comfortable navigating through multiple layers of an organization (C-suite, regional managers, individual practice owners) 5+ years prior management experience required 2+ years of second line leadership experience required You have a firm understanding of macro business fundamentals as well as the constraints, challenges and joys of running small businesses. Dandy is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics. Dandy also fully complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We are dedicated to embracing challenges and creating an accessible, inclusive workplace for all individuals. If you require any accommodations for your interview or have any questions beforehand, rest assured that we will do everything we can to meet your needs. Visit Dandy Careers for more! title: Sales Specialist - Data & AI Security - SF Bay

As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands. About the Role: Veeam, following its acquisition of Securiti AI - the leader in AI-powered data security posture management (DSPM) - is seeking experienced Sales Specialists to drive growth in this innovative business. In this role, you will focus exclusively on Securiti AI solutions, working closely with Veeam account executives to cross-sell into Veeam’s customer base, win new business, and expand existing Securiti AI accounts. You’ll have a shared territory with multiple AEs, strong earning potential, and support from a dedicated Securiti AI solution engineer for technical engagements. You’ll also benefit from Veeam’s robust go-to-market resources to ensure customer success. What You’ll Do: Develop and execute a territory plan to drive repeatable revenue within assigned accounts. Collaborate with account executives to identify and maximize cross-sell opportunities for Securiti AI solutions. Lead the entire sales process, serving as a trusted advisor, and presenting compelling business cases to customers. Manage a pipeline of high-value opportunities, ensuring accurate forecasting and CRM discipline. Expand relationships with key channel partners and resellers to accelerate deal flow and market reach. What You’ll Bring: Proven success closing complex enterprise software deals, with 10-15+ years in security software sales. Extensive experience managing multithreaded sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders. Strong existing relationships with C-suite executives and channel partners in large enterprises. Deep understanding of enterprise software sales, particularly in data security, management, or cybersecurity. title: Deal Operations Strategist
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role You'll be the go-to deal desk and pricing expert for ElevenLabs' North American sales team -- the person that the sales team comes to when a deal is complex, competitive, or needs to move fast. You'll own pricing strategy and deal structuring for our most critical customers, partnering with stakeholders to get non-standard terms across the line, and build the processes that make the whole machine run faster. Own the pricing and deal structure for complex enterprise deals, advising sales on commercials and trade-offs in real time to keep things moving toward close. Work closely with engineering to maintain and evolve our Configure Price Quote tool. Translate customer requirements into deal structures that work commercially and operationally, knowing where to flex and where to hold firm. Own the path through internal complexity, aligning Finance, Legal, Product, and leadership so deals don't stall on process. Partner with Finance to build deal-level P&L models and communicate pricing trends back to the business, informing strategic pricing decisions at the leadership level Develop and maintain pricing frameworks, discount guardrails, and approval policies that scale with the business. Build the analytics and feedback loops that surface where deals are slowing down and why — and fix it. Requirements Hands‑on experience configuring and maintaining CPQ rulesets, price books, and approval workflows. Experience in finance or deal pricing at a company, or experience within investment banking or management consulting Excellent financial modeling, verbal, and written communication skills Proven track record of process optimizations or automation. Ability to make value judgements that balance business, financial, and legal priorities. Bonus: Knowledge of AI/ML industry pricing models and competitive landscape Experience scaling deal desk processes in a high-growth environment Location This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: COO
description: About Airtm Airtm is building the global stablecoin wallet for digital entrepreneurs, the place where people receive earnings, hold balances, convert value, and cash out across 40+ markets. Our mission: give the world's digital entrepreneurs, especially in the Global South, the financial freedom to thrive. Today we serve 150K+ active users and process $1.5B+ in annual payments, and our enterprise partners rely on our rails to pay contractors across LATAM and Africa. The role in one sentence You'll run the operating engine of Airtm organizational accountability, operating cadence and cross-functional execution. Making sure all teams are delivering on their objectives and executing on CEO’S vision and strategy so that money moves reliably across 40+ markets while the CEO focuses on product, capital, and growth. Working with Rubén You'll partner with a founder-CEO who has spent a decade obsessed with one mission: giving digital entrepreneurs in the Global South real financial freedom. He brings vision, product intuition, and conviction; you bring the machine that turns conviction into money moving reliably. If you've thrived as the operational counterweight to a visionary founder, and can push back with data when it matters, this partnership will work. What this isn't This isn't the CEO's right hand or an extended chief of staff. Board materials, fundraising, investor relations, and internal communications belong to the CEO and Finance. You'll be measured on how well the operation runs, not on how well the CEO's week runs. This isn't a coordinate-other-people's-roadmaps role. You'll own outcomes, payout success rates, operational cost-to-serve, time-to-launch in new markets. This isn't an empire-building role, at least not on day one. Airtm already has a VP of Finance owning FP&A, treasury, and pricing & revenue , a compliance team with a BSA Officer, and VASP/AML specialists, and a Data & Analytics and Marketplace team that reports to Product. You'll partner tightly with all of them, and as the operating model matures, parts of the org may consolidate under you, but that's earned, not promised. This isn't a "professionalize a mature company" job, nor a pure back-office role. Airtm operates in volatile, fragmented markets where operations is the product: cash-out speed, reliability, and trust are why users and enterprises choose us. If you need stable processes and predictable quarters, this will frustrate you. What you'll own The operating cadence: company-wide goals, the OKR cycle from annual objectives to team-level key results, and the rhythm of the business, making sure every team knows the number they own and what's in the way. Cross-functional execution: you're the connective tissue between Product (including Marketplace), Pricing & Revenue, Finance, and Compliance, turning their models, targets, and regulatory requirements into operational reality on the ground. Payments operations: payout success rates, corridor reliability, banking and on/off-ramp partner performance, and incident response when money doesn't move the way it should , working hand-in-hand with Finance, who owns treasury and liquidity. Risk & compliance operations: our compliance team owns the regulatory frameworks, BSA, VASP licensing, AML programs, audits. You own making the business run inside those frameworks at speed: fraud operations, market entries and exits without regulatory surprises, and compliance requirements that become workable processes rather than bottlenecks. Customer & enterprise operations: support quality and cost, SLAs for enterprise payout partners, and the onboarding machine that turns a signed contract into money moving in days, not weeks. The profile / Qualifications 10+ years in operations leadership, with at least 5 in fintech, payments, or crypto, ideally where you owned money movement, not just process. You've operated in emerging markets (LATAM strongly preferred) and understand the reality of fragmented banking, currency volatility, and informal economies, not just the pitch-deck version. Fluent in the compliance realities of money movement, MSB/VASP frameworks, AML programs, regulator and banking-partner relationships, enough to be a strong partner (or manager) to a compliance leader, even if you've never been one yourself. You've scaled an operation through a step-change in volume (e.g., 3–10x) and can talk concretely about what broke and what you rebuilt. Strong peer to finance and revenue leaders: fluent in data and unit economics, but secure enough to let others own the model while you own the execution. Spanish and English fluency; comfort working across LATAM. Bonus: hands-on experience with stablecoins/USDC rails or two-sided liquidity problems. Compensation Additional Information

client's business objectives, industry context, and success measures, and communicate progress and impact through regular business reviews Manage escalations with urgency and professionalism to maintain client trust Onboarding, Adoption & Account Health Lead onboarding and implementation with customized guidance and strategic alignment to ensure a strong start Monitor account health using Lead cross-functionally. Align CAD Engineering, ML, UX Design, and Manufacturing so that what the doctor sees on screen is exactly what gets produced. Ground decisions in evidence. Run customer discovery, market research, and competitive analysis to shape the roadmap and surface new opportunities. Ship into a real operation. Manage the full lifecycle from idea through launch and iteration, knowing that every release lands in a live lab with real technicians, real production schedules, and real cases in flight. You'll plan rollouts, train teams, and adapt quickly when the physical world pushes back. Measure and refine. Combine quantitative data with qualitative insight to assess impact, communicate results, and adjust course. title: Technical Support Engineer
description: About Kustomer Kustomer is the AI-native customer experience platform that turns every interaction into a lasting relationship and a measurable business outcome. By unifying customer data, conversations and AI-native workflows into a single connected timeline, Kustomer helps teams cultivate customers, not tickets, resolving issues faster and delivering more personalized service across every channel. Today, Kustomer is the core platform for leading customer service brands like Sweetgreen, Starz, Vuori, Goldbelly and Cotopaxi. Founded in 2015 by serial entrepreneurs Brad Birnbaum and Jeremy Suriel, Kustomer raised nearly $200M in funding culminating in a Series E before being acquired by Meta in a deal that closed in 2022. In 2023, Kustomer's founders and original investors, Battery, Redpoint, and Boldstart Ventures, spun the company back out with a $60M investment as an independent, privately held business ready to focus more deeply on AI. In 2025, Norwest led our Series B, bringing our total funding to $90M. This momentum allowed Kustomer to double down on AI-native innovation and build a sharper roadmap for the future of customer experience. Our Krew is a remote-friendly team spread across the U.S. with hubs in NYC and London. We gather in person each year at our annual Kustomer Kick-Off event and always look for Krew members who are curious, collaborative, and ready to shape the future of Customer Experience. About the Role Kustomer’s AI agent resolves routine questions, and our support partners handle the next layer of straightforward requests. This role handles what’s left: complex, ambiguous technical issues across webhooks, APIs, workflows, integrations, and AI agent behavior. You’ll be the final escalation point before Engineering. You’ll also make Tier 1 and 2 stronger by turning each hard case into a runbook, a fix, or a product improvement. You’ll be responsible for: Owning technical issues end to end, from reproduction through root cause and resolution, within defined SLAs Diagnosing failures in webhooks, REST API integrations, workflows, and automations using logs, payloads, and developer tools Troubleshooting AI agent behavior, such as misrouted or incorrect resolutions, knowledge gaps, and failed actions or integrations, and recommending configuration or knowledge fixes Escalating to Engineering with clear reproduction steps, evidence, and impact, and following through to resolution Identifying recurring issue patterns and partnering with Product and Engineering on fixes, tooling, and self-service improvements Writing runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and escalation playbooks for our AI agent and BPO partners Coaching and enabling Tier 1/2 and BPO team members on technical investigation Providing technical communication during critical incidents and for premier support accounts Joining the on-call rotation for critical events and premier support customers Handling sensitive customer data appropriately Required qualifications: 4+ years experience in technical support, developer support, or support engineering at a B2B SaaS company, including Tier 2/3 or escalation experience Hands-on experience debugging webhooks, REST APIs, and authentication, covering retries, rate limits, payload and schema issues, and idempotency Working proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and JSON, and comfort reading and writing API requests (Postman, curl, browser dev tools) Experience with workflow or automation platforms, such as rules engines, workflow builders, or iPaaS tools (Zapier, Workato) Strong written and verbal communication, including with developers and technical admins, and with Engineering during incidents Sound judgment on prioritization, severity, and when to escalate Strongly preferred: Experience supporting or configuring AI agents or LLM-based products (prompting, knowledge sources, actions and tools, evaluating outputs) Experience with logging and monitoring tools (Datadog, Sentry, Kibana) and basic SQL or Python for data investigation Experience with CRM or CX platforms (Kustomer, Zendesk, Salesforce, Shopify) and their integrations A track record of building tooling or automation that reduced ticket volume HIPAA Compliance All roles at Kustomer may involve handling sensitive personal data. Benefits Kustomer offers an array of benefits including competitive salaries and stock options. In the U.S. we offer 100% healthcare coverage, 401K, WiFi and Mobile reimbursement, and a generous vacation policy; in the UK we also offer pension, supplemental health insurance and other perks. Diversity & Inclusion at Kustomer Kustomer is committed to bringing together individuals from different backgrounds and perspectives. We strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, feel a sense of belonging, and do great work together.We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer open to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, Veteran status, or any other legally protected status. Candidate Privacy Notice As a job applicant, you have the right to know and understand the categories of personal information we collect about you, and the purposes for which we use such personal information. Disclaimer: Kustomer only contacts candidates from company email addresses ending in kustomer.com and does not seek funds from candidates in any circumstances.

title: Director Global Events - Program Management
description: About Kaseya Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success. Backed by Insight Partners , a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide. Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe. We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in. At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. The Director of Program Management, Global Events will lead the program management function within Kaseya's Global Events organization. This role owns how Kaseya's global event portfolio is planned, governed, resourced, and measured, turning strategy into an integrated, predictable, and scalable operating model across every region and event type. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Global Events, this leader will oversee the end-to-end program management of Kaseya's flagship conferences, regional events, executive experiences, customer and partner programs, sales kickoffs. The role leads a team of event program managers, sets the standards and tools they use, and connects Events with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, Finance, and Leadership, ensuring every program is delivered on time, on budget, and with measurable business impact. Key Responsibilities Portfolio Strategy & Planning Partner with the VP of Global Events to translate the global event strategy into an integrated annual and multi-year portfolio plan. Own the global events calendar, balancing business priorities, regional needs, budget, and team capacity. Lead event intake, business case review, and prioritization, ensuring every investment is tied to clear objectives such as pipeline, customer retention, and brand. Run portfolio planning and business reviews with senior stakeholders, recommending where to invest, scale, consolidate, or retire programs. Program Governance & Operating Model Build and lead the Events Program Management team, defining the frameworks, phase gates, and decision rights used to deliver every event. Create standardized playbooks, templates, timelines, RACI models, and run-of-show standards that scale across event types and regions. Establish a consistent planning cadence, including status reporting, risk reviews, and executive checkpoints, that gives leadership clear visibility across the portfolio. Drive continuous improvement through post-event retrospectives, lessons learned, and process optimization. Cross-Functional Program Leadership Lead complex, multi-workstream programs such as flagship conferences and global sales kickoffs, coordinating content, registration, marketing, sales, production, logistics, and executive involvement. Align stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, Product Marketing, Product, Finance, Legal, and regional teams on scope, timelines, and success criteria. Manage dependencies, critical paths, and scope changes across concurrent programs, escalating and resolving issues quickly. Serve as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, providing clear recommendations and tradeoffs. Budget, Resource & Vendor Management Own consolidated financial management for the global events portfolio, including multimillion-dollar budgeting, multi-currency forecasting, and variance reporting. Lead resource and capacity planning across the program management team, agencies, and freelance partners. Drive global sourcing strategy and lead negotiations with venues, agencies, production partners, and suppliers, using portfolio scale to improve value. Establish vendor performance standards, service levels, and scorecards to ensure exceptional delivery. Systems, Data & Reporting Own the events technology and tooling roadmap, including project management, registration, event platforms, and their integration with CRM and marketing automation. Define and track portfolio KPIs includes budget adherence, attendee satisfaction, pipeline contribution, revenue influence, and event ROI. Deliver executive dashboards and portfolio reporting with actionable recommendations. Use data and insights to improve planning accuracy, operational efficiency, and business outcomes. Team Leadership & Development Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing global team of event program managers. Define roles, career paths, and competency standards for event program management. Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and operational discipline. Develop talent through coaching, mentorship, succession planning, and professional development. Required Qualifications 10+ years of experience in event program management, event operations, or a related program management role, including 5+ years leading teams. 10+ Proven success managing a global portfolio of large-scale conferences, customer and partner events, executive programs, sales kickoffs, and trade shows across multiple regions. 10+ Demonstrated experience building or leading a PMO, or establishing program governance, standardized processes, and scalable operating models. 5+ Experience owning multimillion-dollar budgets, multi-currency forecasting, contract negotiations, and vendor partnerships. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Event Management, or a related field. Experience within technology, cybersecurity, IT services, or high-growth organizations. Advanced proficiency with project and portfolio management tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Asana, Monday.com, Jira), event management platforms (e.g., Cvent), and CRM and marketing automation systems (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo, HubSpot). Strong knowledge of international event logistics, risk management, and compliance requirements. Exceptional program management skills, including planning, prioritization, dependency management, and risk mitigation across concurrent programs. Strong executive presence and the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels, often without direct authority. Experience leading distributed teams in fast-paced, growth-oriented environments. Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required Additional information Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Senior Solutions Architect - East Enterprise team
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><div><strong>Overview:</strong><br>As a Senior Solutions Architect on GitLab’s AMER East Enterprise team, you’ll be a trusted advisor to large, complex organizations in the region. You’ll show how GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform meets both technical requirements and business objectives across the software development lifecycle, from planning through monitoring. You’ll guide enterprises through their digital transformation journeys, bringing deep technical expertise, strong customer empathy, and the credibility to engage everyone from practitioners to executives.<br><br>Reporting to a regional Solutions Architect Manager and partnering closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams, you'll own technical evaluations, including proofs of value and workshops, shape solution architectures, and serve as the voice of the customer back to Product Management. You'll focus on driving successful platform adoption, influencing revenue growth through solution selling, and building long-term, trust-based relationships that showcase GitLab's differentiated position in an AI-driven DevSecOps landscape.<br><br><strong>What you'll do:</strong></div> <ul> <li>Own the technical strategy for your assigned enterprise accounts, from discovery through adoption, and solve customer issues of broad scope and high complexity.</li> <li>Drive the technical evaluation process as the directly responsible individual, including solution design, proof of concept or proof of value ownership, workshop design, and the technical components of tenders, audits, and value stream assessments.</li> <li>Lead competitive analysis and positioning on complex opportunities in the region, articulating GitLab’s differentiated value in an AI-driven DevSecOps landscape.</li> <li>Partner with Account Executives and regional sales teams across AMER East Enterprise to shape and execute account strategies. Contribute technical insight to account and territory planning, and coach sales colleagues on deal qualification.</li> <li>Build deep relationships with technical practitioners and business leaders across multiple teams and levels of the customer organization, and help them become GitLab advocates.</li> <li>Advise customers on modern software development, CI/CD, security, and cloud practices, challenging existing approaches to improve return on investment.</li> <li>Serve as the voice of the customer with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing by sharing feedback, use cases, and competitive insights that inform roadmap and positioning.</li> <li>Maintain and extend your technical expertise in GitLab, DevSecOps, AI, and related cloud technologies, creating reusable examples, best practice guidance, and technical collateral for customers and partners.</li> <li>Invest in your own growth and development through ongoing learning, mentorship, and knowledge sharing to continuously improve the impact of the Solutions Architect team.</li> <li>Mentor Solutions Architects and contribute to team learning and SA organizational initiatives.</li> <li>Bring fresh ideas to customer calls and demos based on current market trends, and create reusable examples and technical collateral for customers and partners.</li> </ul> <div><br><br><strong>What you'll bring</strong></div> <ul> <li>Experience engaging with customers in technical pre-sales, consulting, or similar roles, guiding them through solution design and evaluation.</li> <li>Proficiency with the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and continuous integration and continuous deployment workflows.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with GitLab or comparable source control, continuous integration and continuous deployment, and collaboration platforms, and the ability to map platform capabilities to customer use cases.</li> <li>Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, with the ability to discuss deployment, security, and operations options with technical teams.</li> <li>Ability to lead technical evaluations such as proofs of concept or proofs of value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.</li> <li>Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt messages for practitioners through to senior business and technical decision makers.</li> <li>Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, and acting as a customer advocate to internal teams such as Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.</li> <li>Motivation to continuously develop professionally, including learning new technologies, deepening GitLab platform expertise, and applying transferable experience from related fields.</li> <li>Ability to travel as needed, in line with GitLab’s travel policy.</li> </ul> <div><br><br><strong>About the team</strong><br>The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab’s Sales organization and is the technical counterpart to Account Executives. This role focuses on enterprise opportunities across AMER East and reports to a regional Solutions Architect Manager. We help customers realize the full value of GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform by advising on architecture, running technical evaluations such as proofs of value, and guiding digital transformation. We work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing, collaborating asynchronously across regions to share best practices, build reusable technical collateral, and act as the voice of the customer. We’re focused on helping customers modernize end-to-end software delivery, adopt GitLab at scale, and navigate a fast-changing AI and DevSecOps landscape.</div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. Team First — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency. Why Join Us? Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. Responsibilities Open and lead the German market: build pipeline from scratch and close our first German customers, focused on mid-size and larger manufacturing, logistics and wholesale companies Own the German number: set targets with the founding team and be accountable for pipeline and revenue in Germany Own the full sales cycle: from first contact to signed contract, including C-level conversations and complex, multi-stakeholder deals Build the German playbook: ICP, German-language messaging, channels and partners Lead the pod: coach the Go-To-Market Associate on pipeline and work with the Forward Deployed Engineer on first deliveries Represent Lleverage: with German customers, partners and at industry events Work directly with the founding team: on strategy, targets, approach and customer feedback Bring insights: from German customers back into product development What we’re looking for Around 10 years of B2B sales experience, with a strong track record of closing complex deals and hitting targets You have opened a market or built a sales territory from scratch before, and you have taken ownership of a number A senior seller who still loves running deals yourself and is ready to lead a small team as it grows, not a sales executive who manages from a distance You're an excellent relationship builder. You understand that the best outcomes come from genuinely understanding someone's pain, not pitching a product. You listen well and use data to shape your priorities. You're energised by ambiguity. A new market with no playbook excites you rather than stops you. Native-level German and fluent English Based in Germany, or in the Netherlands Nice to haves A network in the German Mittelstand. Experience in B2B sales, partnerships, or business development. Background in SaaS, AI, or Consultancy. Networks in manufacturing, wholesale, distribution or the PE industry. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. You will lead efforts to design, position, and close outcome-oriented professional services engagements that translate complex DevSecOps and digital transformation initiatives into clear, measurable mission-critical outcomes. </p> <p>Reporting to the Senior Manager of Engagement Management, EMEA, you will work at the intersection of technical solutioning and customer requirements, aligning each engagement to their unique needs and objectives.  In your first year, you will build trusted advisor relationships with technical leaders and partners to help integrate professional services into account strategies from early discovery through successful delivery. This is a unique opportunity to shape large-scale implementations that improve how customers plan, build, secure, and operate software using GitLab.</p> <h2><strong>Some examples of our implementation roadmapping, enterprise strategy discussions, and executive-level requirements gathering</li> <li>Drive measurable outcomes by structuring services that support customer success metrics, accurately forecasting services bookings, and tracking key performance indicators related to bookings, margin, and attachment to strategic opportunities.</li> <li>Own the engagement lifecycle outcome-oriented.</li> <li>Influence cross-functional teams by articulating GitLab’s professional services value proposition in the context of federal requirements and compliance frameworks, and by feeding customer insights back into sales, delivery, and practice management.</li> <li>Partner with regional sales and engagement leadership to prioritize and manage services opportunities that support critical deals and strategic initiatives, providing clear recommendations on risk management, negotiation strategies, and commercial structures.</li> <li>Foster a culture of enablement and continuous improvement by training field teams on how to position and sell professional services by sharing trends, feedback, and suggestions that improve go-to-market content and operational processes.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Demonstrated progressive experience structuring, scoping, and selling professional services engagements in the region</li> implementation projects.</li> <li>Solid understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), DevOps practices, and cloud transformation initiatives, with the ability to connect technical solutions to mission objectives and measurable business outcomes.</li> <li>Effective communication and interpersonal skills with executive presence, able to build trusted advisor relationships with division chiefs, program managers, contracting stakeholders, and senior technical leaders.</li> <li>Highly developed facilitation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to guide customers through acquisition processes, commercial structures, and risk mitigation strategies.</li> <li>Comfort working cross-functionally with sales, solutions architecture, delivery, and operations teams to align on deal strategy, staffing, and successful execution in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Capacity to work autonomously and asynchronously in a fully remote setting, managing multiple complex opportunities while maintaining accurate forecasting and consistent alignment with GitLab values and goals.</li> </ul> <p>The Professional Services Engagement Management team at GitLab is dedicated to designing and structuring services engagements that set our customers up for successful, long-term adoption of our DevSecOps platform. title: Founding Engineer (Remote or Hybrid - EEA/UK)
description: Founding Engineer Role can be based remotely in the EEA or hybrid in our London or Munich offices. Fixed software is the wrong shape for logistics, because every team runs its processes differently. Tare is our solution. Combining agentic AI with deterministic logic means Tare fits to any customer but runs the same way every single time. We have just closed our pre-seed funding round with a top European VC and we are now looking for a founding engineer to build Tare with us. About Tarebase We're Dom and Felix, the two co-founders of Tarebase. Dom is a former SVP at a global unicorn, overseeing tens of millions in global carrier spend, with deep logistics domain experience from Amazon, Nestle and EY. Felix was a founding engineer at Raycast and has spent more than two decades building software systems. We've raised pre-seed funding from a top-tier European VC and are building our MVP together with early design partners, who will become our first customers. As our first employee, you'd have a real say in both the product and the engineering decisions behind it. Logistics is difficult to run well, and experienced people are hard to hire. Smaller businesses often pay too much for shipping, struggle to give customers a good delivery experience, and can't match larger competitors' technology or hiring budgets. The software available to them is often expensive, dated or too cumbersome. We want to make logistics less of a burden so these businesses can spend more time selling their products.They're the customers we want to build for: Europe alone has around 26 million SMEs, employing more than 100 million people. Just putting a chat interface and GPT-wrapper on top of the problem is not what we're building. We're combining extraction and analysis, workflow automation, agentic and compiled AI with deterministic, verifiable logic. Recent advances in AI make more of this possible, but building a system that does it reliably is still hard. We're looking for someone who wants to advance the state of the art in this area with us. About you The description below is an ideal, not a checklist. If you don't tick every box but feel ready for the challenges of being the first engineer at an early-stage startup, we'd still like to hear from you. What matters most to us is that you're motivated, committed, willing to stick with hard problems, and someone we can count on. You have a strong technical background and a track record of building and shipping software systems, whether that's cloud backends, web applications, AI-supported systems or a mix of these. You enjoy working across engineering and product. You think like a product engineer: you care about UX/UI, and you want direct contact with customers and the people who use what you build. You'll work mostly in Rust and TypeScript, across the full stack: data engineering, AI, backend, frontend, infrastructure and deployment. We especially value experience with either language from before AI coding tools and a solid understanding of its ecosystem so you can make considered choices. We also value experience operating distributed systems and data-intensive systems in the cloud, including multi-tenant environments and the scaling and security challenges they bring, databases, and durable execution runtimes. You use coding agents effectively, but stay close to the code. You know their limitations in a large codebase, review and challenge their work, and take testing, debugging, refactoring and documentation seriously. You can design useful tests and evaluations, manage complexity, and tell when something is genuinely ready to ship. You also enjoy digging into challenging problems. You keep up with what current models, agent harnesses and research make possible, and you can judge what actually works for a given use case. You know how to build agents and AI workflows into a product and use evaluations, validation and deterministic logic to make what they produce consistent and verifiable. You're comfortable extracting structure from messy documents and care a lot about data quality. You experiment, measure the results, question your assumptions, and keep going until you've found a solution that really holds up. You can turn that work into shipped software, taking a product idea or technical direction through design and implementation without waiting for someone to assign you a ticket. We work remotely, so clear communication and follow-through matter a lot to us. We value people who manage their own work, can be counted on, and raise important issues early. How to apply Apply with the button on this page. Please ensure to use a hand-written CV. We read every application ourselves. It's fine to use tools for spelling or translation, but we want to hear your voice. Our process The process should take a few weeks from start to finish depending on your availability. Application review. If we love your resume we will send over some short questions. Intro call with Dom and Felix. An informal conversation about the role, the technology and what you're looking for. Technical deep dive with Felix. We talk briefly about a system you’ve worked on (no need to share anything confidential), then work through a system design problem together. Half a day with us in Munich or London. We cover your travel, hotel if needed, and meals. You spend about two hours on a made-up task similar to the problems we work on, using your usual tools and coding agents. Then we have lunch, go through your work together, and talk through a customer scenario. References and offer. We speak with 1-2 people you've worked with (only with your agreement) and aim to decide within 48 hours. If we don't move forward after the technical conversation or later, we'll share some feedback with you. Compensation : €100.000–120.000 base salary plus 0.75–1% equity Setup: A MacBook Pro and whatever else you need to work well. If you'd rather not work from home, we'll pay for a coworking space near you. Location : Munich or London, or remote within Europe (GMT-1 to GMT+3) with regular meet-ups. Candidate privacy policy available here: https://tarebase.com/candidate-privacy Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: FTTH Security Expert
description: About P1 Security Founded in 2011 by serial entrepreneur and security expert Philippe Langlois, P1 Security is on a mission to secure critical and sovereign mobile networks by providing services and technologies to identify, detect and recover from critical threats and vulnerabilities. P1 Security is one of the very few companies in the world tackling telecom security through pure Mobile and Telecom Security attacks and security from 5G and Cloud-based infrastructure Security , OpenRAN, Network Slicing and RAN Sharing, Edge Computing (MEC), down to legacy 2/3/4G Diameter, SS7 SIGTRAN attacks, GTP manipulation and fuzzing. Our offering and expertise range from Network and Telecom Core Network Security, Intrusion Detection and Vulnerability Assessment solutions, with technology backed by more than a decade of engineering research. We are a lean scale-up, engaged in emerging markets (Eastern Europe, Middle East, Asia), Europe and North America. The P1 Security team includes experts from telecom operators and security companies as well as renowned security researchers who regularly present unique P1 Security research at leading international security conferences & GSMA working groups. P1 Labs, the R&D branch of P1 Security, shares Open Source initiatives with the telecom security community (www.github.com/P1sec/). We are growing the team with people who want to help write it. We are looking for experienced profiles with grounded, hands-on knowledge of telecom networks — and a real appetite for FTTx technologies in particular. Curious, creative and open-minded people who want to dig deep into a genuinely sovereign topic: the security of the mobile networks our connectivity runs on. Job Description If your years have been spent in FTTx — access networks, PON, CPE, provisioning, field operations — and security has always been the question you kept coming back to, talk to us. The role described below does not really exist as a box to tick yet: we care far more about the person than about an exact match with a job title. Bring the part of the picture you know best, and we will build the rest together. What you will do Audits — you will plan and run scoped, authorized penetration tests of FTTH/PON infrastructure: OLTs, ONTs/ONUs, the management systems around the ODN, and customer premises equipment. PON internals — you will dig into GPON, XG-PON, XGS-PON and NG-PON2: OMCI, PLOAM, and how ONTs are authenticated and provisioned. CPE and gateways — you will take them apart: firmware extraction and reverse engineering, exposed debug interfaces (UART/JTAG), hardcoded credentials, update mechanisms and web/CLI management flaws. Subscribers at scale — you will look at what provisions and manages them (TR-069/CWMP, TR-369/USP, ACS/OSS/BSS integrations, zero-touch provisioning) and at the subscriber-facing edge: BNG/BRAS, PPPoE/IPoE, DHCP, RADIUS/AAA, VLAN segmentation, QoS and isolation between subscribers. Convergence and infrastructure — you will follow fixed–mobile convergence (5G FWA, shared core, shared OSS/BSS, unified identity and billing) and review devices and management planes (routers, switches, aggregation equipment, NMS/EMS, SNMP, NETCONF/YANG, SSH/Telnet, APIs, privileged access) against vendor and industry hardening baselines. Threat modeling — you will map attack paths for real operator environments using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, the GSMA FASG/FS.xx guidance and the MITRE FiGHT knowledge base. Findings and clients — you will turn all of this into clear, prioritized reports with proof-of-concept evidence, risk ratings and actionable remediation, present them to stakeholders, and support remediation verification and retesting. The team — you will contribute to our internal tooling, test methodologies, lab environments and reusable attack playbooks. Preferred Qualifications Deep knowledge on Fixed-line network architecture (FTTx, DSL, Coaxial) MANDATORY: Experience in security audit pentests on OT and IT infrastructure Experience with vendor ecosystems such as Huawei, ZTE, Nokia, Ericsson, Calix, or Adtran FTTH equipment. Familiarity with telecom security standards and frameworks: 3GPP SCAS, GSMA NESAS, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, and ITU-T/BBF specifications. Experience in red teaming or adversary emulation against critical infrastructure. Relevant certifications, such as: OSCP / OSEP / OSWE / OSED GPEN / GXPN / GRID CEH (Practical), eJPT/eCPPT, or CRTO Telecom-specific training (GSMA, Black Hat/DEF CON telecom or hardware trainings) Published research, CVEs, conference talks, or bug bounty history in telecom or embedded devices. If you have a passion for telecom security and want to be part of a dynamic and innovative team, we encourage you to apply and join us in shaping the future of Telecom Security! Language requirements English - fluent speaker French - optional Further details 🏢 Headquarters : Fully remote company, with headquarters in Paris - FRANCE 🏠 Remote policy: At P1 Security, we recognize the importance of work-life balance, and that's why our remote policy is a key part of our company culture. We understand that flexibility is crucial, allowing our team members to work remotely while achieving their personal and professional goals. To keep our team connected, we schedule monthly meetups with department members and gather the entire team on-site every two months. These regular touch points ensure effective communication, collaboration, and a dynamic team spirit, reflecting the dynamic and adaptable spirit of P1 Security. We believe in the power of flexible work arrangements to bring out the best in our team, driving success in a way that suits everyone's unique lifestyle Hiring process First contact call (10-20min) Direct manager call (30min) Capability assessment exercice (depending on position) C-level & Director call (30 min) Specialisations Telecommunications Security, SS7, SIGTRAN, LTE, IMS, UMTS, CDMA, GPRS, OpenStack, Kubernetes, LinuxServers / PNF, Diameter, NFV, Security, VoLTE, VoWifi, GTP, Diameter, 3G, 4G, IoT Security, NFV(i), S1AP, X2AP, Fuzzing, eUTRAN S1AP, X2AP, NgRAN, NGAP, PFCP, 5GC SBI Contact If you are a motivated and experienced professional who is passionate about cybersecurity and driving innovation, we would love to hear from you! Join P1 Security and be part of a fascinating mission to protect critical infrastructure and work alongside industry experts in the cybersecurity field. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a <strong>Senior Manager, Customer Success Architects</strong>, you will lead a distributed Asia Pacific team of Customer Success Architects and Customer Success Managers that help customers realize value from GitLab through strong adoption, measurable outcomes, and trusted partnership.</p> <p>You will partner closely with both executive sponsors and day-to-day end users/practitioners to drive adoption and measurable outcomes.</p> <p>Reporting to the <strong>Sr</strong> <strong>Director of Customer Experience, APJ</strong>, you will coach Customer Success Managers & Customer Success Architects to adoption and manage customer relationships across onboarding, adoption, business reviews, and renewals.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge</strong> of software development lifecycle practices, related tools, and agile or DevOps ways of working.</li> <li><strong>Familiarity</strong> with cloud or container technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker, application security concepts such as static application security testing (SAST) and dynamic application security testing (DAST), or cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Microsoft Azure.</li> <li><strong>Skill</strong> in translating strategy into clear initiatives, coordinating execution, and tracking delivery across competing priorities.</li> <li><strong>Capability</strong> to lead distributed teams across regions, cultures, and lines of business, while working effectively with senior executives and external stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Willingness</strong> to travel <li><strong>Warmth and care</strong> in your leadership approach—able to coach with empathy and build trust on a human level.</li> <li><strong>Interest</strong> in candidates with transferable experience who can connect technical concepts to business value and collaborate well across functions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>On the <strong>Customer Success Management</strong> team, we are accountable for success bookings, customer adoption, measurable outcomes, customer satisfaction, and building customer advocacy across GitLab.</p> <p>We also act as a key connection point between customers and the broader GitLab ecosystem, helping streamline collaboration with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Professional Services, and other partners.</p> <p>In this role, you will manage a team in <strong>Asia Pacific</strong> while collaborating asynchronously with stakeholders across regions, with a focus on helping customers succeed at scale and improving how the organization supports them.</p> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a title: Senior Manager, Global Benefits
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://www.dataiku.com/?utm_source=newswire&utm_medium=press-release&utm_campaign=PlatformforAISuccess" target="_blank">Dataiku</a> is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.<br><br>The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku <a href="https://blog.dataiku.com/?_gl=1*17edvf4*_ga*MjA1Mjk5NzY4OC4xNjY3MjMyMDUz*_ga_B3YXRYMY48*MTY2OTA1MDY5NS4xMi4xLjE2NjkwNTA2OTguNTcuMC4w" target="_blank">blog</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/dataiku/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://x.com/dataiku" target="_blank">X</a>, and <a href="https://www.youtube.com/dataiku" target="_blank">YouTube</a>.</p></div><h1><strong>Senior Manager, Global Benefits</strong></h1> <p>We’re ~1,300 builders across 18 countries. We share context openly, work across functions and borders, question defaults, and own our outcomes. Our People team runs on Dataiku too, with AI agents and automated workflows.</p> <h2><strong>The role</strong></h2> <p><strong>Location:</strong> EMEA - Remote · <strong>Reports to:</strong> Global Total Rewards Lead</p> <p>You’ll own Dataiku’s global benefits programs across all countries where we operate. The goal: benefits that help us win AI talent, feel consistent and fair wherever people work, meet local requirements, and stay financially sustainable.</p> <p>Our People function is lean and decentralized. You’ll set benefits strategy with the Global Total Rewards Lead, partner directly with Finance, Legal, Payroll and our brokers, lead day-to-day benefits operations, and have real autonomy. This is a builder role: you’ll challenge how benefits work today and use AI to make them simpler to run and easier for employees to use.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>        <strong>Shape the strategy.</strong> Define and evolve our global benefits philosophy with the Global Total Rewards Lead, balancing market competitiveness, consistency across countries and cost discipline.</li> <li>        <strong>Own the global portfolio.</strong> Design and manage health, retirement, insurance, leave and wellbeing programs across our entities and EOR countries, setting a clear global floor with smart local variation.</li> <li>        <strong>Run renewals and vendors.</strong> Lead annual renewals, broker and carrier relationships, and RFPs. Negotiate on data, not habit, and hold vendors to clear service levels.</li> <li>        <strong>Keep us compliant.</strong> Make sure plans meet local rules in every country. You’ll own US compliance directly (ERISA, ACA, COBRA, nondiscrimination testing, Form 5500) as well as statutory and collective-agreement obligations in Europe and beyond.</li> <li>        <strong>Manage cost.</strong> Own the global benefits budget and forecasts with Finance. Model plan changes, track claims and utilization trends, and bring clear trade-offs to decision-makers.</li> <li>        <strong>Lead benefits operations.</strong> Lead the team that runs enrollment, life events, leaves, payroll and HRIS integrations, and EOR coordination. Build processes that scale without adding headcount.</li> <li>        <strong>Use AI to reinvent the experience.</strong> Automate enrollment, eligibility checks, reconciliations and employee questions with AI agents and workflows. Make it easy for employees to understand and use what we offer.</li> <li>        <strong>Support growth and change.</strong> Set up benefits for new countries, entity conversions from EOR, and acquisitions, with clean harmonization plans.</li> <li>        <strong>Communicate clearly.</strong> Build benefits guides, open-enrollment campaigns and manager resources that people actually read.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></h2> <ul> <li>        Extensive global benefits experience in a global, high-growth tech or enterprise software company.</li> <li>        Deep expertise in benefits design, renewals, vendor/broker management and benchmarking across multiple countries.</li> <li>        Strong, hands-on US benefits compliance experience, plus experience with European programs and statutory requirements, including UK and French benefits and pensions.</li> <li>        Experience managing benefits through both owned entities and Employer of Record providers (e.g. Deel, Remote).</li> <li>        A track record of building or transforming benefits programs, not just administering them.</li> <li>        Experience leading a team and influencing senior stakeholders in lean, fast-moving environments.</li> <li>        Strong analytical skills for cost modeling and claims analysis, and real curiosity for AI and automation (Workday a plus).</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why join us</strong></h2> <ul> <li>        <strong>Real impact:</strong> shape benefits for a global AI company helping the world’s largest enterprises make AI work.</li> <li>        <strong>Ownership:</strong> the autonomy to build, with direct access to Total Rewards, Finance and People leadership.</li> <li>        <strong>Growth:</strong> help reinvent how People programs are delivered, with AI-powered workflows.</li> </ul> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-Remote #LI-FR1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> </div> <div><strong>What are you waiting for!</strong></div> <div>At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! And if you’d like to learn even more about working here, you can visit our <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/dataiku/">Dataiku LinkedIn page</a>.</div> <div> </div> <div><em>Our practices are rooted in the idea that everyone should be treated with dignity, decency and fairness. Dataiku also believes that a diverse identity is a source of strength and allows us to optimize across the many dimensions that are needed for our success. Therefore, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All employment practices are based on business needs, without regard to race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. This applies to all policies and procedures related to recruitment and hiring, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion and termination and all other conditions and terms of employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact us at: </em><a class="postings-link" ---------- <div> </div> <div><hr></div> <div> <div> </div> <div><strong>Protect yourself from fraudulent recruitment activity</strong></div> <div><em>Dataiku will never ask you for payment of any type during the interview or hiring process. If you experience something out of the ordinary or suspect fraudulent activity, please review our page on identifying and reporting fraudulent activity <a href="https://www.dataiku.com/legal/dataiku-recruitment-scams/" target="_blank">here.</a></em></div> </div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Remote Sr. Product Manager - Revenue Management - 1 year contract (m/f/d)
description: About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️ Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in! We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates. With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️ Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation. Your Role As Senior Product Manager for one of our Revenue Management teams at RoomPriceGenie, you'll own the experience where hoteliers see, trust and act on our AI-powered pricing, both in our app and embedded in our partners' PMSs through Revenue Intelligence. This is not a feature-delivery role. We're looking for a senior PM who sets the strategy and direction, makes hard trade-offs, and turns complex pricing logic into decisions a hotelier can make in seconds. You'll lead a team of engineers, collaborate closely with design and research and work closely with leadership, Account Management, Integrations, Customer Success and Sales. Your mission: make RoomPriceGenie the pricing tool thousands of independent hotels rely on every day. What you'll do Product Vision & Strategy Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area, anchored in clear business goals: adoption, retention, revenue uplift and expansion. Decide what not to build, and bring stakeholders along on why. Shape how pricing shows up across surfaces, from our core app to partner integrations and multi-property accounts. Champion simplicity and explainability: hoteliers should understand why a price was recommended and feel confident acting on it. Discovery & Delivery Talk to hoteliers regularly and, with UX research, turn hidden friction in their revenue management workflows into strategy, not just backlog items. Work closely with the other RM team to turn forecasting and pricing model output into clear experiences that build trust and drive action. Drive solutions end to end, from opportunity assessment to measured impact, knowing when to move fast and when to dig deeper. Impact & Influence Define and own KPIs for your area, be clear about what moved them and why, and be honest about correlation vs. causation. Influence across teams without authority, especially where your area depends on other RM teams, Reporting and Integrations. Your Profile 5+ years as a Senior Product Manager, ideally in B2B SaaS, with clear ownership of outcomes, not just outputs. A track record of making complex systems radically simple Comfortable setting strategy in ambiguous spaces and making trade-offs with incomplete information. Genuine excitement about how AI is reshaping software and how it´s build. Plus: Experience in hospitality tech, revenue management systems or pricing. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership. You're a curious, structured thinker with strong product intuition. You can say no to a stakeholder and keep the relationship intact. You ask "why" until it's clear, and explain "how" until it clicks. You reflect honestly on what didn't work. What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪 At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.
