Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>We are hiring a Staff Product Security Architect to join our Security Platforms and Architecture organization at GitLab.</p> <p>Rather than operating as a purely consultative body, Security Architecture at GitLab functions as a hands-on technical driver. Our mission is to embed proactive guidance directly into modern developer workflows and automated coding environments, embedding security standards into the software development process from the outset. We strive to enable teams to deliver secure, resilient software seamlessly while minimizing reliance on manual security gates.</p> <p>In this role, you will collaborate closely with product engineering organizations, spearhead architectural strategy for critical capabilities, and serve as the primary Security Owner driving risk reduction for key entries within our risk management framework. Your daily work will span architectural design reviews, technical prototyping, and establishing scalable patterns that enable engineering teams to execute autonomously.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Partner with engineering and product leadership across GitLab, developing enough context in their domains to anticipate security problems rather than react to them</li> security risks, and act as Security Owner for high-priority items in the Product Security Risk Register, co-executing remediation with the teams who own the code</li> <li>Codify recurring security decisions into reusable artifacts — guardrails, standards, design patterns,skills, and reference threat models — delivered into developer and AI coding tool workflows</li> <li>Build proofs of concept and prototypes to unblock engineering teams and shorten the distance between a security requirement and a working implementation</li> <li>Conduct security architecture reviews for large or strategic projects, and coordinate with Application Security so that review coverage is comprehensive and correctly prioritised</li> <li>Threat model new and existing systems, and establish the patterns that let teams threat model their own work</li> <li>Work with Security Research on proactive exploration of unknown risks in GitLab's architecture</li> <li>Anticipate emerging security challenges and propose architectural responses before they reach implementation</li> <li>Mentor security engineers across the division, and represent security architecture to engineering audiences</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Depth in application security architecture, including authentication and authorization models, privilege escalation, multi-tenant isolation, and trust boundary analysis</li> <li>Experience securing distributed systems, including service-to-service authentication, secrets handling, and the failure modes of security decisions made across process boundaries</li> <li>Working knowledge of software supply chain security: build and release integrity, artifact provenance, and dependency risk</li> <li>A track record of proactive architecture work — identifying risk before it becomes an incident, and designing something that prevents a class of problem rather than an instance of one</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with engineering leadership and influence technical direction through expertise rather than gatekeeping</li> <li>Experience defining security standards or patterns that teams adopted without being compelled to</li> <li>The ability to operate strategically while remaining hands-on, including reading unfamiliar code, building prototypes, and contributing changes</li> <li>Clear written communication, and the ability to make a security argument to an engineering audience that does not already agree with it</li> <li>A view on how security guidance should be authored and delivered for AI coding tools, not only for humans</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>Security Architects are a part of our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/security/product-security/security-platforms-architecture/">Security Platforms and Architecture</a> team, who address complex security challenges facing GitLab and its customers to enable GitLab to be the most secure software factory platform on the market. Composed of <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/security/product-security/security-platforms-architecture/security-architecture/">Security Architecture</a>, <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/security/product-security/security-platforms-architecture/security-research/">Security Research</a>, and Application Security, we focus on systemic product security risks and work cross-functionally to mitigate them while maintaining Engineering’s development velocity.</p> <p>In FY27, we're implementing a new organizational model where each architect is dedicated to a specific functional area of GitLab's product, enabling deeper context, stronger relationships, and more proactive security guidance. As the Core DevOps architect, you'll be part of a team that includes architects focused on AI and the Sec Section, creating opportunities for collaboration on cross-cutting security challenges while maintaining specialized expertise in your domain.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. You'll turn executive intent into workstreams, coordinate senior stakeholders across Sales, Customer Experience, Product, Marketing, Renewals, Professional Services, Data, and Enablement, and make the tactical calls that keep the portfolio honest.</p> <p>This is a founding seat reporting to the CCO while the broader Programs function is built, and the reporting line may evolve as the team scales. business outcomes.</p> <p>What you'll do</p> <ul> <li>Own execution and business outcomes across CCO-level programs, including go-to-market transformation, renewal and retention motions, product feedback loops, and executive sponsorship for top accounts.</li> <li>Turn CCO direction into workstreams with clear owners, dependencies, and timelines.</li> <li>Coordinate senior stakeholders across Sales, Customer Experience, Product, Marketing, Renewals, Professional Services, Data, and Enablement, holding them accountable without direct authority.</li> <li>Surface stalled work, unowned risks, and slipping timelines so the CCO has a reliable, real-time view of the portfolio.</li> <li>Recommend scope changes, re-sequencing, or ending a program when it is not delivering value.</li> <li>Drive follow-through from executive meetings by tracking decisions and action items to completion.</li> <li>Track program health using data, connect execution to retention, expansion, adoption, and ARR outcomes, and communicate executive-ready narratives.</li> <li>Build shared standards for tracking, reporting, and handoffs, and iterate plans with functional leaders based on field feedback.</li> </ul> <p>What you'll bring</p> <ul> <li>Experience leading complex, cross-functional strategic programs at the executive level and turning ambiguous direction into delivered outcomes without a fully scoped brief.</li> <li>Experience in Customer Experience, go-to-market, or revenue-facing functions such as Customer Success, Renewals, Sales, or Revenue Operations, with fluency in retention, expansion, and adoption motions and how they contribute to ARR.</li> <li>The ability to influence senior stakeholders, including executives, and hold them accountable to commitments without formal authority.</li> <li>Judgment to make high-stakes tactical recommendations under ambiguity, including when data supports changing direction or ending a program.</li> <li>Data fluency to assess program health, diagnose where work is breaking down, and recommend a data-informed next step.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to move between an executive-ready narrative and execution-level detail.</li> <li>Comfort operating without established infrastructure and helping build the function's operating model.</li> <li>Reliable follow-through and the ability to navigate conflict and competing priorities across a broad stakeholder group.</li> </ul> <p>About the team</p> <p>You'll be the first Program Manager supporting CX Executive initiatives and the founding hire in a Programs function that will grow as the CCO's highest-priority cross-functional initiatives outgrow ad hoc ownership. The team works across the customer lifecycle, from go-to-market strategy and product feedback through renewal, expansion, and executive relationships with large accounts. of GitLab's security policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines: drafting, stakeholder review, approval, publication, annual review, and retirement.</li> <li>Define and run the exception management process, including risk-based approvals, expiry tracking, and trend reporting that shows where policies need to change.</li> <li>Run policy attestation and investigate non-adherence.</li> questionnaires and customer meetings, and help turn recurring customer requests into better policies and self-service content.</li> </ul> <li><em>Automation and AI</em></li> <ul> <li>Identify and implement automation and AI-assisted workflows for policy management, evidence collection, control monitoring, and assessment work, in partnership with GRC Engineering.</li> </ul> <li><em>Technical leadership</em></li> <ul> <li>Act as a technical and program leader across Security, Product, Legal, and Engineering, influencing without direct authority.</li> <li>Mentor other team members and help set the direction of the Security Governance roadmap.</li> </ul> </ul> <h4><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h4> <ul> <li>10+ years in security governance, GRC, or IT risk, with hands-on ownership of a policy and standards lifecycle and measurable outcomes, ideally at a global technology company.</li> <li>Working knowledge of SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, FedRAMP, and NIST CSF, including how to put them into practice, not only how to read them</li> <li>Experience creating and maintaining an enterprise Information Security Management System (ISMS), ideally including hands on involvement in ISO 27001 certification or recertification.<span class="screenreader-hidden-offscreen"> </span></li> <li>Understanding of cloud, SaaS, and DevSecOps practices, and the ability to write policy that engineers will follow.</li> <li>A risk-based mindset that balances compliance with real security risk.</li> <li>Demonstrated use of automation or AI to reduce manual GRC work.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication, including translating technical concepts for engineers, executives, auditors, and customers.</li> <li>Experience collaborating with Security, Product, Legal, and Engineering.</li> <li>Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or similar are highly desirable.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What success looks like</strong></h4> <ul> <li>First 30 days: Assessed the current policy library and exception process, built relationships with key stakeholders, and proposed a prioritized roadmap.</li> <li>First 90 days: Uplift the existing security policy library to align with NIST CSF, ISO 27001/27017/27018/42001, and PCI-DSS.</li> <li>First 120 days: A refreshed review cadence is in place, exception reporting is running, and can demonstrate a measurable improvement in policy adherence.</li> <li>First six months: Develop Policy as Code and collaborate with Security, Product, Legal, and Engineering for implementation into existing workflows.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>About the team</strong></h4> <p>The Security Assurance organization helps GitLab build and maintain trust by strengthening how we approach security, compliance, and risk. Security Governance sits within it and owns customer trust, security awareness, policies and standards, and other governance functions. Our counterparts are Security Compliance, Security Risk, and GRC Engineering. <br><br>You will join a small team of four direct reports under the Director, where each person has broad scope and visible impact. Those issues live in the code they write, and you set the technical direction for the static analysis engine that finds them.</p> <p>Your work spans two complementary parts of a complete security analysis. On the engine side, you shape how the static analysis toolkit models a program: parsing source into intermediate representations, resolving symbols, building call graphs, and tracking tainted data across files and languages. You define the architecture and specifications the team builds against, and you delegate component specifications within them to engineers and to the AI agents that implement them. On the evaluation side, you build and apply tooling that tests, measures, and validates what the engine finds against benchmark applications with known vulnerabilities.</p> <p>What the engine can model and how we measure what it finds are parts of one picture. As a Staff engineer you hold that picture, shape the long-range technical goals of the team, and raise the bar for every engineer on it. We build the engine with AI agents that write and review code from written specifications, under human direction. We expect you to direct that work effectively and with good judgment, and to help the team do the same.</p> <h3><strong>What you do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Act as the directly responsible individual (DRI) for the team's highest-scope initiatives from design through delivery, shipping large features with minimal guidance and shaping the long-range goals of the team</li> <li>Bring systems built by one engineer to team ownership through documentation, tests, and shared review</li> <li>Set the technical direction for the AI-assisted tooling that implements, reviews, and validates engine changes and findings, design the checks that decide whether an agent-written change or generated result is fit to merge, and measure detection quality against benchmark applications with known vulnerabilities, raising the bar for what counts as a trustworthy result. That includes static application security testing (SAST) rules mapped to CWE and OWASP, and the test fixtures that prove they work.</li> <li>Own the architecture of the program model (parsing, symbol resolution, intermediate representations, call graphs, and taint and data-flow analysis) and of the pipeline that turns source code into findings, and define how both extend to new languages and frameworks</li> <li>Solve technical problems of the highest scope and complexity, actively seek out difficult impediments affecting the whole team, and advocate for improvements to quality, security, and performance with Product Management, UX, and partner teams such as Code Security and Composition Analysis</li> <li>Mentor all engineers on the team through code review and pairing, remove blockers to their autonomy, and shepherd the definition and improvement of our internal standards through review</li> <li>Participate in on-call rotations to assist troubleshooting product operations, security operations, and urgent engineering issues</li> <li>Define the overarching architecture and specification documents for the engine, delegate component specifications within them, and drive their implementation by AI agents and engineers working independently through phased plans, small reviewable units of change, and specifications kept in lockstep with the code</li> <li>Build and maintain the harness, agent instructions, and agentic skills that keep agent-written code trustworthy, including separate coding and reviewing agents, rules and tests the coding agents cannot change, independent review panels of agents from different model providers, and performance, API, and dependency gates, with risky changes escalated to human review</li> <li>Stay current with research in title: Staff Solutions Architect, AI Subject Matter Expert
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. The Account SA owns the opportunity; you own your product group's success within it. You'll work directly with Product and Engineering, bringing customer needs and field insights into roadmap discussions. You'll also help the wider Solutions Architecture team build expertise through reusable assets, enablement, and coaching.</p> <p>You'll specialize in one product group, not all four. In Security & Compliance, you'll focus on GitLab Ultimate, application security, Dependency Firewall, software supply chain security, compliance, and artificial intelligence (AI) governance. In Platform, you'll focus on GitLab Dedicated, self-managed deployments, bring your own model, and cloud and hybrid architecture. In Core DevSecOps, you'll focus on GitLab Premium, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), source code management, Orbit, Artifact Central, and migrations. DevSecOps brings development, security, and operations together across software delivery. We'll also measure how often Account SAs reuse your assets, their confidence in handling your product group without escalation, and the quality and impact of your feedback to Product.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Act as the technical authority for your product group on prioritized opportunities, from discovery and architecture through trials and PoV evaluations.</li> <li>Lead technical deep dives, workshops, and executive briefings that connect product capabilities to business outcomes and explain how GitLab differs from competing solutions.</li> <li>Design and improve standardized PoV templates with clear, repeatable success criteria. Account SAs own the customer PoV; you'll contribute product-specific content and expertise while keeping the evaluation connected to the broader GitLab platform.</li> <li>Equip account teams for product launches with Product Management and Product Marketing. Build demos and talk tracks, and turn early customer wins into reference stories.</li> <li>Serve as the escalation point for Account SAs and Post-Sales Solutions Architects (Post-Sales SAs) on complex product questions, integrations, and objections.</li> <li>Hand off PoV success criteria and architecture decisions to the Post-Sales SA with the account team when an opportunity closes. Stay involved until the customer's first production workload uses the product, and support complex accounts when Post-Sales SAs bring you in to drive adoption and consumption.</li> <li>Bring structured field feedback, competitive insights, and customer requirements to Product Management and Engineering with the wider SME team. Help manage early-access and design-partner programs, and represent GitLab through customer events, conferences, industry working groups, and published content.</li> <li>Build reference architectures, demo environments, competitive battlecards, PoV playbooks, and enablement content so account teams can handle more opportunities without your direct involvement. Mentor Account SAs and contribute to GitLab's global SME community of practice.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Substantial experience in technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, consulting, or software engineering, with deep, hands-on expertise in one domain: application security testing, supply chain security, and compliance; scalable cloud and hybrid platforms; large CI/CD environments and source code migrations; or production AI-assisted development, working prototypes, and competitive evaluations.</li> <li>Practical expertise in agentic and AI-assisted development workflows across planning, coding, testing, security, and delivery, applied in a customer-facing, pre-sales context.</li> <li>Experience winning technical decisions on large, complex enterprise opportunities through structured Proof of Concept (PoC) or PoV evaluations with defined success criteria and executive sign-off.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider.</li> <li>The ability to lead a whiteboard session with engineers and present the business case to executives in the same meeting.</li> <li>Strong written communication, including the ability to turn complex topics into clear playbooks that others use.</li> <li>Comfort working asynchronously across time zones with Sales, Product, and Engineering.</li> <li>Optional: public speaking, published technical content, open source contributions, or relevant certifications in Kubernetes, cloud architecture, or security.</li> </ul> <p>If you bring transferable experience in an adjacent domain, we encourage you to apply.</p> <h2><strong><br>About the team</strong></h2> <p>We're building our SME organization within GitLab's Solutions title: Strategic Account Executive - AI, San Francisco
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h3><strong>Location- San Francisco, California </strong></h3> <h3><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h3> <p>As a Strategic Account Executive for the San Francisco region, you'll drive GitLab's enterprise growth by helping some of the area's most influential organizations, including a concentrated focus on leading AI companies, adopt, implement, and expand their use of our AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You'll focus on enterprise accounts, with particular emphasis on foundation model labs, AI infrastructure providers, and applied AI companies scaling rapidly in the region, guiding customers through complex digital and DevSecOps transformations and driving pipeline generation that translates into measurable Net ARR and long-term expansion. In this role, you'll act as a key connector between customer stakeholders and GitLab's field organization so GitLab is seen as a trusted, long-term partner across the full sales cycle. In your first year, you'll be expected to build a strong enterprise portfolio across your territory, including a meaningful share of AI-native accounts, create repeatable sales motions, and consistently forecast and report on deal progress and account health.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Drive strategic growth by leading GitLab's enterprise accounts across San Francisco, with a dedicated focus on AI-native companies, serving as a trusted technology advisor to industry leaders in your territory.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Orchestrate winning sales strategies by bringing together Solutions Architects, Customer Success experts, Sales Development, Channel & Alliances, and other technical specialists to deliver transformative, AI-powered DevSecOps solutions tailored to the unique velocity and scale demands of AI-native engineering organizations.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Shape the future of software development by crafting innovative solutions that align GitLab's platform with customers' long-term vision, compliance needs, and business objectives, including the specific infrastructure, security, and governance challenges AI companies face as they scale model development and deployment.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Build deep, strategic partnerships by mastering your customers' industry landscape, success metrics, and growth trajectories, including a strong point of view on the AI/ML ecosystem, so you can position GitLab as their indispensable technology ally.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Design and execute strategic account plans, including opportunity mapping, stakeholder alignment, and multi-threaded engagement, to expand GitLab usage within new and existing strategic accounts, with particular attention to fast-growing AI companies and their evolving technical buying committees.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Lead end-to-end customer journeys from initial discovery through evaluation, negotiation, and successful implementation, ensuring a consistent, high-quality experience at every stage of the sales cycle.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Champion continuous improvement by contributing to forecasting and pipeline reviews, conducting sophisticated win/loss analyses, and sharing strategic insights, including emerging trends in AI company buying behavior, that refine our go-to-market approach.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Prepare and deliver compelling customer-facing and internal presentations, proposals, and recommendations that clearly communicate value, business outcomes, and the path to long-term partnership with GitLab.</li> <li> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Experience driving complex B2B software sales cycles with enterprise customers, ideally in DevSecOps, software development tools, or adjacent SaaS solutions.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Background selling into large, enterprise accounts in San Francisco, United States, with the ability to build trusted C-level and senior stakeholder relationships across business and technical teams.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Familiarity with the AI/ML company landscape, including model providers, AI infrastructure vendors, and applied AI startups, and the ability to speak credibly to engineering and technical leadership about how DevSecOps practices apply to AI-driven development.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Knowledge of San Francisco's enterprise and AI market, including key industries, buying centers, and decision-making dynamics, with the ability to build and nurture a relevant professional network.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Ability to drive new business acquisition and expansion within enterprise accounts through consultative, multi-stakeholder sales motions that lead to sustainable, long-term customer partnerships.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Experience collaborating with channel and strategic partners to generate pipeline, co-sell, and support successful customer adoption.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to lead account strategy, influence internal and external stakeholders, and remain calm under pressure.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Ability to work in line with GitLab's values, use GitLab and Salesforce in your daily work, and travel as needed while following company travel policies.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>The Enterprise Sales team is responsible for driving growth, adoption, and long-term value for GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform with our largest and most strategic customers. As a Strategic Account Executive focused on San Francisco, you'll be part of a distributed, all-remote team that works asynchronously across regions and partners closely with GitLab's sales engineering, marketing, and customer success teams. We value transparency, collaboration, and a consultative approach, and we support one another through shared account planning, regular deal reviews, and knowledge sharing focused on enterprise customers across the San Francisco region.</p> <div class="c-message_actions__container c-message__actions"> </div> <div><span style="font-size: xx-small;"><span style="color: white;">Remote-Global</span></span></div><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p>As a Strategic Account Executive for our Mumbai territory, you'll drive GitLab's growth across large Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI) institutions, alongside leading enterprises and conglomerates headquartered in the city. It will be a blended territory of Enterprise and Conglomerates slightly more BFSI heavy. You'll help these organisations adopt, implement, and expand their use of our AI-powered DevSecOps platform, guiding them through modernisation and DevSecOps transformations while building a pipeline that translates into measurable Net ARR and long-term expansion.</p> <p>You'll bring an understanding of the software development lifecycle, including continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) automation, secure development practices, and infrastructure modernisation. build a strong BFSI and Enterprise portfolio across your territory, create repeatable sales motions aligned to how regulated financial institutions and large enterprises buy and adopt platforms, and platform</li> <li>Position GitLab against regulatory and compliance priorities (for example RBI, IRDAI, and SEBI guidelines on IT governance, outsourcing, cyber resilience, and data localisation), working with Solutions Architects and Security specialists on deployment options such as self-managed and GitLab Dedicated</li> <li>Partner closely with Sales Development Representatives, Solutions software sales cycles with large enterprise customers, ideally in DevSecOps, software development tools, or adjacent SaaS and infrastructure solutions that support the software development lifecycle</li> <li>A track record selling into BFSI institutions in India, with an understanding of their buying behaviour, long evaluation cycles, vendor risk assessments, and procurement processes within large accounts across Mumbai</li> <li>Strong understanding of modern software delivery, including CI/CD, secure development practices (DevSecOps, supply chain security), and cloud and infrastructure modernisation, with the ability to connect platform capabilities to customer outcomes</li> <li>Working familiarity with the regulatory and compliance landscape for Indian financial institutions, including data residency, audit, and security expectations, and comfort discussing on-premises, private cloud, and hybrid deployment models</li> <li>Proven ability to navigate and creating and executing account plans for priority accounts, including opportunity mapping, multi-threaded engagement, and disciplined deal and account management</li> <li>Experience working with system integrators and channel partners to co-sell and deliver in the Indian market</li> <li>Effective communication and interpersonal skills, including comfort leading customer presentations, negotiations, and executive-level conversations, and coordinating internal resources to move opportunities forward</li> <li>Capacity to work autonomously and asynchronously in a fully remote environment while staying aligned to shared goals, processes, and forecasting expectations across the broader GitLab team, with the flexibility to meet customers in person across Mumbai</li> You’ll interact with customers daily as they encounter the difficult edge cases of running GitLab in complex environments. In the space of a day, you might be doing behind the scenes work of a Linux administrator troubleshooting performance problems by using strace on a particular process, interacting with the Product team to ensure that steps in a bug report are reproducible, or interacting with the Engineering team itself by diving deep into our codebase and putting together a merge request to actually fix a customer issue. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">That’s not all though - you’d equally be invited to contribute to the source code, improve our documentation, and help build out more efficient support processes in our issue tracker. We want to live in a world where everyone can contribute, and as a member of the support team, there are no barriers to using your skills to improve the experience of our users and customers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><br></span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Some examples of our projects: </span></p> <ul> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/gitlab-detective">A tool to automatically check a GitLab Omnibus install for known issues</a></li> <li>A<a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/gitlabsos"> solution to capture the state of a customer’s server</a> for easier troubleshooting</li> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/sosparser">A tool which turns log files into interactive tables to easily sort and filter columns</a></li> <li>A functionality to<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/ci/chatops/"> ChatOps</a> to make it easier to identify user accounts on GitLab.com</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">  </span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Support a mix of Self-managed and GitLab.com (SaaS) customers and resolve their issues via Zendesk tickets, merge processes by reviewing applications and assessments, and by participating in interviews.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you’ll bring </strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span on Rails)</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Experience with Git and CI/CD</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Expertise in writing support content </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Ability to communicate complex technical topics to customers and coworkers of varying technical skill level</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Familiarity with DevOps methodologies and technologies like Serverless and Kubernetes</span></li> <li You’ll partner across GitLab to turn talent brand strategy into campaigns and content throughout the candidate journey.</p> <p>This role is a strong fit for a brand, recruitment marketing, employer brand, or content professional who can move between strategy and execution. campaigns across careers content, social media, employer review platforms, talent communities, events, and recruiter channels.</li> <li value="3">Develop and curate stories featuring team members, leaders, teams, culture, values, career growth, and the impact of working at GitLab.</li> <li value="4">Partner with Talent Acquisition to create targeted content and campaigns that support hiring priorities, pipeline generation, and conversion.</li> <li value="5">Improve candidate journey touchpoints with transparent, consistent, and relevant information throughout the hiring process.</li> <li value="6">Use content, channel, candidate feedback, and funnel metrics to improve performance and communicate impact.</li> <li value="7">Collaborate across GitLab to ensure content is accurate, inclusive, culturally relevant, and aligned with our voice.</li> <li value="8">Manage projects and external partners while improving talent brand processes, systems, reporting, and operations through iteration and thoughtful use of technology and artificial intelligence tools.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li value="1">Experience in talent brand, employer brand, recruitment marketing, content strategy, communications, or a related field.</li> <li value="2">Experience translating a brand or employer value proposition into content, campaigns, or audience experiences.</li> <li value="3">Strong storytelling, writing, editing, and editorial judgment across multiple channels.</li> <li value="4">Experience planning and delivering campaigns or programs with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and deadlines.</li> <li value="5">Comfort using performance data, audience insights, feedback, and market research to improve outcomes.</li> <li value="6">Experience influencing across functions and working with senior stakeholders, subject matter experts, creative partners, or vendors.</li> <li value="7">Ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize competing work, and move from strategy to detailed execution in an asynchronous environment.</li> <li value="8">A commitment to inclusive, transparent storytelling, alignment with GitLab’s values and remote working practices, and applicable work authorization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The GitLab Talent Brand team helps candidates understand what it means to work here through marketing, storytelling, partnerships, candidate education, and recruiter enablement. This is a detail-oriented, execution-focused role for someone who enjoys bringing order to a fast-moving tool landscape and wants to build a foundation in Tech operations.</p> <p>This role reports to the Vice President, Enablement & AI.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li><strong>Tool Inventory & Consolidation:</strong> Maintain an up-to-date inventory of all AI tools used across the field org, identify overlap or redundancy, and support consolidation efforts to reduce tool sprawl.</li> <li><strong>Tool Adoption & Use Case Index: </strong>Formalize a library of field-adopted and -requested use cases for our AI tools, in coordination with the AI Transformation Owner, CRO.</li> <li><strong>Utilization & Tracking:</strong> Monitor usage of AI tools across teams, build simple reporting to track adoption trends, and flag underutilized or underperforming tools to stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Comms & Enablement: </strong>draft internal announcements for tool rollouts and create micro-enablement programs to engage the field in AI tools.</li> <li><strong>Tool Access Requests/Management:</strong> Own the intake and processing of access requests for AI tools, ensuring provisioning is timely, accurate, and aligned with licensing and approval requirements.</li> <li><strong>AI Data Management:</strong> Support the organization, quality, and hygiene of data used by or generated from AI tools, working with relevant teams to keep gDrive/datasets accurate and properly maintained.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Early-Mid Level Experience:</strong> Some experience in enablement, sales/business operations, IT operations, or a similar coordination-heavy function; comfortable owning recurring operational processes.</li> <li><strong>Organized & Detail-Oriented:</strong> Strong attention to detail with the ability to track multiple tools, requests, and datasets simultaneously without things falling through the cracks.</li> <li><strong>Interest in AI Tooling:</strong> Genuine curiosity about AI tools and platforms, with willingness to learn the technical basics of how they're configured, accessed, and maintained. Enablement is instrumental in helping GitLab grow at a more accelerated pace and achieve our ambitious revenue targets. title: Territory Sales Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a strategic Territory Sales Manager  for Japan, you will own and grow your Digital Native and Retail territory with GitLab’s enterprise relationships in the Japan market. You’ll help Enterprise organizations realize the full value of GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform by leading the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through rollout and long-term adoption. Reporting to an Area Sales Manager or Regional Director, you’ll use a consultative approach to understand complex customer needs, guide them through evaluation, and coordinate pre- and post-sales resources to ensure successful deployments and visible business outcomes.</p> <p>You’ll work under minimal supervision on complex deals, act as the voice of the customer into GitLab, and partner closely with our strategic channel partners to generate qualified opportunities and develop new customers. In your first year, you’ll be expected to establish and execute clear account plans for enterprise prospects and customers in the Japan market, build strong internal and external stakeholder relationships, and consistently manage your forecast and pipeline with transparency and discipline.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Support GitLab’s strategic prospects and customers in your territory in Japan  Market, with a focus in the Digital Natives and Retail industry, owning the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts </li> <li>Lead account strategy by developing and executing account plans aligned to each customer’s business needs and long-term goals</li> <li>Conduct prospecting and opportunity development activities in named large and strategic accounts, including working closely with strategic channel partners to generate qualified leads and new customers</li> <li>Coordinate pre- and post-sales engagement with solutions architects, customer success, and support teams to ensure successful rollout, adoption, and expansion of GitLab products</li> <li>Provide clear account leadership, including regular activity, pipeline, and forecast reporting to sales management</li> <li>Analyze wins and losses, contribute to root cause analysis, and share lessons learned with account managers, marketing, and technical teams to improve future outcomes</li> <li>Act as the voice of the customer by sharing feedback and product ideas through GitLab’s public issue tracker and internal channels</li> <li>Use a consultative sales approach to uncover business issues, shape solution recommendations, and deliver compelling proposals, quotes, and presentations that address customer requirements</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience managing complex sales cycles with large, strategic enterprise customers, selling into the Digital Natives and retail segment</li> <li>Proven ability to prospect, qualify, and develop new opportunities while also growing existing accounts through strong account management</li> <li>Skill in leading pre- and post-sales activities, coordinating with technical, support, and channel partners to drive adoption and expansion</li> <li>Proficiency in consultative selling, including uncovering business needs, building account plans, and delivering proposals and presentations that align GitLab solutions to customer outcomes</li> <li>Ability to prepare and maintain accurate activity, pipeline, and forecast reports, and to contribute to win/loss and root cause analysis</li> <li>Effective communication and collaboration skills to share customer feedback and lessons learned with sales management, product, marketing, and technical teams</li> <li>Familiarity with software development concepts and tools, with preferred exposure to Git, software development tools, or application lifecycle management</li> <li>Alignment with GitLab’s values, openness to learning, and interest in applying transferable skills even if your background does not match every requirement exactly</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Territory Sales Manager will join our enterprise sales team, which focuses on driving GitLab adoption with large customers in the Japan market. The team is responsible for the full relationship lifecycle with enterprise accounts, from initial engagement through long-term expansion and advocacy, ensuring customers realize value from GitLab’s DevSecOps platform. Team members work in an all-remote, distributed environment and collaborate asynchronously across time zones with sales leadership, solutions architects, customer success, marketing, and channel partners. The team is currently focused on maintaining and growing our existing footprint in the region, executing a consistent global sales motion while adapting to local customer needs and partnering closely with strategic channel organizations to reach and support key accounts.</p> <p>Additional details about our process can be found on our<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/" target="_blank"> hiring page</a>.</p> <div class="c-message_actions__container c-message__actions"> </div> <div><span style="font-size: xx-small;"><span style="color: white;">Remote-Global</span></span></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. title: Senior Director of Global Tax
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London, Cardiff or Distributed | 💰 Dependant on experience + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> </p> <p><strong>⭐Our Tax team</strong></p> <p>We're looking for an experienced, hands-on and enthusiastic<strong> Senior Director of Global Tax </strong>to lead the Global Tax team at Monzo, and our wider finance team.</p> <p>You’ll be leading our growing Tax team of 10+ individuals, and will be reporting into the Group Financial Controller (with a close partnership with the MBL Chief Financial Officer and wider Executive team).</p> <p>A large part of the role involves advising on the tax implications of all new business developments, ensuring we’re both set up for compliance and optimised wherever possible and appropriate. Given the stage Monzo is currently at in its growth journey, these will be many and wide ranging, from customer products to treasury strategies, group reorgs to mobility proposals, systems implementations to international expansion.</p> <p><strong>🔑 Key responsibilities of the role...</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Global tax strategy:</strong> Defining how Monzo approaches tax across the UK, Europe, and future markets. You will set our tax risk appetite and prepare reporting for our Audit and Risk Committee.</li> <li><strong>International expansion:</strong> Structuring cross-border expansion across Europe and future regions, advising on market-entry structures, permanent establishment risks, and local compliance.</li> <li><strong>Transfer pricing:</strong> Establishing, documenting, and defending our global transfer pricing strategy and intragroup financing arrangements.</li> <li><strong>Total tax ownership:</strong> Overseeing group Direct Tax, Indirect Tax (VAT), Employment Tax, Transfer Pricing, and Operational Customer Taxes across all locations.</li> <li><strong>Tax authority relationships:</strong> Acting as the primary liaison with HMRC and international tax authorities, proactively managing tax audits, and overseeing statutory regimes including Senior Accounting Officer compliance.</li> <li><strong>Product and commercial advisory:</strong> Working directly with product managers, engineers, and treasury to understand what they want to build (from savings pots to complex lending products) and ensuring the tax treatment is clear from day one.</li> <li><strong>Leading the team:</strong> Mentoring and leading our tax team, fostering a culture of technical excellence, autonomy, and commercial focus.</li> <li><strong>AI and automation:</strong> Designing a tech-enabled tax operating model that embeds AI, workflow tools, and automation across our compliance, reconciliations, and contract reviews; scaling our output as volumes grow while keeping the team focused on high-judgement strategic work.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩We’d love to hear from you if...</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re a qualified tax professional or accountant (CTA, ACA, ACCA, ADIT, or international equivalent). </li> <li>You’ve led an in-house tax team at scale, ideally within banking, fintech, or a regulated multinational. </li> <li>You’re an empathetic, effective people leader with a strong track record of coaching individuals and fostering a positive, high-performing environment.</li> <li>You bring practical experience with cross-border tax issues, international structuring, and transfer pricing.</li> <li>You understand operational and customer taxes common to financial services (such as FATCA/CRS, withholding taxes, and interest reporting).</li> <li>You are excited by modern technology, data, and AI, with a clear view on how tools can automate workflows, reduce human error, and modernise routine tax tasks.</li> <li>You can explain complex tax positions to non-tax stakeholders, including product leads, commercial teams, and auditors.</li> <li>You’re comfortable with ambiguity: we move fast, build things that haven't been built before, and you’ll frequently make calls without a standard blueprint.</li> <li>What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 Dependant on experience + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff offices. We're also open to distributed working within the UK (with the expectation of some travel to our London office).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key rounds:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Phone call with the Recruiter (30 mins)</li> <li>Initial Interview with the Hiring Manager (45 min)</li> <li>Role Specific, Technical, Leadership & Behavioural Interviews (x4 45 mins)</li> </ul> <p>Our average process takes around 4 - 5 weeks but we will always work around your availability. </p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <div> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">here</a>.<br><br>#LI-NZ1 #LI-Remote</p> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties
description: Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties Ben jij een ervaren installatietechnicus die klaar is voor een leidinggevende rol? Of geef je al leiding aan monteurs en wil je meer verantwoordelijkheid binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek? Dan hebben we bij Campus Installatietechniek in Barneveld een mooie uitdaging voor je! Als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties combineer je jouw technische kennis met het aansturen en begeleiden van een team monteurs. Je zorgt dat werkzaamheden goed worden voorbereid, projecten volgens planning verlopen en jouw collega's hun werk optimaal kunnen uitvoeren. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen de monteurs, werkvoorbereiding, projectleiding en opdrachtgevers. Wat je gaat doen Als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en coördinatie van werkzaamheden binnen verschillende installatieprojecten. Je zorgt dat jouw team weet wat er moet gebeuren en dat projecten veilig, efficiënt en volgens afspraak worden uitgevoerd. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren van monteurs en technici; Coördineren en verdelen van werkzaamheden binnen werktuigbouwkundige installatieprojecten; Bewaken van de planning, voortgang, kwaliteit, veiligheid en kosten; Afstemmen met projectleiders, werkvoorbereiders, opdrachtgevers en leveranciers; Zorgen dat materialen, informatie en middelen tijdig beschikbaar zijn; Meedenken over technische vraagstukken rondom klimaatinstallaties, verwarming en luchtbehandeling; Signaleren van verbeterkansen en bijdragen aan efficiëntere werkprocessen; Onderhouden van goede contacten met klanten en andere betrokken partijen. Je staat dicht bij de techniek, maar houdt tegelijkertijd het overzicht over het grotere geheel. Dankzij jouw inzet kunnen de monteurs hun werk goed uitvoeren en worden projecten succesvol opgeleverd. Wat neem je mee? Je hebt een stevige technische basis binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek en vindt het leuk om collega's aan te sturen en verder te helpen. Je kunt goed organiseren, communiceert duidelijk en weet ook bij onverwachte situaties het overzicht te bewaren. Daarnaast herken jij jezelf in het volgende: Een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding richting installatietechniek, werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar; Enkele jaren werkervaring binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek, bijvoorbeeld als Eerste Monteur, Leidinggevend Monteur of Teamleider; Kennis van gebouwgebonden installaties, zoals verwarmingsinstallaties, klimaatinstallaties en luchtbehandeling; Leidinggevende kwaliteiten en het vermogen om collega's te motiveren; Organisatorisch inzicht en een goed gevoel voor planning en kwaliteit; Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een klantgerichte instelling; Een proactieve houding en het vermogen om technische en organisatorische uitdagingen op te lossen. Heb je ruime ervaring als Eerste Monteur of Leidinggevend Monteur en ben je toe aan een volgende stap? Ook dan komen we graag met je in contact! Waar ga je het doen? Campus Installatietechniek is een installatiebedrijf gevestigd in Barneveld. We werken aan uiteenlopende werktuigbouwkundige installaties binnen de utiliteit en gebouwgebonden installatietechniek.Bij Campus houden we van korte lijnen, duidelijke afspraken en een praktische aanpak. We zorgen voor een goede voorbereiding en ondersteunen elkaar waar nodig. Hierdoor kunnen onze monteurs zich richten op hun vak en kunnen projecten efficiënt worden uitgevoerd. Als Teamleider krijg je de ruimte om mee te denken, verbeteringen door te voeren en jouw eigen stempel te drukken op de dagelijkse werkzaamheden. Je werkt samen met betrokken collega's die elkaar kennen, helpen en samen zorgen voor tevreden klanten. Wij zijn een trots onderdeel van de snelgroeiende VDK Groep (185 bedrijven, 9.000 collega’s), maar opereren met een eigen identiteit en cultuur. Dit betekent dat je bij ons de voordelen van een grote organisatie ervaart – denk aan opleidingsmogelijkheden, een stabiele basis en top secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden – terwijl je tegelijkertijd de vrijheid, dynamiek en verantwoordelijkheid krijgt om je eigen stempel te drukken bij het lokale bedrijf. title: Customer Solution Architect (AU, NZ, SG)
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re seeking a Customer Solutions Architect (CSA) to help drive the adoption of Supabase across a diverse range of customers: from agile startups building towards their first launch to established brands with highly scaled workloads. At Supabase, CSA’s are responsible for the entire customer journey, working closely with our most valuable users to: 1. Uncover and understand business and technical requirements. 2. Design and architect technical solutions built on the Supabase platform. 3. Work with customers to lead proof-of-value implementations. 4. Provide regular customer engagements to answer complex questions, unblock adoption, and optimize scaled performance. Successful CSAs always put customers first, working closely with them to become trusted advisors who understand their needs, work as an extension of their team toward common success, and advocate on behalf of the customer within Supabase. You'll be joining our team to support Supabase Team & Enterprise customers, where you will be expected to lead and innovate around the following areas of responsibility: DISCOVERY - Lead technical discovery to uncover business and technical objectives, set appropriate expectations of the Supabase platform, and define the criteria for success, ensuring customers can receive the guidance they need to achieve it. - Design, build, and present Supabase platform demonstrations to high-value customers. Leverage quality storytelling to present the value of the Supabase platform and of the entire Supabase Success team. - Work directly with Growth team members to size deals, provide anticipated usage estimates, and identify potential workloads supported by the Platform. PROOF-OF-VALUE ONBOARDING - Collaborate directly with customers to determine the technical scope of a proof-of-value to ensure customers recognize the value of the Supabase platform while minimizing risk to adoption. - Set proof-of-value timelines, business outcomes, and success criteria that ensure a customer is comfortable proceeding with the platform once a proof-of-value has been completed. - Actively guide new customers through an onboarding journey, utilizing emails, docs, guides, and webinars to promote their rapid deployment and growth on the platform. CUSTOMER SUCCESS - Understand immediate custom goals (i.e onboard and adoption) as well as long-term customer opportunities (i.e. optimization & identifying new workloads) to build meaningful account plans for high-value customers. - Deliver on synchronous and asynchronous engagements with Supabase customers, including application architecture assessments, database design and performance optimization, and proactive support to enable customers to scale with confidence. - Serve as an internal champion for your customers and for the platform. Work closely with Support, Product, and Engineering to provide platform feedback, identify areas of improvement, while communicating platform roadmaps to customers. - Invest in customer connections to build a trust-based relationship. Everyday CSA’s work with the production data stores of startups and enterprises alike. Building trust in the Success team and Supabase platform is paramount to a successful customer relationship. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE - 6+ years of relevant work experience in Solutions Architecture, Database Engineering, or similar. - Strong background with relational database management systems such as PostgreSQL or MySQL. - Background in web application development, with familiarity with Python, C# and popular JavaScript frameworks (React, Vue, Svelte) as well as Node.js. - Very strong communication skills, particularly of technical concepts. CSA’s at Supabase spend a significant amount of time translating business needs to technical outcomes, and technical concepts to organizational impact. - Well-organized and effective storyteller with meaningful interpersonal skills. CSA’s often have to navigate multiple stakeholders with conflicting opinions, and the ability to effectively mediate this type of conflict is crucial. - Experience with project management, business analysis and revenue operations tools. We use HubSpot, BigQuery etc., and familiarity with these platforms will help enable your success. - Previous experience leading customer-facing engagements to deliver meaningful technical and business value. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Product Marketing Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰£100,000 - £133,000 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits">Benefits</a> |</p> <p>We’re looking for several <strong>Product Marketing Leads </strong>to set the market intelligence and product strategy for individual product Collectives.</p> <p>At Monzo, Product Marketing is a global product-market fit discipline rather than a GTM discipline. We’re embedded in squads with PMs, Designers and User Researchers, shaping products and propositions by acting as the voice of the market (UK, Ireland, Spain and future markets). We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead marketing strategy and execution, to bring those propositions to customers. Together, we aim to build and market category-leading products. If that’s your flavour of product marketing, Monzo is for you.</p> <p>This is a player/coach role. You'll own Product Marketing for a Collective: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and guiding how launches land in the market. If you love influencing what gets built as much as how it's communicated, you'll feel at home here.</p> <p><strong>Where you could join:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Wealth </strong>is building the future of how people grow their money: helping millions of customers save, invest, and plan for retirement with the same simplicity and trust they expect from their current account. It spans Savings, Investments, Pensions, Insurance, and brand new kinds of wealth-building experiences. This is a role for someone who wants to challenge how traditional wealth products work to make growing money (finally) feel simpler and more useful for everyday customers.</li> <li><strong>MonzOS </strong>is the intelligence layer of Monzo: an AI-powered operating system that helps customers find the right product, insight or action at the right moment. It brings together personalisation, recommendations, search and in-app discovery to make Monzo feel more useful every time someone opens the app. This is a role for someone who is excited by the challenge of making Monzo feel simple, trusted and indispensable in people’s financial lives.</li> <li><strong>EU </strong>is building Monzo for millions of customers across Europe, taking what people love about Monzo in the UK and making it work brilliantly in new markets. This role will lead consumer market insight and competitor discovery for new countries, while supporting growth in already-live markets like Ireland and Spain. This is a role for someone who loves figuring out how to win a market: turning customer insight, competitor analysis and local context into practical, provocative choices for product and marketing.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>You and your team will…</p> <ul> <li><strong>Set strategy for multiple categories. </strong>You'll own a one-year product marketing strategy for a complex, multi-product Collective. You will work to define how Monzo wins in multiple categories with multiple products over time.</li> <li><strong>Set the market intelligence agenda. </strong>You'll decide what we need to understand about our customers, competitors, and the market. You’ll identify and size opportunities, and build the frameworks other teams use to prioritise and respond.</li> <li><strong>Shape what gets built.</strong> You'll use market intelligence to shape product strategy across multiple areas, bringing a perspective that changes what we build and in what order. You'll sit alongside Product leadership, driving commercial outcomes through product differentiation.</li> <li><strong>Define positioning that moves the business. </strong>You'll ensure every product starts with a customer problem, differentiated positioning, and a proposition worth talking about. You’ll demonstrate that positioning will shift customer perception and move revenue at scale.</li> <li><strong>Own how we go to market.</strong> You'll decide when products launch, with what mechanic, and in what order, so launches across the Collective add up to more than a run of releases. You'll give Integrated Marketing a brief sharp enough that they never have to guess, then feed what the market tells you back into the proposition.</li> <li><strong>Raise the bar for Product Marketing.</strong> You'll define what great looks like through high standards, coaching, feedback, and better systems. You'll improve how PMM works by embedding AI into our workflows, tools, and playbooks. On the manager track, you'll also be accountable for the development, performance, and careers of a small team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Great PMMs come from all sorts of places. This is for you if: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You think beyond a single product.</strong> You're comfortable owning strategy across multiple products and categories, where work spans multiple squads and the decisions have business-wide implications.</li> <li><strong>You own the hardest calls in your domain.</strong> You're trusted to make high-stakes positioning and strategy decisions independently, and you're right often enough that Product and Marketing leadership seek your judgement. You're comfortable making difficult trade-offs between commercial needs, customer experience, and competitive urgency when the right answer isn't obvious.</li> <li><strong>You bring senior people with you.</strong> You build consensus around difficult decisions, influence senior stakeholders across disciplines, and create clarity out of ambiguity. People look to you for guidance when the path forward isn't obvious.</li> <li><strong>You're a player/coach.</strong> You still want to do the hardest strategic work yourself while coaching others through feedback, mentoring, and high standards. Whether or not you're a people manager, your impact is visible in the growth of the people around you.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Interview Process</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages:</p> <ul> <li>Initial Call (45mins) </li> <li>Case Study Presentation (1hour)</li> <li>x2 final interviews via Google Meet (45mins for each interview)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to hiring@monzo.com. You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you: </strong></p> <ul> <li>£100,000 - £133,000 as a base salary</li> <li>This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK </li> <li>We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</li> <li>Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences </li> <li>And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"><strong>here</strong><strong> </strong></a></li> </ul> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage.
