title: Cloud Platform Engineer
description: ABOUT THE ROLE As a Cloud Platform Engineer at Supabase, you’ll join Cloud Engineering, part of Engineering Operations, and shape the foundations that let engineering teams build, ship, and operate infrastructure safely and independently across AWS and GCP. This is a role spanning cloud governance, platform engineering, and hands-on operations. You’ll work across AWS and GCP account structure, identity and access management, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), reusable platform primitives, security boundaries, and self-service workflows for engineers. You’ll be joining at a point where many of these foundations are being actively defined or reworked. We’re looking for someone who can take ambiguous, messy, business-critical infrastructure problems and turn them into pragmatic systems, tools, standards, and written guidance that scale with the company and empower teams to go faster. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Designing and implementing cloud governance across AWS and GCP, including identity, account organization, access controls, and guardrails. - Building reusable infrastructure and building blocks using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), enabling teams to provision and manage infrastructure safely and consistently. - Creating self-service capabilities that reduce organizational friction and let engineers move more quickly within sensible boundaries. - Owning resource governance and visibility: management tagging, a trustworthy inventory of what exists and who owns it, and consistent cross-account billing data. - Developing reusable security primitives, including secrets storage, KMS, certificate management, token vending, direct service-to-service authentication, mTLS, and related platform services. - Owning cloud-level network and operational primitives: IP address management, DNS, and health signals such as service-limit and quota alerting. - Combining software engineering with hands-on operations and total ownership: building, deploying, monitoring, troubleshooting, and improving what you own. - Establishing and sharing cloud engineering best practices through documentation, internal tooling, examples, and enablement. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - Have 5+ years of experience in cloud governance, platform engineering, and/or operations, have operated production systems at scale, and carried on-call for them. - Have previously undertaken a significant migration, e.g. rearchitected an AWS account topology, introduced IaC for existing infrastructure, centralized identity/SSO, or brought a second cloud under governance. - Enjoy building internal platform and self-service experiences for other engineers. - Are genuinely deep in at least one—ideally two—of the three strength areas below (and tell us which is your center of gravity): - Tooling & ecosystem: You’re intimately familiar with the breadth of AWS services in general, and IAM/SSO in particular. You know their Well-Architected Framework, and when to reach outside. You have working knowledge of GCP. You use IaC routinely and have run it in production, whichever tool. You’ve probably collaborated with auditors on meeting compliance requirements. - Software engineering: You write real production code (Go, Rust, or a comparable systems language), and can build reliable, maintainable services. You thrive across all stages of the SDLC, set technical direction, know how to de-risk projects, and produce written artifacts such as RFCs. - Operations: You’ve run production infrastructure yourself: carried the pager, written the alerts and runbooks, used SLOs or similar to decide what to fix first, and made shared systems less risky over time. You like owning systems, simplifying complex infrastructure problems, and turning best practices into reusable building blocks. - Are comfortable treating infrastructure as software and have relevant experience with IaC and automation. - Communicate clearly, work with a wide range of stakeholders, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams. - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and iterating toward better systems over time. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Product Design Lead
description: Fuel50 is a workforce transformation platform helping organisations understand workforce capability, build skills and enable internal mobility in an AI-driven world. Our products combine skills intelligence, talent marketplace experiences and responsible AI to help people and organisations take their next step.Â We are looking for a Product Design Lead to shape the next chapter of our product experience and design organisation.Â This is a senior player-coach role. You will lead and develop our product design team while staying close to the work, setting direction, shaping product strategy, prototyping ideas and helping teams ship high-quality experiences.Â You will work closely with Product and Engineering as a leadership trio, influencing decisions across the organisation and helping Fuel50 build products that are simple, trusted and valuable.Â If youâre a strategic design leader who still loves getting close to the work, developing people and shipping real product, weâd love to hear from you!Â What you'll do: Lead, manage and coach our product designers, supporting their growth and helping them reach their next level.Â Set and communicate a clear product design vision across Fuel50's skills intelligence, talent mobility and AI-powered experiences, and tell the story of where our products are going in a way that excites customers, colleagues and leadership.Â Own the design direction without waiting for it to be handed to you. Spot opportunities, form a point of view, and prototype ideas to make them tangible.Â Bring a strong point of view to senior conversations, challenge assumptions constructively and influence decisions across the business.Â Partner with Product and Engineering from discovery through to delivery, balancing customer value, design quality, technical reality and pace.Â Design human-centred AI experiences with appropriate trust, explainability, user control and clear handoffs, including agent and assistant experiences that work across multiple surfaces such as the Fuel50 platform, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.Â Grow our design engineering capability, and be comfortable building and shipping working prototypes or code yourself.Â Evolve our design system, accessibility standards (including WCAG compliance) and design-to-code practices so Fuel50 feels coherent and high quality across every product.Â Shape design team structure, capability, hiring, planning and ways of working as the organisation evolves.Â What you'll bring: Experience in product design in a SaaS or technology environment (we suggest 7 or more years), including at least 2 years leading, managing or coaching designers, and a track record of building healthy, high-performing teams.Â Strong product design craft across discovery, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, research and shipped digital products.Â Experience designing complex, connected systems and journeys for multiple personas, ideally in an enterprise or B2B product.Â The ability to think big and set a compelling vision, while staying pragmatic about what can be learned and shipped next.Â The ability to originate ideas and direction, and to communicate them clearly through stories, prototypes and design narrative.Â Confidence working with experienced senior stakeholders and influencing through clarity, judgement and strong communication.Â Experience working closely with Product and Engineering as a genuine cross-functional trio.Â Technical fluency and a willingness to get into the code. You should be comfortable building working prototypes using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or similar tools, and have contributed code that has shipped to production, for example front-end changes or design system components submitted through pull requests.Â Hands-on experience using AI coding and design tools, such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, to prototype faster and ship real work. We want someone who uses these tools well and can show how they have changed the way their team works.Â Working knowledge of accessibility and WCAG. You have designed to WCAG standards, tested for it, and built accessibility into your team's design system and review process.Â An interest in design systems and data-informed decision-making.Â You do not need to tick every box. We care about the quality of your thinking, the way you work with people and your ability to turn ambitious ideas into better product experiences.Â All Fuellies are a core part of our culture and making Fuel50 an amazing place to work. Some additional benefits are:Â Â A day off on your birthday and your Fuel50 anniversaryÂ A âReFuel Dayâ once a quarter to relax and refuelÂ Remote work and flexible work times - we're supportive of school commitments, traveling in off-peak hours, and attending to lifeâs eventsÂ A progressive parental leave policyÂ Comprehensive fully subsidised health insurance with Southern CrossÂ What's it like to be a Fuellie? Fuel50âs team is fully remote, with an HQ in New Zealand, and team members across five countries. We have a co-working space in the BHive in Takapuna that we use to meet occasionally for team and strategic planning and other team events. If youâre based outside of Auckland and are needed on-site for anything, weâll pay for you to get here.Â We know that having the right people with the right attitude and behaviour is a big part of what makes us successful.Â Living our values is an important part of being successful in this role.Â Â We have a culture around continuous and respectful feedback and recognition - be part of a team working towards a common goal and helping each other every step of the way.Â Â We have #SuperheroAwards at quarterly planning meetings and spontaneous recognition and shout-outs across the business.Â Â We'll have your back when you need help - your colleagues want to see you succeed and work hard to help you do so.Â Â We work hard and deliver amazing results to our clients - when you see our amazing feedback, you'll be proud to be a Fuellie.Â Application process: If this sounds like you, then please apply. If youâre not sure you're ready or perhaps you don't meet all requirements yet, please apply anyway. We'll review every application that we get.Â Â Please include a link to your portfolio or attach it as part of your application.Â This role is based in New Zealand, candidates must hold the relevant right to work in NZ i.e. Citizenship or a work visa at the time of application.Â Please mention the word **GLOWING** and tag RNTIuMTYxLjU2LjY2 when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNTIuMTYxLjU2LjY2). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

title: Data Director, Payments
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or UK Remote | 💰 £150,000 - £200, 000 + Equity +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a> </p> <p><br><strong>About our Data Discipline </strong></p> <p>We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.</p> <p>Our Data discipline is centralised, but deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers and Analysts work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers, Marketers and other specialists. This means Data is not a downstream service: we help shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.</p> <h2><strong>Our Payments team ⭐</strong></h2> <p>At Monzo, payments are more than just moving money from A to B. They are a core part of how customers experience trust, speed, and financial control every day. As a Data Director in Payments, you would help shape seamless local payment experiences, ensuring customers can pay and get paid reliably while continuing to modernise the infrastructure that powers millions of transactions behind the scenes.</p> <p>The role also sits at the intersection of Monzo’s broader ambition to build truly borderless banking and expand into new markets. That means designing products and payment capabilities that work effortlessly across geographies, currencies, and customer needs, while helping Monzo scale into new markets with the same simplicity and transparency that defines the brand today.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Design to help shape Monzo’s payments strategy to make Monzo's global ambitions a reality, enabling revenue and customer growth with a resilient, self-serve banking platform. </p> <p>To succeed, you should be excited about solving tough, ambiguous business problems with analytical rigour, commercial viability and execution effectiveness<br><br></p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day </strong></p> <ul> <li>Establish yourself as a trusted member of the Payments Leadership team, enabling better decisions across Payments and the wider Data Discipline</li> <li>Co-drive Payments strategy and product decisions with Product and Engineering, bringing Data into discovery early to shape priorities and challenge thinking</li> <li>Identify untapped opportunities for commercial optimisation, including across pricing, commercialisation, investment and customer growth</li> <li>Set the data strategy for Payments, including the operating model, team priorities, architecture, technical debt and key metrics and drivers</li> <li>Translate between technical, product and commercial perspectives to help teams make clear, high-impact decisions</li> <li>Develop and scale a high-performing team of data professionals sharing accountability for product and business outcomes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <p>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</p> <ul> <li>You have experience driving payments innovation and product strategy forward in a fast-growing business</li> <li>You combine deep Data expertise with strong product and commercial judgement. </li> <li>You can move comfortably from detailed metrics or architecture discussions to customer strategy, pricing and business outcomes</li> <li>You are an empathetic people leader who can build trust quickly, raise the performance bar and retain excellent talent</li> <li>You have experience growing and leading a full stack data team, including individual contributors and managers across Data Science, Analytics Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering and Analytics</li> <li>You have experience collaborating with senior cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing and risk/control functions</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>The Interview Process</strong></p> <p>After an informal ~30 min recruiter call, our interview process involves 2 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!</p> <ol> <li><strong>Initial Call (1 hour)</strong> You'll meet with one of our senior data leaders.</li> <li><strong>Loop Stage</strong> - This is one stage with 4 interviews (totalling 4 hours) split between a collaboration with one of our engineers on a technical exercise, as well as behavioural and leadership interviews. You can have this all in one day or split these across multiple days, whichever your prefer.</li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on tech-hiring@monzo.com</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <h3><strong>What’s in it for you</strong></h3> <p>💰Base salary £150, 000 - £200, 000 + Equity + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> </p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK  </p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>#LI-AL1 #LI-REMOTE</p> <p><a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"><strong><br><br></strong></a></p> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Talent Sourcer

Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: We're looking to hire a new Talent Sourcer in Tokyo to build top-of-funnel talent pipelines and shape talent strategy across our Go-To-Market (GTM) organization. In this role, you'll partner with regional leadership to fill critical GTM roles like Solutions Consultants https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/notion/15dde0f5-b3fd-4d46-8ec2-0858ebdd888d and Outcomes Architects https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/notion/7030916f-4277-45db-9fed-644bb3fba059 primarily in Japan. WHAT YOU'LL DO: - You'll manage the sourcing process from inception through successful close, ensuring an exceptional experience for candidates and hiring managers at every step - You'll serve as a strategic advisor and talent sourcing expert, leading successful searches across GTM roles - You'll conduct initial qualification screenings and casual chats with candidates to assess fit and build relationships - You'll collaborate with the broader team on process improvements, programs, and strategic initiatives - You'll lead talent branding initiatives, including organizing hiring webinars and publishing blogs and articles that feature our employees - You'll provide talent mapping and market insights to support local and global recruiting and hiring teams - You'll make informed data-driven decisions that build efficiencies into the sourcing process - You'll find creative and unconventional ways to help us build a diverse top-of-funnel for GTM roles across all levels - You'll help build and manage partnerships to bring more underrepresented talent to Notion - You'll advance our Inclusion, Diversity, Equity, and Accessibility (I.D.E.A) strategy, working to build more diverse and inclusive teams WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - title: Ubuntu Linux Kernel Engineer - Silicon Enablement
description: <p>Ubuntu Linux is already the most popular Linux distribution in the world, and its mission is to remain at the forefront of the global software ecosystem. As the industry evolves, we are expanding our support for a wider array of System on Chip (SoC) platforms to ensure that every user receives a high-performance and reliable experience. There is growing and vital demand from major silicon manufacturers such as NVIDIA, AMD, Qualcomm, MediaTek, and Renesas to provide Ubuntu Linux as the foundational platform for their next-generation hardware.</p> <p>The Canonical Kernel Team is responsible for the build, maintenance, and distribution of the Linux kernel for Ubuntu. We are looking for engineers who share our passion for building high-quality, robust software foundations that others can rely upon. This role sits at a critical junction in the software stack, ensuring that the underlying hardware is seamlessly integrated, optimized and prepared to meet the demands of modern computing.</p> <p>While direct experience with the Linux kernel would be an advantage, it is not a hard requirement. Candidates with RTOS or bare-metal experience and demonstrable hardware experience are encouraged to apply.</p> <p>We welcome applications from engineers at various stages of their careers, from those beginning their journey in hardware-level development to seasoned industry veterans.</p> <h2><strong>Location</strong></h2> <p>This is a globally remote role.</p> <h2><strong>What the role entails</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Drive the integration of platform support from our silicon partners into the Ubuntu Linux kernel</li> <li>Lead the identification and resolution of complex kernel issues reported by partners, customers, or discovered through rigorous testing</li> <li>Own the delivery of distinct, silicon-optimized variants of the Ubuntu Linux kernel to the global community</li> <li>Develop and refine the tooling and automation required for the reliable delivery and testing of our kernels</li> <li>Manage the submission and review process for upstream patches, collaborating effectively with both internal and external maintainers</li> <li>Identify new methodologies and strategies for maximizing performance on partner silicon</li> <li>Collaborate proactively within a globally distributed engineering team to ensure cohesive outcomes across the organization</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Proficiency in C programming, particularly for low-level system development</li> <li>A strong grasp of device drivers, BSPs, and other aspects of hardware-level system engineering</li> <li>Deep understanding of operating system kernel fundamentals</li> <li>Professional proficiency with Git for version control and collaborative development</li> <li>Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal, within a professional context</li> <li>A professional approach to collaborating with business partners and the open-source community</li> <li>Ability to travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks in length</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience with Python or Bash scripting for automation and tooling</li> <li>Prior experience working with major SoC families (e.g., NVIDIA, Intel, AMD, Qualcomm, MediaTek, Renesas)</li> <li>Familiarity with Ubuntu, Debian, or Snap packaging</li> <li>Demonstrated expertise in Linux kernel patching and debugging</li> <li>A deep understanding of performance optimization techniques for silicon platforms</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer you</strong></h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Home-based work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About Canonical</strong></h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h2><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. </p> <p><a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-remote</p>

title: Graduate Software Engineer, Open Source and Linux, Canonical Ubuntu
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring <strong>2025 and 2026 Graduate Software Engineers</strong> into engineering teams around the world. As a global platform company we offer a wide range of software engineering challenges, in both open source products and commercial business systems. We have teams that work in a variety of languages, typically Python, Golang, Rust, C/C++, JavaScript and of course... Bash. We work from the very lowest levels of the Linux system - BIOS and boot loaders, firmware, kernel and drivers, all the way up to desktop applications and containers. We work on tiny devices like the Raspberry Pi and new RISC-V boards, all the way up to supercomputers, clouds and Kubernetes clusters. We work on compilers and toolchains, and we work on security, cryptography, performance and documentation. Some of our teams focus on packaging thousands of pieces of software, others focus on deep contributions to a single body of code.</p> <p>If you are excited about the potential that open source has for humanity and the enterprise, you have outstanding results in your academic career, and you are excited to contribute to the open source stack, this is the best way to apply to Canonical. We will work with you to identify teams and projects that would be interesting and a good fit for your skills and motivations. The process is highly competitive, it will require effort and excellence to succeed if you apply here.</p> <p>Most of our engineering teams work from home. We try to align a single team in a single time zone - EMEA (Europe, Middle East and Africa), APAC (Asia Pacific and Indian Ocean), and AMER (North, South and Central Americas). Even though you work from home, we try to ensure you always have colleagues alongside to coach and mentor you, and for the companionship of shared problem solving and pair programming. Larger projects have multiple teams and might span the globe. We work with the open source community and specialize in building teams that work well in the 'fishbowl' of open source engineering. This is full time work, five days a week, often solving hard problems with significant responsibility. We don't generally work weekends and nights and we do enjoy good holidays but we also expect productive and intense engagement Monday to Friday.</p> <p>We bring all our engineering teams together in person twice a year for a deep 'sprint' with other teams to stimulate discussion and enable a wide range of career development paths. This is a fantastic way to demonstrate and develop your skill in software, learn about a wide range of technologies, make a meaningful impact to open source, and see some very interesting new cities that you might never otherwise get to visit.</p> <p>If you find the open source stack amazing, and you have been a consistent high-performing student in your school and university, then this will be a challenging and exciting start to your career.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This is a Globally remote role.</p> <h3>The role entails</h3> <ul> <li>Shaping the roadmap for your product at global sprints every six months</li> <li>Focusing on design and user experience, even for developer tooling and command line apps</li> <li>Writing high quality, resilient and performant code, potentially serving millions of demanding daily users</li> <li>Working towards mastery of key programming languages and Linux system knowledge</li> <li>Engaging with users and the open source community through code reviews and issue trackers</li> <li>Responding to customer issues as a priority, develop an understanding of enterprise requirements</li> <li>Developing skills and awareness of security in software design and implementation</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Mathematics or another STEM discipline with programming courses</li> <li>Confidence to get started and deliver high quality code in one of Python, Rust, C/C++, Golang, JavaScript or Java</li> <li>Experience with Ubuntu or another Linux distribution</li> <li>Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results</li> <li>Result-oriented and organized, with the drive to meet commitments</li> <li>Personal projects in technology and software engineering beyond the curriculum</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability</li> <li>Personal responsibility and accountability</li> <li>Thoughtfulness, self-awareness and the ability to reflect and develop</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3>Nice-to-have skills</h3> <ul> <li>Upstream open source contributions</li> <li>Packaging and Linux distribution contributions - Debian, Fedora, Arch, Nix or another</li> <li>Leadership and organization skills</li> <li>Presentation and writing skills</li> <li>Business and commercial interests</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. title: Head of AI Native Operations
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. About the Role We are looking for a Head of AI Native Operations to build the autonomous systems that run Supabase. Supabase is building an AI-native internal operating system, where agents carry the operational load end to end. We are standing up a new central team to build that platform and run it in production. This is the role that leads it, and it is hands-on. You design the architecture, build the first versions of the critical pieces, and are accountable for whether every agent we run is correct, safe, and improving over time. We build rather than buy, and there are no settled best practices for most of this yet, so you will be setting them. You will lead a team of senior individual contributors extending the platform and driving adoption across teams. What You’ll Be Responsible For In this role, you’ll: - Own the agent platform architecture: The harness and orchestration layer and connectors into company systems, shared context and memory, and the path from prototype to production. - Catch regressions before they ship: Model, prompt, and tool changes can’t ship until they pass the evals. When a new model comes out, you know within hours whether to adopt it. - Make every agent observable: Every run and every decision is traced. For any agent at any time, you can answer what it did, why, what it cost, and how its quality is trending. - Own safety and trust: Design the controls that let agents act without a human in the loop: least-privilege credentials, hard policy limits, escalation thresholds, audit logs, sandboxing, and prompt-injection defenses. - Replace workflows, don’t assist them: Pick the workflows agents can fully own today and take them to production. - Turn wins into a platform: Package what works into reusable components, templates, and eval harnesses so other teams can ship their own production agents without starting from scratch. - Build and direct the team: Hire and grow senior ICs, review their designs and pull requests, and hold the quality bar. - Measure what matters: Track workflows automated, eval pass rates, cost per run, and work absorbed against the hiring plan. How You’ll Think A Point of View on Where Automation Wins You have a thesis about how AI and automation change the way a company operates, and it comes from building, not reading. You can look at a business and say which workflows agents can own today, which they will own in 12 months as models improve, and which still need people, and why. You defend that view with evidence from systems you have shipped, and you update it when the evals tell you to. Eval-Driven You don’t trust an agent because the demo looked good. You trust it because it passes a test set of real cases, and you know which cases it fails. When anything changes, your first question is “what do the evals say?” Inversion Thinking Left alone, an autonomous system tends to fail quietly, or people route around it. So the first question about any agent isn’t “does it work on the happy path?” but “how will this break, and how will we know?” The design follows from that answer: what the agent is never allowed to do, what it escalates, and which alert fires when quality drifts. Recursive Thinking Every system you build should produce the evidence that grades it. An agent isn’t done when it works. It’s done when it tells you, without you in the loop, that it has stopped working. Must Have - Hands-on agent building: Have personally designed and built autonomous agent or LLM systems that ran in production and that others depended on. Prototypes, demos, and configuring a vendor tool don’t count. You don’t need to be a career software engineer, but you must have built these systems yourself. - Architecture depth: Can explain how the pieces fit together (orchestration, tool and data access, context and memory, tracing, evals, guardrails, deployment), with opinions on current frameworks. - Security judgment: Have shipped agents that take real actions with real permissions, and designed the controls that made that safe. - A tested point of view: Can argue, with examples from your own builds, where autonomous systems create real business leverage and where they don’t yet. - Technical leadership: Have led senior builders and set the quality bar through design and code review. Strong Signal - Have replaced a human-run business workflow (finance, operations, support, release management) end to end with an autonomous system. - Are native to Git, Markdown, and pull requests, and comfortable reading and writing Python or TypeScript. - Have taken an internal platform from zero to adoption by teams you did not control. - A software engineering background is a plus, but not required. What Success Looks Like - Six months: 20+ autonomous agents in production on the shared platform, each with an eval suite, tracing, and a named owner. - Regressions get caught, not discovered: Quality problems surface in an alert or dashboard before a user reports them. - Workflows replaced, not assisted: Multiple high-volume workflows are fully owned by agents, with humans handling only escalations. - Trusted by default: No agent causes material financial, security, or customer harm, and every agent’s permissions and actions can be audited. - Teams ship their own: At least three teams outside the core team run production agents built on the platform. - Autonomous team: Your two reports work independently, and you spend your time on architecture and review rather than execution. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. title: Staff Data Scientist
location: Barcelona; Cardiff, London or Remote (UK); London
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><h4>📍 London or Barcelona | UK remote | 💰 £124,400 - 165,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> | <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology">Technology</a> — <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/data">Data</a></h4> <p>We’re looking for a Staff Data Scientist excited to help build the bank of the future. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who combines deep technical expertise with strong commercial judgement and can apply both to Monzo’s most important and complex challenges.</p> <p>At Monzo, we’re building a bank that is fair, transparent and a delight to use. We’re growing extremely fast and have over 11 million customers in the UK. We’ve built a product that people love and more than 80% of our growth comes from word of mouth and referrals.</p> <p><em>Enable Monzo to Make Better Decisions, Faster</em></p> <p>We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. And we’re great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker, which gives data scientists the headspace to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.</p> <p>As a Staff Data Scientist, you’ll lead efforts on strategically important, business-critical problems. You’ll apply judgement in areas of organisational or technical complexity, steward initiatives end-to-end, and focus your hands-on contribution where it can create the greatest impact. You’ll be a trusted technical partner to senior leaders, raise the bar for Data Science across Monzo, and build capability in others through coaching, reusable approaches and clear standards.</p> <h4><strong>Our Data Science team ⭐</strong></h4> <p>We are excited to be expanding and are hiring across our Data Science teams. Whether your interests lie in Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Fincrime, Wealth or Core, we are looking for versatile people who can contribute across squads and collectives. While we allocate teams after the interview process, we aim to match your skills and aspirations with the most suitable role. Throughout the process, you will meet team members from across our Data Science collectives, who will guide you through the opportunities available. Join us and be part of shaping our future!</p> <h4><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Shape and lead the data strategy for a large domain or collective, connecting customer and commercial goals to a clear portfolio of high-impact Data Science work</li> <li>Identify, frame and lead strategically important problems where the path is ambiguous, dependencies span teams, and decisions involve meaningful customer, commercial, regulatory or operational trade-offs</li> <li>Partner with senior leaders across product, engineering, ML, design, research, risk and operations, bringing an independent technical perspective that influences strategy and turns it into measurable outcomes</li> <li>Establish measurement strategies and metric maps that clarify how customer behaviour, product changes and business outcomes connect, enabling teams to test assumptions and make better decisions faster</li> <li>Set and evolve best practices for experimentation, causal inference, forecasting, optimisation and decision science, choosing methods that are proportionate to the decision and its risks</li> <li>Remain hands-on where your expertise is most valuable: exploring complex data, designing analyses and experiments, building models or prototypes, and resolving the hardest technical questions</li> <li>Steward critical data products and initiatives end-to-end, ensuring they are robust, well-governed, clearly documented and adopted by the people who need them</li> <li>Balance pace and analytical rigour, making pragmatic trade-offs while protecting the quality, reproducibility and interpretability of your work</li> <li>Raise Data Science standards across Monzo through technical direction, proposals, reviews, reusable methods and thoughtful challenge</li> <li>Coach and mentor data scientists and analytics engineers, using live projects and wider discipline initiatives to build sustainable capability beyond your own individual output</li> </ul> <h4><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h4> <ul> <li>You have an exceptional track record of leading complex, business-critical Data Science work from ambiguous problem framing through to measurable outcomes</li> <li>You have shaped strategy across a large product or business domain and can influence senior leaders through clear, independent judgement</li> <li>You bring deep expertise across several Data Science disciplines and can set the technical direction for work involving significant complexity, uncertainty or risk</li> <li>You repeatedly create clarity across organisational boundaries, resolve difficult dependencies and turn long-term strategy into decisive action</li> <li>You communicate complex ideas, assumptions and risks with clarity, and hold a consistently high bar for analytical quality, governance and reproducibility</li> <li>You remain a highly credible hands-on practitioner with SQL and Python, while raising standards and multiplying the impact of experienced colleagues</li> </ul> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves:</p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Call</li> <li>Initial Call</li> <li>Technical assessment</li> <li>Final Interviews <ul> <li>Business Fit/Collaboration</li> <li>Case Study</li> <li>Technical Interview</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>Our average process takes around 2–3 weeks, but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process.</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>For more insight into the hiring experience at Monzo, check out our blog post written by one of our Recruiters - <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/2022/03/21/data-hiring-at-monzo">Data Hiring at Monzo</a>.</p> <h4><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></h4> <p><strong>💰 £124,400 - £165,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits</strong></p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK or Spain</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍 This role can be based in our London or Barcelona offices, but we’re also open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕ And much more - see our full list of <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">benefits</a>.</p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we’ll make this happen whenever we can — whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Security Engineer, Detection and Response
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Millions of people rely on Notion to do their most important work, and protecting that trust is foundational to everything we build. We’re looking for a hands-on Detection Engineer to build and operate the systems and workflows we use to detect and respond to attacks across Notion’s cloud-native environment. You’ll ship high-signal detections, improve the platform that powers them, participate in incident response, and help shape how detection and response engineering scales at Notion. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Corporate Security, and Infrastructure, with broad latitude to identify gaps, prioritize investments, and build what’s needed next. We view detection and response as a software engineering discipline: detections are code, platforms are products, and measurement matters WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Build and tune high-signal detections across cloud, identity, endpoint, and SaaS environments, with review and mentorship from senior teammates as you ramp up. - Contribute to the detection platform, including rule lifecycle management, tuning, measurement, and rollout safety. - Build tooling and automation that speed up triage, enrichment, investigation, and detection authoring, including LLM-based workflows where useful. - Turn threat intelligence and adversary TTPs into detections, telemetry requirements, and response improvements. - Take part in investigations, incident response, and postmortems, and help turn what we learn into lasting fixes. - Help define and track metrics such as coverage, MTTD, and alert quality. - Join a shared on-call rotation for incident response. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING - We're hiring across a range of experience levels. If you have some of these skills but not all, we'd still like to hear from you. - 3+ years of experience in detection engineering, security operations, incident response, threat hunting, or a closely related security or software engineering role. - Have written or tuned detections that run in production, and care about signal quality and cutting noise. - Working knowledge of at least one detection or query language (Sigma, KQL, SPL, YARA-L, EQL, or Panther), or strong SQL or Python skills and the drive to learn one quickly. - An understanding of how attackers operate (for example, MITRE ATT&CK), and the ability to use it to decide what to detect. - Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, ideally including identity and access logs. - Have used SIEM, EDR, or SOAR tools in any size of environment. - Write clearly in runbooks, design docs, and incident notes, and can own well-scoped projects end to end. NICE TO HAVE - Have led purple team, blue team, or adversary emulation exercises that improved detections or telemetry. - Experience running SIEM, EDR, or SOAR platforms at large scale. - Experience building or maintaining detection-as-code workflows (version control, CI, and tests for detections). - Experience applying LLMs or agent-style tooling to security workflows. - Experience securing AI-enabled systems or endpoint tooling. - Kubernetes or container detection experience. - Background in threat intelligence, malware analysis, or digital forensics. - Contributions to the security community through research, tooling, CTFs, or talks. - Experience at a high-growth startup or AI company. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $185,000 - $280,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550 and and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Credit Risk Oversight Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£79,900 - £95,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨</p> <p><strong>Our Credit Oversight team⭐</strong></p> <p>Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and with the planned launch of new initiatives. As our lending portfolio grows, our second line of defence Credit Risk Oversight team is growing with it - and we’re looking for a Credit Risk Oversight Manager to join us!</p> <p>Our Credit Risk Oversight team is crucial in providing support and challenge to our Borrowing teams in the first line of defence to help Monzo grow safely. We’re looking for someone (maybe you?!) with proven experience in consumer credit risk who likes getting into the details and analysing data to deliver independent assurance - and challenge - of credit risk management across the lifecycle. </p> <p>Ideally you’ll have experience and in-depth knowledge of retail unsecured or small business credit risk strategy within financial services. You’ll have seen first-hand how a credit portfolio performs at different stages of the credit cycle, and have hands-on experience in shaping or overseeing lending strategies. You’ll have a collaborative approach, and be comfortable working across a broad range of stakeholders. You’ll also be someone who likes getting into the details, analysing data and providing constructive challenges.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p><strong>Providing ongoing oversight of credit risk - this includes analysing and understanding the performance of our existing lending products, developing and enhancing monitoring metrics and providing input to relevant committees and forums  </strong></p> <ul> <li>Partnering with our first line of defence teams to support credit strategy changes - including new product launches and pilots - ensuring that we deliver magical lending products for our customers while meeting our Risk Appetite</li> <li>Delivering deep insight, feedback and challenge on our credit strategies - including data-driven analysis and actionable counter-proposals - to support management decision making and shaping better outcomes for our customers</li> <li>Leading second line assurance work on thematic reviews</li> <li>Collaborating with our model validation and model development teams to ensure understanding of the models that underpin our credit strategies</li> <li>Providing credit expertise and input into relevant strategic projects and critical Monzo-wide processes, such as stress-testing and forecasting</li> <li>Supporting us in maintaining our Credit Risk Framework and making sure it is well embedded within the business</li> <li>Taking a balanced and proportionate approach to risk management, making sure that managing risks becomes part of everyone at Monzo’s day-to-day role</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you …</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have a strong background in credit risk management within consumer or small business lending - experience in unsecured product, such as credit cards, loans or overdrafts would be particularly beneficial</li> <li>Have proven analytical skills, and can use these to interrogate data, build monitoring and look for early indicators of trends</li> <li>Have hands-on experience and/or understanding of how to use credit risk scorecards and NPV models to develop strategies for making credit decisions</li> <li>Have a solid technical toolkit; SQL or similar is a must-have, and experience using a data visualisation tool (such as Looker, PowerBI or Tableau) is a plus</li> <li>Are excited to explore how we can use AI tools to improve our credit and risk management processes</li> <li>Can convey problems and solutions using clear and simple language, both written and verbal (see <a href="https://monzo.com/tone-of-voice/">Monzo’s tone of voice</a> guide). This is particularly important for communicating complex issues and priorities to non-experts</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Have a track record of building and maintaining trusting relationships with stakeholders, while providing effective and respectful challenge</li> <li>Are passionate about technology, and what we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply - even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £79,900-95,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>An initial call with our recruiter</li> <li>A call with one of our Credit Risk Oversight Managers, the hiring manager(s) for the role </li> <li>A take-home task</li> <li>Two competency, based interviews - one role specific technical interview and one behaviours and values interview</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 4-8 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>#LI-TK1<strong><br><br></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Director Payment Integrity
description: Job Title: Director, Payment Integrity Reports To: Vice President, Operations This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers. The ability to interact with all levels of SIHO staff and external parties with a high level of professionalism, while adapting quickly between multiple high priority items, is essential. Brief Description of Duties: Directly supervise and manage the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams, including day to day oversight, staffing, and performance management Read, research, and interpret federal and state regulations governing grievances and appeals, and translate regulatory requirements into practical, actionable process changes Continuously monitor and improve grievances and appeals processes to ensure ongoing compliance with CMS and state regulatory requirements Support the claims and benefit configuration quality assurance program, including developing and delivering training and education for staff Stay current on emerging fraud, waste, and abuse trends and lead efforts to proactively identify and investigate potential FWA Review results across all three departments and identify process improvement initiatives and cost savings opportunities Analyze department and operational data in Excel to identify trends and draw actionable insights Manage data transfers with vendor partners, meet with vendors regularly to ensure processes are working as intended, and escalate potential issues as they arise Interact directly with customers as needed Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others Develop, maintain, and report statistical measurements assessing the effectiveness of the QA, FWA, and G&A programs Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C Reporting and ODAG, and others as assigned Minimum Skills Requirement: B.S. degree or equivalent work experience in a healthcare operation 3-5 years experience in a managed care environment Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to grievances and appeals, including CMS and state Department of Insurance requirements Experience across Medicare Advantage, ACA, employer group/TPA, and MEWA products preferred Demonstrated ability to lead and manage people and teams, while also directly supervising staff on a daily basis Proficient in Excel with the ability to analyze data and draw actionable insights Thorough understanding of medical and health plan terminology; familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding a plus Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate with all levels of management as well as external entities, vendors, and customers Ability to work successfully at a self-directed pace in a changing, fast-paced, high demand environment, adapting quickly between competing high priority items Ability to work successfully under tight deadlines Experience with SIHO systems including the HSP claims system Proficient in Microsoft Office suite products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook All positions are subject to change based on the needs of the business. \n \n Please mention the word **GRACIOUSNESS** and tag RNTIuMTYxLjU2LjY2 when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNTIuMTYxLjU2LjY2). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.</p> <p>These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️</p> <p>Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life:</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.</p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency 🕣✨</p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.</p> <p><strong>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product</li> <li>you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day</li> <li>you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions</li> <li>you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity</li> <li>you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software</li> <li>you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).</li> <li>you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing</li> </ul> <p>We're on the look out for L40 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-1.pdf">Engineering Progression Framework</a> you will be interviewed across the whole framework, so if you're not sure what level you're aiming for chat to your recruiter! </p> <p><em>Not ticking every box? href="http://cassandra.apache.org/"><strong>Cassandra</strong></a> for most persistent data storage</li> <li><a href="http://kafka.apache.org/"><strong>Kafka</strong></a> for our asynchronous message queue</li> <li><a href="http://kubernetes.io/"><strong>Kubernetes</strong></a> and <a href="https://www.docker.com/"><strong>Docker</strong></a> to schedule and run our services </li> <li><a href="https://www.envoyproxy.io/"><strong>Envoy Proxy</strong></a> for RPC</li> <li><a href="http://aws.amazon.com/"><strong>AWS</strong></a> for most of our production infrastructure and<a href="https://cloud.google.com/"> <strong>GCP</strong></a> for most of our data infrastructure</li> <li>React for our public web apps and internal tools</li> <li>We also have physical datacenters with actual cables to connect to various third parties</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Interview Process:</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages: </p> <ol> <li>Initial Call </li> <li>Take home task or pair coding exercise </li> <li>Final interview: including a system design and a behavioural interview </li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. </p> <p>One of our engineers has written a detailed blog on their experience through this process, for extra details, hints and tips please see <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/2022/03/23/demystifying-the-backend-engineering-interview-process"><strong>here</strong></a>.</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰 <span style="font-weight: 400;">£85,000 - £110,000</span> base salary <span style="font-weight: 400;">+<strong> </strong>Incentive Awards tied to your performance</span></p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK </p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"><strong>here </strong></a></p> <p><em>We're usually always hiring for Backend Engineers, so title: Director of Product Design

Product Design is the largest discipline within the design organisation, with designers working in tight-knit squads alongside researchers, product managers, and engineers to solve real customer problems at scale.</p> <p>We design for the “magic moments.” We’ve built a bank that feels deeply human, not just functional, shaping how millions of people experience money every day. Our product is our personality. We combine research, empathy, and craft to turn everyday interactions into memorable experiences.</p> <p>Now, we’re entering our next phase of growth and looking for exceptional design leaders to help define not only Monzo’s future, but the future of banking itself.
