As a senior leader within the Design organisation, you’ll raise the quality bar and expand design’s impact, influence, and effectiveness across Monzo.</p> <p> </p> <h2>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</h2> <ul> <li>Setting the strategic direction and design vision for your area, inspiring teams to think bigger and bolder, whilst aligning with Monzo goals and mission.</li> <li>Partnering with the leadership team for your area to define priorities, shape roadmaps, and turn strategy into impactful execution.</li> <li>Building and nurturing a high-performing design team - investing in their growth, wellbeing, and long-term success.</li> <li>Maintaining an exceptional quality bar across all design work through clear feedback and coaching, helping designers and teams consistently deliver best-in-class experiences.</li> <li>Creating an environment where feedback is open, craft is celebrated, and design quality continues to evolve across the organisation.</li> <li>Acting as a champion for design at Monzo, influencing how design thinking shapes our products and culture.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if...</h2> <ul> <li>You’ve led design strategy and vision across complex product areas, helping teams navigate ambiguity and deliver meaningful customer and business impact.</li> <li>You’re comfortable operating at multiple altitudes, from defining long-term direction to driving high-quality execution.</li> <li>You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Research and Commercial, and know how to influence senior stakeholders through clarity, insight, and craft.</li> <li>You have a strong point of view on product design and consistently raise the bar for quality, systems thinking, and customer experience.</li> <li>You’ve built and led high-performing design teams, creating environments where people can grow, do exceptional work, and have meaningful impact.</li> <li>You know how to scale design influence across an organisation, shaping product direction, ways of working, and culture beyond your immediate team.</li> <li>You’re energised by Monzo’s mission to make money work for everyone, and excited to help shape the next generation of payments experiences through thoughtful, magical and innovative design. </li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2>🙌 What’s in it for you</h2> <ul> <li>💰 £140,000 - £165,000 + Equity + Benefits </li> <li>✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK</li> <li>✅ We can sponsor your visa</li> <li>📍 This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)</li> <li>⏰ Flexible working hours and trust-based work culture</li> <li>📚 £1,000 annual learning budget for books, training, and conferences</li> <li>🏡 Full remote setup support, including equipment and workspace essentials</li> <li>➕ Plus lots more!</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-TR1</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. We hire on a pipeline based approach which means your application will be considered across all of our open EM positions. We use the interview process to assess your strengths and we'll match you to a role that best aligns with your experience. Of course, this is a collaborative process so you can also tell us which roles you're most interested in as you progress through interviews 😊 We're currently hiring across Platform, Core App, and Expansion.</p> <p><strong>You’ll spend your time:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Taking accountability for delivery across your squad(s), collaborating with the Technical Lead and Product Manager.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Actively fostering a high bar for engineering excellence within your teams. You’re accountable for the technical outcomes your teams deliver alongside individual engineer performance and growth, so holding a high bar (and clearly articulating your expectations) is key.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You’ll initially lead a group of around 7-10 engineers (depending on the role) and support, coach and develop them through their career with regular 1:1s and continuous feedback.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Partner with senior engineers in your area to drive technical initiatives that raise the bar for our engineering practices.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Lead on communication with stakeholders from other teams, creating focus space for engineers to do their best work.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Collaborate with the wider engineering organisation to contribute to company-wide best managerial and technical practices and standards.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">While this is not a role which requires hands-on-coding, we are looking for an experienced manager who has a strong technical and delivery background and </span><strong>has worked as a software engineer in previous roles.</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We recognise that engineering managers lead in different ways, we’re looking for someone who: </span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Is comfortable operating with ambiguous problem areas with a high degree of autonomy.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">It’s a bonus if you have experience working in an experimentation led environment.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Has delivery experience and is able to guide the squads in achieving their outcomes.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Focuses on outcomes over processes, who optimises for the highest impact and leverage.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Is able to input, understand and challenge engineering decisions - but to empower the team to make those decisions themselves</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Has an understanding of what good looks like for a high-performing team of engineers and ability to chart a course to get there</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Is able to to coach people to achieve their goals</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Has a natural ability to inspire and motivate a team</span></li> </ul> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">We consider your application across all open EM roles at Monzo independent of which role you've applied for, so </span></em><strong><em>if you've recently applied to a similar role at Monzo and have been unsuccessful, please wait 6 months before applying again.<br><br></em></strong></p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. Monzo Business Banking is fast-growing, is the UK’s most recommended business account for overall service quality. We recently hit 1 million customers and are used by 1 in 6 UK SMEs.</p> <p>We want to help businesses spend less time on financial admin and more time focused on running and growing their business. We’re building intelligent, data-driven and AI/ML-enabled product experiences that help small businesses feel more in control, make better decisions, and get more value from Monzo.</p> <p>ML is at the core of how we build and scale our products, enabling Monzo to make better decisions, faster, and helping us serve businesses more effectively.</p> <p>As a Lead Machine Learning Scientist in Business Banking, you’ll help build and ship models that power the next generation of Business Banking experiences. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Research, Data Science and Analytics Engineering to bring ML-enabled product capability into the heart of how we build for businesses.</p> <p>Whether it’s helping businesses understand their cash flow, reducing manual admin, surfacing the right insight at the right moment, or helping teams build intelligent product experiences responsibly, our work makes business banking smarter, simpler and more useful for SMEs.</p> <p> </p> <h1>What you'll be working on</h1> <p>As a Lead Machine Learning Scientist, you’ll be a technical leader and hands-on individual contributor, spearheading our ML and GenAI capabilities and shipping key models that powers magical Business Banking experiences.</p> <p>You’ll:</p> <ul> <li>Be one of the first ML Scientists in Business Banking, bringing leadership through ambiguity by adding structure and direction to our ML capabilities while staying agile and building momentum.</li> <li>Develop and deploy advanced ML models on our cloud-native data platform to serve hundreds of thousands of business customers.</li> <li>Partner with Product, data science and other stakeholders to identify the highest-impact opportunities, size impact, and define success metrics.</li> <li>Decide when to use ML, GenAI, or simpler approaches and be clear on trade-offs.</li> <li>Design robust evaluation and monitoring so we can ship responsibly and measure impact in production.</li> <li>Lead the design and implementation of batch and near-real-time models (e.g. LLM-powered experiences, predictive models, time-series forecasting).</li> <li>Collaborate closely with MLOps and Backend Engineering to operationalise models end-to-end and raise the bar on ML lifecycle rigor.</li> <li>Set technical standards, mentor others, and support experimentation and iteration.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h1>You should apply if</h1> <p>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</p> <ul> <li>You have a multiple year track record of excellence leading the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning models to tackle real business problems, preferably in a fast-moving tech company.</li> <li>You have experience developing and shipping state-of-the-art ML models to production and delivering business impact.</li> <li>You're impact-driven and excited to own the end-to-end journey that starts with a business problem and ends with your solution having a measurable impact in production.</li> <li>You have a self-starter mindset; you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so.</li> <li>You speak Python fluently and have extensive, hands-on experience with <code>scikit-learn</code>. You are comfortable using SQL, and keen to learn Go, which is used in many of our backend microservices.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity and have experience helping your team and stakeholders resolve that ambiguity.</li> <li>You want to be involved in building a product that small businesses use to run and manage their financial lives every day.</li> <li>You have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions.</li> <li>You’re excited about fast-moving developments in Machine Learning and AI and can communicate those ideas to colleagues who are not familiar with the domain.</li> <li>You’re adaptable, curious and enjoy learning new technologies and ideas.</li> <li>You’re excited by the opportunity to help Business Banking evolve into AI and ML-enabled product capability.</li> <li>You can work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Research and Data colleagues to shape product strategy, clarify trade-offs and build things that customers actually use.</li> <li>You’re thoughtful about responsible ML/AI; especially in financial products where trust, transparency and customer control matter.</li> </ul> <h1>Nice to haves</h1> <ul> <li>Experience working on personalisation, ranking, recommendation, forecasting, classification or decisioning problems for customer-facing applications.</li> <li>Experience working on ML systems for fintech, banking, accounting, payments, lending, invoicing, cash flow, tax, risk or business software.</li> <li>Experience with GenAI, LLMs, agentic workflows, retrieval, evaluation frameworks, or human-in-the-loop product experiences.</li> <li>Commercial experience writing critical production code and working with microservices.</li> <li>Experience designing experiments, A/B tests or other approaches to measure product and customer impact.</li> <li>Experience working in regulated environments or with products where explainability, auditability and customer trust are especially important.</li> </ul> <h1>The interview process</h1> <p>Our interview process involves 3 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!</p> <p>30 minute recruiter call</p> <p>45 minute call with hiring manager</p> <p>Full Loop: ML Modelling Interview, Product & ML interview, Behavioural Interview, Leadership interview</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on <a href="mailto:tech-hiring@monzo.com">tech-hiring@monzo.com</a>. Please also use that email to let us know if there's anything we can do to make your application process easier for you, because of disability, neurodiversity or any other personal reason.</p> <h1>What’s in it for you</h1> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance</p> <p>#LI-REMOTE #LI-SR1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. You'll leverage your deep expertise to develop and deploy advanced ML models to our more than 15 million customers.</div> <div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="notion-selectable notion-text-block" data-block-id="39569fe4-26d2-80b8-8740-c2c314894362"> <div> <div> <div> <div class="x78zum5"> <div id=":rl37:" class="content-editable-leaf-rtl notranslate" data-content-editable-leaf="true"><span class="discussion-level-1 discussion-id-39569fe4-26d2-80d3-845e-001cd33a75ba notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">Your work may involve user and product embeddings to better understand customer behaviours, contextual bandits for optimising real-time decisions, or personalised ranking algorithms that improve search and discovery. You'll also build scalable, explainable, and responsible AI solutions that enhance trust, transparency, and the overall customer experience.</span></div> <div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="notion-selectable notion-text-block" data-block-id="39569fe4-26d2-803a-b699-d14b2512f916"> <div> <div> <div> <div class="x78zum5"> <div id=":rl38:" class="content-editable-leaf-rtl notranslate" data-content-editable-leaf="true"><span class="discussion-level-1 discussion-id-39569fe4-26d2-80d3-845e-001cd33a75ba notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">The technical approaches you take to help solve customer problems will be very much in your hands and we’ll strongly encourage and support experimentation and innovation. We’ll be expecting you to justify and demonstrate effectiveness along the way, making sure the approach meets our business and customer needs.</span></div> <div class="content-editable-leaf-rtl notranslate" data-content-editable-leaf="true"> </div> <div class="content-editable-leaf-rtl notranslate" data-content-editable-leaf="true"> <h2><strong>You should apply if:</strong></h2> <p>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</p> <ul> <li>You have a multiple year track record of excellence leading the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning models to tackle real business problems preferably in a fast moving tech company</li> <li>You have experience developing and shipping state of the art ML models to production and delivering business impact</li> <li>You're <em>impact driven</em> and excited to own the end to end journey that starts with a business problem and ends with your solution having a measurable impact in production</li> <li>You have a <em>self-starter mindset;</em> you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so</li> <li>You speak Python fluently and have extensive, hands-on experience with <code>scikit-learn</code>. You are comfortable using SQL, and keen to learn <a href="https://go.dev/">Go lang</a> which is used in many of our backend microservices</li> <li>You’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity and have experience helping your team and stakeholders resolve that ambiguity</li> <li>You want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day</li> <li>You have a <em>product mindset</em>: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions</li> <li>You're excited about fast-moving developments in Machine Learning and can communicate those ideas to colleagues who are not familiar with the domain</li> <li>You’re adaptable, curious and enjoy learning new technologies and ideas</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to haves:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience working on personalisation, ranking & recommendation problems for consumer applications</li> <li>Commercial experience writing critical production code and working with microservices</li> </ul> <h2><strong>The interview process:</strong></h2> <p>Our interview process involves 3 main stages. title: Lead Product Designer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Product Design makes up almost half of our design disciplines, working in tight-knit squads alongside research, product, and engineering to solve real customer problems at scale.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>We design for the "magic moments"</strong></p> <p>We’ve built a bank that feels human, not just functional. Our product <em>is</em> our personality. We blend research, empathy, and craft to turn everyday interactions into memorable experiences.</p> <p>Right now, we’re growing fast and looking for passionate designers to shape Monzo’s future and there’s a huge opportunity to make your mark.</p> <p>Applying to this role, you’ll be in a standard hiring process for a Lead Product Designer, and we’ll find the perfect team for you along the way. </p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tackling the most complex and ambiguous design challenges, turning complexity into elegant, scalable solutions that empower teams and improve the customer experience.</li> <li>Defining and delivering large-scale projects that connect initiatives across the business, using design methods to align strategies and drive impactful outcomes.</li> <li>Leading the creation of compelling product visions, principles, and direction that inspire teams to build toward a shared future.</li> <li>Using AI to level-up parts of your design workflow. Whether that’s ideation, analysis, prototyping or shipping production code to our app.</li> <li>Raising the bar for visual execution, considering motion, interaction, and mental model clarity to deliver delightful and practical solutions.</li> <li>Positively influencing our design system, tooling, and processes to improve how we create design at scale.</li> <li>Driving improvements across the business by connecting your work to wider goals and leveraging cross-functional collaboration.</li> <li>Acting as a role model in Design, sharing your work broadly, mentoring others, and contributing to the growth and success of the Design team.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a proven track record of delivering impactful, customer-centric native-app designs that solve complex problems and drive commercial outcomes.</li> <li>You’re skilled at leading research, defining product visions, and aligning teams around a shared strategy.</li> <li>You excel at creating modular, scalable solutions and have a strong grasp of how to use design artefacts to communicate insights effectively.</li> <li>You’re a natural collaborator who can navigate multi-squad projects, align leadership, and drive clarity in ambiguous situations.</li> <li>You’re passionate about improving design systems, processes, and ways of working to help teams deliver better outcomes at scale.</li> <li>You’re a role model who actively contributes to the growth of the Design team through hiring, mentoring, and fostering a positive culture.</li> <li>You’re excited about Monzo’s mission to make money work for everyone and are ready to make a significant impact on our customers and business.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £90,000 - £120,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor your visa.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!</p> <p> </p> <p>🌈<strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>30-minute call with our Recruiter</li> <li>1-hour craft interview where you’ll present a single case study to 2 members of our Design team</li> <li>2 x 45-minute interviews covering Teamwork and Impact</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>This process should take around 4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or UK Remote | 💰<a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-0.pdf"> Senior Engineer (L50)</a> £105,000 - £135,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> | <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology">Technology</a> - Engineering  </p> <p><strong>About our Engineering Teams:</strong></p> <p>We have around 650 engineers across Monzo who design and build our in-house banking platform. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.</p> <p>These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities.</p> <p>We contribute to <a href="https://github.com/monzo"><strong>open source software</strong></a> as much as possible. Our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology"><strong>blog</strong></a><strong> </strong>is a good place to learn even more about what we do!</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day   </strong></p> <p>This role is all about collaborating with your team to make a difference to your customers. As a backend engineer you’ll work in a squad alongside other disciplines like product managers, marketers, user researchers, designers, mobile engineers, web engineers, data analysts, business analysts, writers and more! </p> <p>Together you'll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). They are: Core Banking, Business Banking, Wealth, Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Platform, Fincrime, Security & Expansion. All of our collectives are doing innovative work, many of which have machine learning and AI at the forefront- from fighting financial crime to building smarter financial tools - and you may have the opportunity to join a collective that gives you direct exposure to this exciting space.</p> <p>They’re all looking for additional Backend Engineers right now, we do a standard interview process across all our collectives and at the end we will find the best match for you based on your skills, experience, preferences and aligning with the business need! </p> <p>Our backend engineers have a variety of different backgrounds. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you. We do not ask for formal qualifications or degree requirements for any of our engineering roles.</p> <p><strong>How we work 💻</strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️</p> <p>Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life:</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.</p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency 🕣✨</p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.</p> <p><strong>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product</li> <li>you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day</li> <li>you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions</li> <li>you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity</li> <li>you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software</li> <li>you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).</li> <li>you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing</li> </ul> <p>We're on the look out for L50 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-1.pdf">Engineering Progression Framework </a>- we will interview you across the whole frame work, so if you are not sure what level you are aiming for please chat to your recruiters! </p> <p><em>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything thats listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</em></p> <p><strong>What you’ll be working on: </strong></p> <p>We hire very technically agnostic so whilst we use the below technologies we do not expect prior knowledge, you will be fully supported in our organised onboarding to get up to speed in the below: </p> <ul> <li><a href="http://golang.org/"><strong>Go</strong></a> to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial <a href="https://tour.golang.org/welcome/1"><strong>here</strong></a>)</li> <li><a href="http://cassandra.apache.org/"><strong>Cassandra</strong></a> for most persistent data storage</li> <li><a href="http://kafka.apache.org/"><strong>Kafka</strong></a> for our asynchronous message description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. You will be leading across multiple teams in an org of around 20-30 people. We’re expanding and your role as the Senior EM will be to grow and build new squads as needed. Your direct reports will include Tech Leads, Senior Engineers and 2-3 Engineering Managers.<br><br>Senior Engineering Managers at Monzo are part of cross-functional, autonomous teams and groups. Our teams are mission driven, and typically include Product Managers, backend, web and mobile engineers as well as data scientists, designers and subject matter experts relevant to that mission. Teams are organised into groups, and then collectives - we aim to keep our line management structure as shallow as possible, and for teams to directly own decision making relevant to their work.</p> <p>Senior Engineering Managers are accountable for the technical and delivery outcomes for their area - that means supporting and developing best in class engineering talent, as well as creating an inclusive team environment for people to do their best work. You’ll be responsible for structuring, organising, supporting and challenging your team to deliver on their mission.</p> <p>You can read more on the expectations of Senior Engineering Managers in our <a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-manager-framework-v2-0.pdf">Progression Framework</a>.</p> <p><strong>Is this role right for you?</strong></p> <p>While this is not a role which requires hands-on-coding, we are looking for an experienced manager who has a strong technical and delivery background and has worked as a software engineer in previous roles.</p> <p>We recognise that Senior Engineering Managers lead in different ways, we’re looking for someone who is adept at: </p> <ul> <li><strong>Delivery and Execution</strong>: Enjoys taking accountability for delivery across your squad(s), collaborating with the Technical Lead and Product Manager.</li> <li><strong>Engineering and Operational Excellence</strong>: Actively fosters a high bar for engineering excellence within your teams. You’re accountable for the technical outcomes your teams deliver alongside individual engineer performance and growth, so holding a high bar (and clearly articulating your expectations) is key.</li> <li><strong>People Leadership:</strong> Has experience directly managing at least 2-3 Engineering Managers and leading orgs of around ~20 engineers. You can support, coach and develop them through their career with regular 1:1s and continuous feedback.</li> <li><strong>Technical Influence:</strong> Partners with senior engineers to drive technical initiatives that raise the bar for our engineering practices.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Relationships:</strong> Builds strong stakeholder relationships with other teams, and creates a focus space for engineers to do their best work.</li> <li><strong>Organisational Wide Impact:</strong> Collaborates with the wider engineering organisation to contribute to company-wide best managerial and technical practices and standards.</li> </ul> <p><em>We consider your application across all open EM roles at Monzo independent of which role you've applied for, so </em><strong><em>if you've recently applied to a similar role at Monzo and have been unsuccessful, please wait 6 months before applying again.<br><br></em></strong></p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <p>After an initial informal recruiter call you go through two main stages</p> <ol> <li><strong>Initial Call (1 hour)</strong> You'll meet with one of our Senior Engineering Managers or Engineering Directors. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They’ll ask example based questions (‘Tell me about a time when…’)<br><br></li> <li><strong>Loop Stage (3 hours 30 mins)</strong> The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability) and one 30 minute reverse interview (more details below).</li> </ol> <p>The Loop is one stage and the interviews in this stage are:</p> <p><em>- Team and Org Management (1 hour)</em><em><br></em>An example based interview with 1-2 of our engineering leaders. They’re interested to hear examples from your previous experience on the teams you’ve led, how you’ve shaped and partnered with product, and the impact you had.</p> <p><em>- System Design (1 hour)</em><em><br></em>You'll partner with a Staff or Principal Engineer on a technical whiteboarding exercise.</p> <p><em>- Behavioural (1 hour)</em><em><br></em>Similar to Team and Org Management, this is an example based interview with 1-2 Engineering Leaders. This interview focuses on your people leadership style and core behaviours as an Engineering Manager.</p> <p><em>- Chat with an Engineering Leader (30 mins)</em><em><br></em>At Monzo, we believe interviews are a two-way street. This will be your opportunity to ask us any questions about Monzo, engineering leadership or our teams – whatever’s on your mind. </p> <p>All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process. </p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰 £138,000 - £175,000 + Equity + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> </p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK  </p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> <strong>here</strong></a><br><br>#LI-Remote #LI-AL1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. We’re embedded in squads with PMs, Designers, and User Researchers, shaping products and propositions by acting as the voice of the market (UK, Ireland, Spain and future markets). If that’s your flavour of product marketing, Monzo is for you.</p> <p><strong>This is a senior individual contributor role.</strong> You'll own Product Marketing for a product end-to-end: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and helping bring launches to market. There are two levels of seniority available — we will determine together what best fits you during the interview process.</p> <p><strong>Where you could join:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Core </strong>is the foundation of Monzo. It's where we build the products millions of people use every day: from Current Accounts and Joint Accounts to Pots, Subscriptions, Savings Challenge, and all the moments that make managing money feel effortless. Today that includes growing products like Flex, Loans, Credit Insights, Mortgages, and Overdrafts in the UK, while also taking Monzo's Flex proposition to millions more customers across Europe. This is a role for someone excited by the challenge of growing an established proposition at home while shaping how it succeeds in new markets; understanding local customer needs, refining the proposition, and helping build the foundations for Monzo to win internationally.</li> <li><strong>Wealth </strong>is building the future of how people grow their money: helping millions of customers save, invest, and plan for retirement with the same simplicity and trust they expect from their current account. It spans Savings, Investments, Pensions, Insurance, and brand new wealth-building experiences. This is a role for someone who wants to challenge how traditional wealth products work and make growing money feel simpler, more accessible, and more rewarding for everyday customers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own Product Marketing for a Product. </strong>You'll define a 2–4 quarter Product Marketing strategy that connects customer needs, market opportunity, and product direction into a clear plan. You'll own Product Marketing across the full product lifecycle from early discovery through launches and iteration. You'll be the go-to person for understanding how your product succeeds in the market.</li> <li><strong>Become the expert on your market. </strong>You'll build a deep understanding of your customers, competitors, and category, using research, data, and experimentation to identify opportunities that influence product priorities. You'll bring the voice of the market into day-to-day product decisions and help your squad make better bets.</li> <li><strong>Define positioning customers understand. </strong>You'll create clear, differentiated positioning and messaging that helps customers understand why your product matters. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Writers, and Integrated Marketing to ensure that positioning is reflected consistently across the product experience and everything customers see.</li> <li><strong>Influence Product Strategy. </strong>You'll work alongside Product Managers, Designers, and Researchers to shape product strategy with customer and market insight. Product teams will seek your perspective before committing to product bets, and you'll help turn customer problems into products people genuinely love.</li> <li><strong>Shape successful launches. </strong>You'll design launch strategies that fit the customer problem, partner with Integrated Marketing on campaigns, and coordinate cross-functional launches across Product, Marketing, Operations, and Support. You'll measure what worked, learn quickly, and continuously improve how your product reaches customers.</li> <li><strong>Measure what matters. </strong>You'll use customer and commercial data to understand whether your work is making a difference. You'll build business cases for product decisions, measure launches against meaningful outcomes, and use what you learn to strengthen positioning, propositions, and future product decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>This is for you if: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You enjoy owning entire products.</strong> You're comfortable taking responsibility for Product Marketing across a full product experience, from customer insight through to positioning. </li> <li><strong>You solve ambiguous problems with evidence.</strong> You enjoy understanding customers, identifying market opportunities and turning insight into practical product and marketing recommendations.</li> <li><strong>You know what makes products win.</strong> You combine customer insight, market understanding and commercial thinking to build products and propositions people genuinely love.</li> <li><strong>You influence through collaboration.</strong> You enjoy working closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, Researchers and Integrated Marketing, bringing people with you through evidence rather than authority.</li> <li><strong>You're always improving and helping others improve.</strong> You seek feedback, develop your craft and contribute to making the team stronger through sharing knowledge and helping others. Mentor more junior team members informally.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>The Interview Process</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages:</p> <ul> <li>Initial Call (30mins) </li> <li>Case Study Presentation (45mins)</li> <li>x2 final interviews via Google Meet (45mins for each interview)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to hiring@monzo.com. You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you: </strong></p> <ul> <li>£70,000 - £105,000 as a base salary</li> <li>This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK </li> <li>We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</li> <li>Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences </li> <li>And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"><strong>here</strong><strong> </strong></a></li> </ul> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. <br><br>#LI-JB1 #LI-REMOTE</p> <p><strong> </strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.</p> <p><strong>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</strong></p> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 Base salary £155,000 - £200,000 + Equity</p> <p>✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor your visa. </p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! title: Staff Analytics Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>Staff Analytics Engineer - Borrowing</strong></p> <p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰 £121,600-164,600 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance and<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> benefits</a> |<a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4"> Hear from the team</a> ✨</p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Borrowing Analytics Engineering Team</strong></p> <p> </p> <p>Our mission in Borrowing is to help people achieve their financial goals through better borrowing. Our customers borrow money to achieve something in their lives — whether that’s making a big life event affordable, buying something they need now without affecting their monthly budget, or getting by until payday. We’re shaping this mission by building products our customers love, while safely scaling some of Monzo’s biggest revenue lines.</p> <p>Borrowing is one of Monzo’s most complex and fastest-growing domains. We operate 12+ products across multiple geographies, underpinned by 1,700+ data models and an analytics engineering team that’s scaling to match. We’re in the middle of a major data architecture transformation, expanding into new markets, and building the next generation of data infrastructure to support it all.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Staff Analytics Engineer to help shape how Borrowing builds and uses data at scale. Reporting to the Borrowing Data Director, you’ll work across product, credit, engineering, Data Platform, and analytics engineering teams to turn complex technical problems into clearer systems, stronger data products, and better business decisions.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Architecting Borrowing’s data layer at scale.</strong> Partnering across Analytics Engineering, Product, Engineering, Credit, and Data Platform to shape how 1,700+ models across 12+ products are structured, connected, and evolved. You’ll set shared patterns that help teams build trusted, consistent, and scalable data products across Borrowing.</li> <li><strong>Designing and governing data products</strong>. Moving us beyond ad-hoc tables toward well-defined, contractual data assets with clear ownership, SLAs, documentation, and interfaces. You’ll work with teams across Borrowing and Data Platform to define what makes a Borrowing dataset “production-grade” and consumable by analytics, ML, decisioning, and regulatory teams.</li> <li><strong>Building feature stores and reusable analytical assets</strong>. Identifying cross-product signals (credit behaviour, repayment patterns, affordability, risk indicators) that should be modelled once, tested rigorously, and consumed by many. You’ll design the layer that turns raw product data into curated, versioned features that power models, dashboards, and decisions.</li> <li><strong>Scaling our analytics engineering infrastructure</strong>. Shaping the tooling, patterns, and developer experience that make an 80+ person credit and data organisation more productive. This means influencing our data architecture and ways of working across data and credit disciplines, while partnering with the central Data Platform team to ensure Borrowing’s needs are reflected in ingestion, streaming, and schema contract design.</li> <li><strong>Driving cross-product data consistency</strong>. As we expand across geographies and product lines, ensuring our data models are coherent and comparable. You’ll work with AE leads and domain experts to define shared conventions and abstractions that allow us to reason about Borrowing as a whole, not just product-by-product.</li> <li><strong>Being a senior technical partner for Borrowing’s data estate.</strong> Partnering with backend engineers on source data payload design, with product managers on measurement strategy, with credit teams on decisioning data, and with senior leadership on what’s possible and what’s next.</li> <li><strong>Leading through influence and leverage. </strong>You won’t manage people directly, but you’ll shape how an entire domain builds data. You’ll multiply the impact of AEs across Borrowing by setting the right patterns, unblocking architectural decisions, and raising the bar on what good looks like.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You think in systems, not just queries.</strong> You’ve designed data architectures that span multiple products or domains, and you know how to keep them coherent as they scale. You can take ambiguous problems and turn them into a clear technical direction, delivery sequence, and set of trade-offs.</li> <li><strong>You’ve built data products, not just data models.</strong> You understand the difference between a table that exists and a data asset that’s governed, documented, versioned, discoverable, and trusted. You’ve defined SLAs, contracts, interfaces, or ownership models for data consumers, and you’re excited to do this at scale.</li> <li><strong>You have deep fluency with analytics engineering systems and infrastructure.</strong> dbt at scale, BigQuery or equivalent, CI/CD for data, testing frameworks, and orchestration. You don’t just use these tools, you shape how teams use them. You’ve hit the scaling limits and know what to do about them.</li> <li><strong>You can design reusable feature layers.</strong> You’ve designed, contributed to, or have a clear vision for reusable feature layers that serve multiple consumers, including ML pipelines, dashboards, decisioning engines, and regulatory reporting. You understand the trade-offs between freshness, cost, granularity, correctness, and ease of use.</li> <li><strong>You’re comfortable at the platform boundary.</strong> You can have a productive conversation with a Data Platform engineer about ingestion patterns, streaming vs. batch trade-offs, schema evolution, and infrastructure costs. You don’t need to build the platform, but you need to shape what it delivers.</li> <li><strong>You connect technical choices to business outcomes.</strong> You care about whether data models, feature layers, and platform patterns actually improve decisions. You understand how product, credit, engineering, and operational teams use data, and you use that context to align people around better technical choices.</li> <li><strong>You lead through others.</strong> You create leverage not by writing more SQL, but by setting patterns, reviewing designs, unblocking teams, and raising the standard. You’re energised by making 30+ people more effective, not by being the single expert.</li> <li><strong>You communicate across altitudes.</strong> You can whiteboard a data architecture with a back-end engineer in the morning and present a strategic data roadmap to a director in the afternoon. You adapt your message to your audience without losing precision.</li> <li><strong>You care about credit products.</strong> You’re excited, or curious, about the complexity of lending, including risk, affordability, regulatory constraints, and multi-product dynamics. You see it as a fascinating data domain, not just a business vertical.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Interview process</strong></p> <p>Our typical process is structured as:</p> <ul> <li>Recruiter call</li> <li>Initial call  </li> <li>3 x 1 hours sessions (final interview)</li> </ul> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. </p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰  £121,600-164,600 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance and<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> benefits</a></p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK </p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas </p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕ And much more, see our full list of benefits<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> <strong>here</strong></a></p> <p>#LI-AS #LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Talent Management
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion is entering a new chapter of People work: more AI-native, more strategic, and more focused on building systems that help every Notino do the best work of their career. We're building toward a four-pronged People Consulting model: - Strategic People Partners who steer orgs as the consultative layer closest to the business. - Talent Management is the systems and programmatic engine layer — talent programs, systems and resourcing work that support our People Partners & talent density. - People Relations is the primary arm and escalation point for employee relations. - People Operations owns the operational layer of the end-to-end employee lifecycle, a layer we're increasingly scaling through agentic services. We are looking for the right person to join our existing Talent Management arm. This person will help define, operationalize, and continuously improve how we grow talent at Notion. This role sits at the intersection of talent philosophy, people partner strategy and enablement. This is not a siloed program role. It is an extension of our strategic People Partner & Talent Management org: someone who brings deep talent management craft, strong business judgment, and the operating muscle to turn philosophy into practice across the company. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: 1. Maintain and operationalize Notion’s talent philosophies - Codify and evolve our talent philosophies across performance, growth, leadership, career development, internal mobility, early career, and high-performance expectations. - Translate principles into practical tools, rituals, and operating mechanisms that People Partners and leaders can use. - Ensure our philosophies stay connected to business needs, company strategy, and the realities of how work is changing. - Ensure the talent systems we build are durable and make talent expectations clear, consistent, and actionable — without over-programming or adding unnecessary process. 2. Co-build the programmatic layer & talent engine for People Partners - Help steer and co-build the overall talent enablement engine equipping People Partners to drive higher-quality actions with leaders. If People Partners are consultants, our talent management arm builds the resources to enable talent density. - Keep our core philosophies aligned with our deployment-ready materials: playbooks, manager guides, conversation frameworks, decision tools, calibration support, and coaching resources. - Partner closely with strategic People Partner leaders to identify where enablement is needed most and how it should show up in the business. Develop net new, creative strategies aligned with Notion’s values and vision. - Ensure People Partners are not just consuming talent programs, but actively shaping and deploying them with context and judgment. 3. Enable talent density - Bring the taste, craft, and pattern recognition to understand what different talent segments need to grow. - Design self-service strategies & actions that help leaders develop talent - Power up our mechanisms to better identify, engage, stretch, and retain talent. - Enable our leadership bench. 4. Lead fluid, high-leverage talent strategy projects This role will flex into the highest-priority talent questions of the moment. Examples of historical and potential high-impact projects include: - Early career strategy enablement: helping define the scaffolding, manager expectations, growth model, and experience needed to make Notion a definitive launchpad for early-career talent. - Total rewards exploration: partnering with Total Rewards, Talent, and People leaders to explore what recognition could look like in a more AI-native, high-performance environment. - Role architecture for the next generation of work: rethinking how roles, levels, career paths, and talent systems should evolve as AI changes what people can do. - Internal mobility and talent flow: partnering with People Ops, Recruiting and People partners in creating clearer, higher-touch pathways for high-slope talent to find the right next opportunity inside Notion. - Leadership expectations: supporting the translation of Notion’s leadership philosophy into practical enablement for managers and leaders. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Significant experience designing, scaling, and evolving talent management strategies and programs (e.g. performance, talent reviews, succession planning, career architecture, or related initiatives). - Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive cross-functional change without formal authority. - Experience translating ambiguous talent philosophies into scalable tools, frameworks, and operating mechanisms. - Strong business acumen and organizational judgment, with the ability to connect talent decisions to company outcomes. - Excitement for reimagining talent management in an AI-native world. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $230,000 - $270,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. title: Partner Sales Director - IHV Alliances
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced <strong>IHV Alliance Sales Director</strong> to join our strategic partnerships team who will be responsible for leading IHV Alliances globally, in AMER, EMEA or APAC regions. Reporting to the Head of IHV Alliances, the IHV Alliance Sales Director will work closely with IHV and Canonical teams in those geographies to develop and maintain strong relationships with senior executives at strategic partner organizations, fostering collaboration and alignment on joint business objectives. The IHV Alliance Sales Director will manage and grow a team of Business Development Managers and help them identify and pursue new business opportunities with IHVs, driving revenue growth and market expansion, develop and execute go-to-market strategies for joint offerings, oversee the day-to-day management of alliances including contract negotiations and performance tracking, and issue resolution. </p> <p>The Director is responsible for building trusted relationships with IHV partners, increasing Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelising the partnership and leading all business interactions from engineer to CxO. They will often run customer workshops focused on particular initiatives at that customer, attend sales events, give public presentations and lead executive engagements.</p> <p>Location: This role will be based remotely in AMER, EMEA or APAC regions.</p> <p><strong>As an IHV Alliance Sales Director you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build strategic relationships with IHV partners at all levels</li> <li>Grow their awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu</li> <li>Demonstrate a deep understanding of the Linux and cloud software ecosystem</li> <li>Negotiate contracts and commercial business terms</li> <li>Demonstrate a deep understanding of large and complex organizations</li> <li>Lead partnerships in APAC with companies like Lenovo, Huawei, Quanta, Fujitsu, Inspur, H3C,  NEC, Asus etc.</li> <li>Lead partnerships in EMEA with companies like Ericsson, Nokia, Bull, Siemens</li> <li>Lead partnerships in the Americas with companies like Dell, HPE, IBM, Supermicro</li> <li>Work closely with marketing, sales engineering and product management</li> <li>Deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner</li> <li>Lead executive interlocks between IHV and Canonical leadership</li> <li>Travel regularly - sometimes internationally - to drive partnerships in person</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Valued skills and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in alliance or indirect sales management roles</li> <li>Autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality</li> <li>Ability to capture customer requirements, evaluate gaps, identify and create opportunities</li> <li>Passionate about Ubuntu products and mission</li> <li>Comfortable in fast-paced and high pressure environments with measurable goals</li> <li>Experience with Linux, virtualization, containers, and other cloud technologies.</li> <li>Excellent communication and presentation skills</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></p> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>About Canonical</strong></p> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p>
